```typescript
    const targetEmail = user?.email || 'admin@zecratary.com';
    setLoading(true);

    try {
      // Dynamic currency detection
      if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
        const storedSym = localStorage.getItem('zecratary_currency_symbol');
        const cur = localStorage.getItem('zecratary_currency') || 'USD';
        setCurrencySymbol(storedSym || CURRENCY_SYMBOLS[cur] || '$');
      }

      const qParams = new URLSearchParams({
        userId: targetUserId,
        email: targetEmail,
        page: String(targetPage),
        limit: '10',
        search: searchQuery,
        type: typeFilter,
        t: String(Date.now())
      });

      const res = await fetch(`/api/tokens?${qParams.toString()}`, { cache: 'no-store' });
      if (res.ok) {
        const data = await res.json();
        if (data.success) {
          if (data.balance !== null && data.balance !== undefined) setTokenBalance(Number(data.balance));
          if (data.walletBalance !== null && data.walletBalance !== undefined) setWalletBalance(Number(data.walletBalance));
          if (data.tokenSymbol) setTokenSymbol(data.tokenSymbol);
          if (data.tokenIcon !== undefined) setTokenIcon(data.tokenIcon || '');
          if (data.tokenName) setTokenName(data.tokenName);
          if (data.isEnabled !== undefined) setIsTokenEnabled(Boolean(data.isEnabled));
          
          if (data.costs) {
            setCosts({
              chef: data.costs.chef ?? data.costs.aiChefCost ?? 2,
              import_url: data.costs.import_url ?? data.costs.importUrlCost ?? 5,
              import_text: data.costs.import_text ?? data.costs.importTextCost ?? 2,
              import_photo: data.costs.import_photo ?? data.costs.importPhotoCost ?? 10,
              meal_planner: data.costs.meal_planner ?? data.costs.mealPlannerCost ?? 5,
              macro_analysis: data.costs.macro_analysis ?? data.costs.macroAnalysisCost ?? 3
            });
          }

          if (Array.isArray(data.packages) && data.packages.length > 0) {
            const mapped = data.packages.map((pkg: any) => {
              const tokensVal = Number(pkg.tokens ?? pkg.tokenAmount ?? 0);
              const priceVal = Number(pkg.price ?? pkg.priceDollars ?? 0);
              const isPop = Boolean(pkg.popular ?? pkg.isPopular ?? (pkg.badge && String(pkg.badge).toLowerCase().includes('popular')));
              const isBest = Boolean(pkg.bestValue ?? (pkg.badge && String(pkg.badge).toLowerCase().includes('value')));
              return {
                id: pkg.id,
                name: pkg.name,
                tokens: tokensVal,
                tokenAmount: tokensVal,
                price: priceVal,
                priceDollars: priceVal,
                badge: pkg.badge,
                bonusTokens: Number(pkg.bonusTokens || 0),
                popular: isPop,
                bestValue: isBest,
                description: pkg.description
              };
            });
            setPackages(mapped);
          }

          if (Array.isArray(data.transactions)) {
            setTransactions(data.transactions);
          }

          if (data.totalPages) setTotalPages(data.totalPages);
          if (data.stats) setStats(data.stats);
        }
      }

      // Live Wallet Balance Sync
      try {
        const wRes = await fetch(`/api/wallet?email=${encodeURIComponent(targetEmail)}&t=${Date.now()}`, { cache: 'no-store' });
        if (wRes.ok) {
          const wData = await wRes.json();
          if (wData.user && typeof wData.user.wallet_balance !== 'undefined') {
            setWalletBalance(parseFloat(wData.user.wallet_balance || 0));
          }
          if (wData.walletSymbol || wData.currencySymbol) {
            setCurrencySymbol(wData.walletSymbol || wData.currencySymbol);
          } else if (wData.settings?.currency) {
            setCurrencySymbol(CURRENCY_SYMBOLS[wData.settings.currency] || '$');
          }
        }
      } catch (_) {}

    } catch (err) {
      console.warn('[TokenPortal] Error loading telemetry:', err);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    document.title = `${t('tokenPortalTitle', 'Token Portal')} - Zecratary`;
    initAuthStorage();
    const user = getCurrentUser();
    if (!user) {
      router.replace('/login');
      return;
    }
    setCurrentUser(user);
    fetchTokenData(user, page, search, selectedType);

    const handleSync = () => {
      const u = getCurrentUser();
      if (u) {
        setCurrentUser(u);
        fetchTokenData(u, page, search, selectedType);
      }
    };

    window.addEventListener('storage', handleSync);
    window.addEventListener('zecratary_tokens_updated', handleSync);
    window.addEventListener('zecratary_wallet_updated', handleSync);
    window.addEventListener('zecratary_token_settings_updated', handleSync);
    window.addEventListener('zecratary_languages_updated', handleSync);
    window.addEventListener('zecratary_dictionary_updated', handleSync);
    window.addEventListener('zecratary_locale_changed', handleSync);

    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('storage', handleSync);
      window.removeEventListener('zecratary_tokens_updated', handleSync);
      window.removeEventListener('zecratary_wallet_updated', handleSync);
      window.removeEventListener('zecratary_token_settings_updated', handleSync);
      window.removeEventListener('zecratary_languages_updated', handleSync);
      window.removeEventListener('zecratary_dictionary_updated', handleSync);
      window.removeEventListener('zecratary_locale_changed', handleSync);
    };
  }, [fetchTokenData, page, search, selectedType, router, t]);

  // Execute Atomic Purchase via Store Wallet
  const handleConfirmPurchase = async () => {
    if (!confirmModalPackage || !currentUser) return;
    setPurchasing(true);

    const tokensToBuy = Number(confirmModalPackage.tokens ?? confirmModalPackage.tokenAmount ?? 0);
    const priceToPay = Number(confirmModalPackage.price ?? confirmModalPackage.priceDollars ?? 0);

    try {
      const res = await fetch('/api/tokens', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          action: 'purchase',
          packageId: confirmModalPackage.id,
          tokens: tokensToBuy,
          tokenAmount: tokensToBuy,
          price: priceToPay,
          priceDollars: priceToPay,
          packageName: confirmModalPackage.name,
          userId: currentUser.id || 'usr_admin_1',
          userEmail: currentUser.email || 'admin@zecratary.com'
        })
      });

      const data = await res.json();
      if (!res.ok || !data.success) {
        throw new Error(data.error || 'Token purchase failed.');
      }

      const newBal = Number(data.balance ?? (tokenBalance + tokensToBuy));
      setTokenBalance(newBal);

      const newWalletBal = Math.max(0, walletBalance - priceToPay);
      setWalletBalance(newWalletBal);

      // Local user cache sync
      if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
        try {
          const raw = localStorage.getItem('zecratary_user');
          if (raw) {
            const u = JSON.parse(raw);
            u.token_balance = newBal;
            u.wallet_balance = newWalletBal;
            localStorage.setItem('zecratary_user', JSON.stringify(u));
          }
        } catch (_) {}
      }

      // Broadcast to other tabs & UI capsules
      window.dispatchEvent(new Event('zecratary_tokens_updated'));
      window.dispatchEvent(new Event('zecratary_wallet_updated'));
      window.dispatchEvent(new Event('storage'));

      try {
        const bc = new BroadcastChannel('zecratary_balance_channel');
        bc.postMessage({ type: 'TOKEN_PURCHASED', tokens: newBal, wallet: newWalletBal });
        bc.close();
      } catch (_) {}

      showToast(
        (t('purchaseSuccessToast', 'Successfully purchased {tokens} {symbol}!'))
          .replace('{tokens}', tokensToBuy.toLocaleString())
          .replace('{symbol}', tokenSymbol),
        'success'
      );

      setConfirmModalPackage(null);
      fetchTokenData(currentUser, page, search, selectedType);
    } catch (err: any) {
      showToast(err.message || 'Error completing purchase.', 'error');
    } finally {
      setPurchasing(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    // TASK 1: Full-Width (100%) Fluid Canvas with Responsive Padding
    <div 
      className="w-full max-w-full px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 xl:px-10 space-y-6 pb-24 font-sans transition-colors duration-200"
      style={{ color: 'var(--color-text)' }}
    >
      {/* Toast Alert Banner */}
      {toastMessage && (
        <div 
          className="fixed top-20 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 z-50 px-5 py-2.5 rounded-2xl text-xs font-bold shadow-2xl flex items-center gap-2 animate-in fade-in slide-in-from-top-3 border"
          style={{
            backgroundColor: 'var(--color-card)',
            borderColor: toastMessage.type === 'success' ? 'var(--color-emerald)' : '#ef4444',
            color: 'var(--color-text)'
          }}
        >
          {toastMessage.type === 'success' ? (
            <CheckCircle2 className="h-4 w-4" style={{ color: 'var(--color-emerald)' }} />
          ) : (
            <AlertCircle className="h-4 w-4 text-red-500" />
          )}
          <span>{toastMessage.text}</span>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Top Header Bar */}
      <div 
        className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-4 border-b pb-4" 
        style={{ borderColor: 'var(--color-border)' }}
      >
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-black tracking-tight" style={{ color: 'var(--color-primary)' }}>
            {t('tokenPortalTitle', 'Token Portal')}
          </h1>
          <p className="text-xs" style={{ color: 'var(--color-text-secondary)' }}>
            {t('tokenPortalSubtitle', 'Purchase and manage tokens for AI Chef recipe generation and automated imports.')}
          </p>
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => fetchTokenData(currentUser, page, search, selectedType)}
            disabled={loading}
            className="border font-bold text-xs px-3.5 py-2.5 rounded-xl transition flex items-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer shadow-xs disabled:opacity-50 hover:opacity-80"
            style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--color-inner-dark)', borderColor: 'var(--color-border)', color: 'var(--color-text)' }}
            title={t('reloadBtn', 'Reload')}
          >
            <RefreshCw className={`h-4 w-4 ${loading ? 'animate-spin' : ''}`} style={{ color: 'var(--color-primary)' }} />
            <span>{t('reloadBtn', 'Reload')}</span>
          </button>

          <Link
            href="/wallet"
            className="px-4 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold border transition shadow-xs flex items-center gap-1.5 hover:opacity-80"
            style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--color-inner-dark)', borderColor: 'var(--color-border)', color: 'var(--color-emerald)' }}
          >
            <Wallet className="h-4 w-4" />
            <span>{t('topUpWalletBtn', 'Top Up Wallet')}</span>
          </Link>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Free Token Mode Alert Banner */}
      {!isTokenEnabled && (
        <div 
          className="p-4 rounded-3xl border flex items-center gap-3 shadow-sm animate-in fade-in"
          style={{
            backgroundColor: 'var(--color-card)',
            borderColor: 'var(--color-emerald)',
            color: 'var(--color-text)'
          }}
        >
          <div className="p-2.5 rounded-2xl bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-400 border border-emerald-500/20">
            <Sparkles className="h-5 w-5" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <h4 className="font-extrabold text-xs uppercase tracking-wider text-emerald-400">
              {t('freeTokenModeBanner', 'Free Token Mode Active')}
            </h4>
            <p className="text-xs opacity-80 mt-0.5">
              {t('freeTokenModeDesc', 'Token consumption is currently bypassed by the administrator. All AI Chef and import features are free to use!')}
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* 1. KPI Telemetry Summary Cards */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4">
        {/* Current Token Balance */}
        <div 
          className="p-5 rounded-3xl border shadow-xs flex flex-col justify-between space-y-3"
          style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--color-card)', borderColor: 'var(--color-border)' }}
        >
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
            <span className="text-xs font-bold opacity-75">{t('currentTokenBalance', 'Current Token Balance')}</span>
            <div className="p-2 rounded-xl bg-amber-500/10 text-amber-500 border border-amber-500/20">
              <DynamicTokenIcon symbol={tokenSymbol} icon={tokenIcon} size={18} className="w-4 h-4" />
            </div>
          </div>
          <div className="text-2xl font-black font-mono flex items-center gap-2">
            <span>{tokenBalance.toLocaleString()}</span>
            <span className="text-sm font-sans flex items-center gap-1 opacity-90">
              <DynamicTokenIcon symbol={tokenSymbol} icon={tokenIcon} size={16} className="w-4 h-4 inline-block" />
            </span>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Store Wallet Balance */}
        <div 
          className="p-5 rounded-3xl border shadow-xs flex flex-col justify-between space-y-3"
          style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--color-card)', borderColor: 'var(--color-border)' }}
        >
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
            <span className="text-xs font-bold opacity-75">{t('storeWalletBalance', 'Store Wallet Balance')}</span>
            <div className="p-2 rounded-xl bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-400 border border-emerald-500/20">
              <Wallet className="h-4 w-4" />
            </div>
          </div>
          <div className="text-2xl font-black font-mono text-emerald-400">
            {currencySymbol}{walletBalance.toFixed(2)}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Lifetime Tokens Used */}
        <div 
          className="p-5 rounded-3xl border shadow-xs flex flex-col justify-between space-y-3"
          style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--color-card)', borderColor: 'var(--color-border)' }}
        >
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
            <span className="text-xs font-bold opacity-75">{t('lifetimeDeducted', 'Lifetime Tokens Used')}</span>
            <div className="p-2 rounded-xl bg-rose-500/10 text-rose-400 border border-rose-500/20">
              <TrendingDown className="h-4 w-4" />
            </div>
          </div>
          <div className="text-2xl font-black font-mono">
            {stats.totalDeducted.toLocaleString()}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Lifetime Tokens Granted */}
        <div 
          className="p-5 rounded-3xl border shadow-xs flex flex-col justify-between space-y-3"
          style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--color-card)', borderColor: 'var(--color-border)' }}
        >
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
            <span className="text-xs font-bold opacity-75">{t('lifetimeGranted', 'Lifetime Tokens Granted')}</span>
            <div className="p-2 rounded-xl bg-sky-500/10 text-sky-400 border border-sky-500/20">
              <TrendingUp className="h-4 w-4" />
            </div>
          </div>
          <div className="text-2xl font-black font-mono">
            {stats.totalGranted.toLocaleString()}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* 2. Token Bundles Showcase (Fluid Grid) */}
      <div 
        className="p-6 rounded-3xl border shadow-sm space-y-5"
        style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--color-card)', borderColor: 'var(--color-border)' }}
      >
        <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b pb-4" style={{ borderColor: 'var(--color-border)' }}>
          <div>
            <h3 className="text-lg font-black tracking-tight" style={{ color: 'var(--color-primary)' }}>
              {t('tokenBundlesHeading', 'Available Token Bundles')}
            </h3>
            <p className="text-xs opacity-75">
              {t('tokenBundlesDesc', 'Select a package to instantly top up your AI token balance via your Store Wallet.')}
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 xl:grid-cols-3 2xl:grid-cols-4 gap-5">
          {packages.map((pkg) => {
            const displayTokens = Number(pkg.tokens ?? pkg.tokenAmount ?? 0);
            const displayPrice = Number(pkg.price ?? pkg.priceDollars ?? 0);
            const isPopular = Boolean(pkg.popular || (pkg.badge && pkg.badge.toLowerCase().includes('popular')));
            const isBestValue = Boolean(pkg.bestValue || (pkg.badge && pkg.badge.toLowerCase().includes('value')));

            return (
              <div
                key={pkg.id}
                className="p-5 rounded-3xl border flex flex-col justify-between space-y-4 shadow-xs hover:shadow-md transition relative group"
                style={{
                  backgroundColor: 'var(--color-inner-dark)',
                  borderColor: isPopular ? 'var(--color-primary)' : 'var(--color-border)'
                }}
              >
                <div className="space-y-3">
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                    <h4 className="font-black text-sm" style={{ color: 'var(--color-text)' }}>
                      {pkg.name}
                    </h4>
                    {isPopular && (
                      <span className="px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[9px] font-black uppercase tracking-wider text-white bg-[var(--color-primary)]">
                        {pkg.badge || t('popularBadge', 'Most Popular')}
                      </span>
                    )}
                    {isBestValue && !isPopular && (
                      <span className="px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[9px] font-black uppercase tracking-wider text-emerald-400 border border-emerald-500/30 bg-emerald-500/10">
                        {pkg.badge || t('bestValueBadge', 'Best Value')}
                      </span>
                    )}
                    {!isPopular && !isBestValue && pkg.badge && (
                      <span className="px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[9px] font-black uppercase tracking-wider text-[var(--color-primary)] border border-[var(--color-primary)]/30 bg-[var(--color-primary)]/10">
                        {pkg.badge}
                      </span>
                    )}
                  </div>

                  <div className="flex items-baseline gap-1.5 font-mono">
                    <span className="text-2xl font-black text-amber-500">
                      +{displayTokens.toLocaleString()}
                    </span>
                    <span className="text-xs opacity-80 flex items-center gap-1">
                      <DynamicTokenIcon symbol={tokenSymbol} icon={tokenIcon} size={14} className="w-3.5 h-3.5 inline-block" />
                    </span>
                    {pkg.bonusTokens && pkg.bonusTokens > 0 ? (
                      <span className="text-[10px] font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-400 border border-emerald-500/20 ml-1">
                        +{(pkg.bonusTokens).toLocaleString()} Bonus
                      </span>
                    ) : null}
                  </div>

                  {pkg.description ? (
                    <p className="text-xs leading-relaxed opacity-75">
                      {pkg.description}
                    </p>
                  ) : (
                    <p className="text-xs leading-relaxed opacity-60">
                      Top up your culinary workspace with {displayTokens.toLocaleString()} tokens.
                    </p>
                  )}
                </div>

                <div className="pt-3 border-t flex items-center justify-between gap-2" style={{ borderColor: 'var(--color-border)' }}>
                  <div className="flex items-baseline gap-1">
                    <span className="text-base font-black font-mono">
                      {currencySymbol}{displayPrice.toFixed(2)}
                    </span>
                    <span className="text-[10px] opacity-60">{t('oneTimePayment', 'one-time')}</span>
                  </div>

                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => setConfirmModalPackage(pkg)}
                    className="px-4 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold text-white transition shadow cursor-pointer hover:opacity-90 active:scale-95"
                    style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--color-primary)' }}
                  >
                    {t('buyNowBtn', 'Buy Now')}
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* 3. Feature Consumption Information Bar (All 6 Rates) */}
      <div 
        className="p-4 rounded-3xl border flex flex-col xl:flex-row items-center justify-between gap-4 text-xs font-medium"
        style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--color-card)', borderColor: 'var(--color-border)' }}
      >
        <span className="font-bold text-[var(--color-primary)] uppercase tracking-wider text-[11px] shrink-0">
          {t('featureCostsHeading', 'Feature Consumption Rates')}:
        </span>

        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-6 gap-3.5 w-full text-xs font-bold">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 opacity-90 p-2 rounded-xl border" style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--color-inner-dark)', borderColor: 'var(--color-border)' }}>
            <Zap className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-amber-400 shrink-0" />
            <span className="truncate">{t('chefCostLabel', 'AI Chef')}:</span>
            <strong className="font-mono text-amber-500 ml-auto">{costs.chef} {tokenSymbol}</strong>
          </div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 opacity-90 p-2 rounded-xl border" style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--color-inner-dark)', borderColor: 'var(--color-border)' }}>
            <Zap className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-sky-400 shrink-0" />
            <span className="truncate">{t('importUrlCostLabel', 'URL Scraper')}:</span>
            <strong className="font-mono text-sky-400 ml-auto">{costs.import_url} {tokenSymbol}</strong>
          </div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 opacity-90 p-2 rounded-xl border" style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--color-inner-dark)', borderColor: 'var(--color-border)' }}>
            <Zap className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-emerald-400 shrink-0" />
            <span className="truncate">{t('importPhotoCostLabel', 'Photo OCR')}:</span>
            <strong className="font-mono text-emerald-400 ml-auto">{costs.import_photo} {tokenSymbol}</strong>
          </div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 opacity-90 p-2 rounded-xl border" style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--color-inner-dark)', borderColor: 'var(--color-border)' }}>
            <Zap className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-purple-400 shrink-0" />
            <span className="truncate">{t('importTextCostLabel', 'Text Parsing')}:</span>
            <strong className="font-mono text-purple-400 ml-auto">{costs.import_text} {tokenSymbol}</strong>
          </div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 opacity-90 p-2 rounded-xl border" style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--color-inner-dark)', borderColor: 'var(--color-border)' }}>
            <Zap className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-indigo-400 shrink-0" />
            <span className="truncate">{t('mealPlannerCostLabel', 'Meal Plan')}:</span>
            <strong className="font-mono text-indigo-400 ml-auto">{costs.meal_planner} {tokenSymbol}</strong>
          </div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 opacity-90 p-2 rounded-xl border" style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--color-inner-dark)', borderColor: 'var(--color-border)' }}>
            <Zap className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-teal-400 shrink-0" />
            <span className="truncate">{t('macroAnalysisCostLabel', 'Macro Analysis')}:</span>
            <strong className="font-mono text-teal-400 ml-auto">{costs.macro_analysis} {tokenSymbol}</strong>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* 4. Token Audit Ledger Table (Autofill Guardrail & Accessible Region) */}
      <div 
        role="region"
        aria-label="Token Transaction Audit Ledger"
        data-lpignore="true"
        className="p-6 rounded-3xl border shadow-sm space-y-4"
        style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--color-card)', borderColor: 'var(--color-border)' }}
      >
        <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-3 border-b pb-4" style={{ borderColor: 'var(--color-border)' }}>
          <h3 className="font-extrabold text-sm" style={{ color: 'var(--color-primary)' }}>
            {t('tokenLedgerHeading', 'Token Audit Ledger')}
          </h3>

          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <div className="relative">
              <Search className="h-3.5 w-3.5 absolute left-3 top-2.5 pointer-events-none opacity-60" />
              <input
                type="text"
                autoComplete="off"
                data-lpignore="true"
                data-form-type="other"
                spellCheck="false"
                placeholder={t('searchLedgerPlaceholder', 'Search transactions by description or ID...')}
                value={search}
                onChange={(e) => setSearch(e.target.value)}
                className="pl-8 pr-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl border text-xs outline-none font-medium w-48 sm:w-64"
                style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--color-inner-dark)', borderColor: 'var(--color-border)', color: 'var(--color-text)' }}
              />
            </div>

            <select
              value={selectedType}
              onChange={(e) => setSelectedType(e.target.value)}
              className="px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-xl border text-xs font-bold outline-none cursor-pointer"
              style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--color-inner-dark)', borderColor: 'var(--color-border)', color: 'var(--color-text)' }}
            >
              <option value="all">{t('allTypesFilter', 'All Types')}</option>
              <option value="chef">{t('filterTypeChef', 'AI Chef')}</option>
              <option value="import">{t('filterTypeImport', 'Recipe Import')}</option>
              <option value="purchase">{t('filterTypePurchase', 'Bundle Purchases')}</option>
              <option value="grant">{t('filterTypeGrant', 'Plan Grants')}</option>
              <option value="planner">{t('filterTypePlanner', 'Meal Planner')}</option>
              <option value="macro">{t('filterTypeMacro', 'Macro Analysis')}</option>
            </select>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Transactions Table */}
        <div className="overflow-x-auto">
          {transactions.length === 0 ? (
            <div className="py-12 text-center text-xs opacity-50">
              {t('noTransactionsFound', 'No transactions found matching your criteria.')}
            </div>
          ) : (
            <table className="w-full text-left text-xs border-collapse">
              <thead>
                <tr className="border-b text-[10px] uppercase font-bold opacity-70" style={{ borderColor: 'var(--color-border)' }}>
                  <th className="py-2.5 px-3">{t('colTxDate', 'Date')}</th>
                  <th className="py-2.5 px-3">{t('colTxId', 'Transaction ID')}</th>
                  <th className="py-2.5 px-3">{t('colTxType', 'Type')}</th>
                  <th className="py-2.5 px-3">{t('colTxDesc', 'Description')}</th>
                  <th className="py-2.5 px-3 text-right">{t('colTxAmount', 'Amount')}</th>
                  <th className="py-2.5 px-3 text-right">{t('colTxBalanceAfter', 'Balance After')}</th>
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody className="divide-y" style={{ borderColor: 'var(--color-border)' }}>
                {transactions.map((tx) => {
                  const isCredit = Number(tx.amount) > 0;
                  return (
                    <tr key={tx.id} className="hover:opacity-80 transition">
                      <td className="py-3 px-3 font-mono text-[11px] opacity-75">
                        {tx.created_at ? new Date(tx.created_at).toLocaleDateString(locale === 'th' ? 'th-TH' : (locale || 'en-US')) : '—'}
                      </td>
                      <td className="py-3 px-3 font-mono text-[10px] opacity-60">
                        {tx.id.slice(0, 14)}...
                      </td>
                      <td className="py-3 px-3">
                        <span className="text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider px-2 py-0.5 rounded border opacity-80" style={{ borderColor: 'var(--color-border)' }}>
                          {tx.type}
                        </span>
                      </td>
                      <td className="py-3 px-3 font-medium">
                        {tx.description}
                      </td>
                      <td className={`py-3 px-3 text-right font-bold font-mono ${isCredit ? 'text-emerald-400' : 'text-rose-400'}`}>
                        {isCredit ? `+${tx.amount}` : tx.amount} {tokenSymbol}
                      </td>
                      <td className="py-3 px-3 text-right font-mono font-bold opacity-80">
                        {tx.balance_after}
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  );
                })}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* Pagination Controls */}
        {totalPages > 1 && (
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between pt-4 border-t text-xs" style={{ borderColor: 'var(--color-border)' }}>
            <span className="opacity-75">
              {(t('pageIndicator', 'Page {page} of {total}'))
                .replace('{page}', String(page))
                .replace('{total}', String(totalPages))}
            </span>

            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setPage(Math.max(1, page - 1))}
                disabled={page === 1}
                className="p-2 rounded-xl border disabled:opacity-30 cursor-pointer shadow-xs hover:opacity-80"
                style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--color-inner-dark)', borderColor: 'var(--color-border)' }}
                title={t('prevPage', 'Previous')}
              >
                <ChevronLeft className="h-4 w-4" />
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setPage(Math.min(totalPages, page + 1))}
                disabled={page === totalPages}
                className="p-2 rounded-xl border disabled:opacity-30 cursor-pointer shadow-xs hover:opacity-80"
                style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--color-inner-dark)', borderColor: 'var(--color-border)' }}
                title={t('nextPage', 'Next')}
              >
                <ChevronRight className="h-4 w-4" />
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* CONFIRMATION PURCHASE MODAL (Autofill Safe Form-Free Container) */}
      {confirmModalPackage && (
        <div 
          onClick={() => setConfirmModalPackage(null)}
          className="fixed inset-0 bg-black/80 backdrop-blur-md z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 cursor-pointer"
        >
          <div 
            onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
            role="region"
            aria-label="Confirm Token Purchase Modal"
            data-lpignore="true"
            className="border rounded-3xl max-w-md w-full p-6 space-y-5 shadow-2xl relative text-xs cursor-default transition-colors duration-200"
            style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--color-card)', borderColor: 'var(--color-border)', color: 'var(--color-text)' }}
          >
            <div className="flex justify-between items-center border-b pb-3" style={{ borderColor: 'var(--color-border)' }}>
              <h3 className="font-extrabold text-sm" style={{ color: 'var(--color-primary)' }}>
                {t('confirmPurchaseModalTitle', 'Confirm Token Purchase')}
              </h3>
              <button type="button" onClick={() => setConfirmModalPackage(null)} className="p-1 rounded-lg">
                <X className="h-4 w-4" />
              </button>
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-3.5">
              <div className="p-4 rounded-2xl border space-y-2.5" style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--color-inner-dark)', borderColor: 'var(--color-border)' }}>
                <div className="flex justify-between items-center">
                  <span className="opacity-75">{t('tokensToCredit', 'Tokens to Credit')}:</span>
                  <span className="text-base font-black font-mono text-amber-500 flex items-center gap-1">
                    +{(Number(confirmModalPackage.tokens ?? confirmModalPackage.tokenAmount ?? 0)).toLocaleString()}
                    <DynamicTokenIcon symbol={tokenSymbol} icon={tokenIcon} size={16} className="w-4 h-4 inline-block" />
                  </span>
                </div>
                <div className="flex justify-between items-center">
                  <span className="opacity-75">{t('amountToDeduct', 'Cost to Deduct')}:</span>
                  <span className="text-base font-black font-mono text-rose-400">
                    -{currencySymbol}{(Number(confirmModalPackage.price ?? confirmModalPackage.priceDollars ?? 0)).toFixed(2)}
                  </span>
                </div>
                <div className="flex justify-between items-center border-t pt-2" style={{ borderColor: 'var(--color-border)' }}>
                  <span className="opacity-75">{t('storeWalletBalance', 'Store Wallet Balance')}:</span>
                  <span className="font-mono font-bold">
                    {currencySymbol}{walletBalance.toFixed(2)}
                  </span>
                </div>
                <div className="flex justify-between items-center">
                  <span className="opacity-75">{t('walletBalanceAfter', 'Projected Wallet Balance')}:</span>
                  <span className={`font-mono font-black ${walletBalance >= Number(confirmModalPackage.price ?? confirmModalPackage.priceDollars ?? 0) ? 'text-emerald-400' : 'text-red-500'}`}>
                    {currencySymbol}{Math.max(0, walletBalance - Number(confirmModalPackage.price ?? confirmModalPackage.priceDollars ?? 0)).toFixed(2)}
                  </span>
                </div>
              </div>

              {walletBalance < Number(confirmModalPackage.price ?? confirmModalPackage.priceDollars ?? 0) && (
                <div className="p-3 rounded-2xl border flex items-center justify-between text-[11px] text-amber-500" style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--color-inner-dark)', borderColor: '#f59e0b' }}>
                  <span>
                    {(t('shortfallWarning', 'Insufficient wallet funds. Short by {amount}.'))
                      .replace('{amount}', `${currencySymbol}${(Number(confirmModalPackage.price ?? confirmModalPackage.priceDollars ?? 0) - walletBalance).toFixed(2)}`)}
                  </span>
                  <Link
                    href={`/wallet?amount=${(Number(confirmModalPackage.price ?? confirmModalPackage.priceDollars ?? 0) - walletBalance).toFixed(2)}`}
                    className="font-bold underline hover:opacity-80"
                  >
                    {t('topUpWalletBtn', 'Top Up Wallet')}
                  </Link>
                </div>
              )}

              <div className="flex justify-end gap-2.5 pt-3 border-t" style={{ borderColor: 'var(--color-border)' }}>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setConfirmModalPackage(null)}
                  className="px-4 py-2 border rounded-xl font-bold cursor-pointer hover:opacity-80"
                  style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--color-inner-dark)', borderColor: 'var(--color-border)' }}
                >
                  {t('cancelBtn', 'Cancel')}
                </button>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={handleConfirmPurchase}
                  disabled={purchasing || walletBalance < Number(confirmModalPackage.price ?? confirmModalPackage.priceDollars ?? 0)}
                  className="px-5 py-2 text-white font-bold rounded-xl shadow cursor-pointer hover:opacity-90 disabled:opacity-40"
                  style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--color-primary)' }}
                >
                  {purchasing ? t('processingPurchase', 'Processing...') : t('confirmAndPayBtn', 'Confirm & Pay')}
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```typescript
// @ts-nocheck
'use client';

import { useState, useEffect, useCallback, useRef } from 'react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { 
  Package, Plus, Trash2, Camera, Search, ArrowUpDown, 
  Check, Edit3, X, Save, ChefHat, Calendar, Minus, Sparkles 
} from 'lucide-react';
import { getCurrentUser, User, initAuthStorage } from '@/lib/auth';
import { CATEGORIES } from '@/constants/categories';
import { useTranslation } from '@/components/LanguageProvider';

export default function PantryPage() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const [currentUser, setCurrentUser] = useState<User | null>(null);
  const [pantryItems, setPantryItems] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [search, setSearch] = useState('');
  const [selectedCategory, setSelectedCategory] = useState<string>('ALL');
  const [selectedIds, setSelectedIds] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [sortAsc, setSortAsc] = useState(true);

  const fileCameraInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement | null>(null);

  const safeDefaultCategory = (Array.isArray(CATEGORIES) && CATEGORIES.length > 0)
    ? (typeof CATEGORIES[0] === 'string' ? CATEGORIES[0] : (CATEGORIES[0]?.name || 'Produce'))
    : 'Produce';

  // Add Modal State
  const [showAddModal, setShowAddModal] = useState(false);
  const [itemName, setItemName] = useState('');
  const [itemCategory, setItemCategory] = useState(safeDefaultCategory);
  const [itemQuantity, setItemQuantity] = useState('1');
  const [itemUnit, setItemUnit] = useState('Unit');
  const [expiryDate, setExpiryDate] = useState('');

  // Edit Modal State
  const [editingItem, setEditingItem] = useState<any | null>(null);

  const loadPantryData = useCallback((user: User | null) => {
    if (!user || typeof window === 'undefined') return;

    try {
      const raw = localStorage.getItem('zecratary_pantry_items') || localStorage.getItem('zecratary_pantry');
      let allItems: any[] = raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : [];

      if (!Array.isArray(allItems) || allItems.length === 0) {
        allItems = [
          { 
            id: 'p_1_' + user.id, 
            userId: user.id, 
            createdBy: user.email, 
            name: 'Eggs', 
            quantity: '6', 
            unit: 'units', 
            category: 'Dairy', 
            expiryDate: '2026-11-15' 
          },
          { 
            id: 'p_2_' + user.id, 
            userId: user.id, 
            createdBy: user.email, 
            name: 'Jasmine Rice', 
            quantity: '2', 
            unit: 'kg', 
            category: 'Grains and Pasta', 
            expiryDate: '2027-01-20' 
          },
          { 
            id: 'p_3_' + user.id, 
            userId: user.id, 
            createdBy: user.email, 
            name: 'Olive Oil', 
            quantity: '1', 
            unit: 'bottle', 
            category: 'Condiments and Sauces', 
            expiryDate: '2027-08-30' 
          }
        ];
        localStorage.setItem('zecratary_pantry_items', JSON.stringify(allItems));
        localStorage.setItem('zecratary_pantry', JSON.stringify(allItems));
      }

      const creatorItems = allItems.filter((item: any) => {
        return !item.userId || item.userId === user.id || item.createdBy === user.email;
      });

      setPantryItems(creatorItems);

      // Asynchronously synchronize with PostgreSQL/MySQL backend
      fetch(`/api/pantry?userId=${encodeURIComponent(user.id)}&t=${Date.now()}`)
        .then((res) => (res.ok ? res.json() : null))
        .then((data) => {
          if (data && Array.isArray(data.items) && data.items.length > 0) {
            setPantryItems(data.items);
            localStorage.setItem('zecratary_pantry_items', JSON.stringify(data.items));
            localStorage.setItem('zecratary_pantry', JSON.stringify(data.items));
          }
        })
        .catch(() => {});
    } catch (e) {
      console.error('Failed to load pantry data', e);
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    document.title = `${t('pantryInventory', 'Pantry Inventory')} - Zecratary`;
    initAuthStorage();
    const user = getCurrentUser();

    if (!user) {
      router.replace('/login');
      return;
    }

    setCurrentUser(user);
    loadPantryData(user);

    const handleSync = () => {
      const active = getCurrentUser();
      if (active) {
        setCurrentUser(active);
        loadPantryData(active);
      }
    };

    window.addEventListener('storage', handleSync);
    window.addEventListener('zecratary_pantry_updated', handleSync);
    window.addEventListener('zecratary_auth_changed', handleSync);
    window.addEventListener('zecratary_languages_updated', handleSync);
    window.addEventListener('zecratary_dictionary_updated', handleSync);
    window.addEventListener('zecratary_locale_changed', handleSync);

    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('storage', handleSync);
      window.removeEventListener('zecratary_pantry_updated', handleSync);
      window.removeEventListener('zecratary_auth_changed', handleSync);
      window.removeEventListener('zecratary_languages_updated', handleSync);
      window.removeEventListener('zecratary_dictionary_updated', handleSync);
      window.removeEventListener('zecratary_locale_changed', handleSync);
    };
  }, [loadPantryData, router, t]);

  const savePantryList = (updatedCreatorItems: any[]) => {
    if (!currentUser) return;

    try {
      const raw = localStorage.getItem('zecratary_pantry_items') || localStorage.getItem('zecratary_pantry');
      const allItems: any[] = raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : [];

      const otherUsersItems = allItems.filter((item: any) => {
        return item.userId && item.userId !== currentUser.id && item.createdBy !== currentUser.email;
      });

      const merged = [...updatedCreatorItems, ...otherUsersItems];
      localStorage.setItem('zecratary_pantry_items', JSON.stringify(merged));
      localStorage.setItem('zecratary_pantry', JSON.stringify(merged));

      setPantryItems(updatedCreatorItems);

      // Asynchronously persist to PostgreSQL/MySQL backend
      fetch('/api/pantry', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ userId: currentUser.id, items: updatedCreatorItems })
      }).catch(() => {});

      window.dispatchEvent(new Event('zecratary_pantry_updated'));
      window.dispatchEvent(new Event('storage'));
    } catch (e) {
      console.error('Failed to save pantry items', e);
    }
  };

  const handleAddItem = (e?: React.FormEvent | React.KeyboardEvent | React.MouseEvent) => {
    if (e && 'preventDefault' in e) e.preventDefault();
    if (!itemName.trim() || !currentUser) return;

    const newItem = {
      id: 'p_' + Date.now() + '_' + Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 6),
      userId: currentUser.id,
      createdBy: currentUser.email,
      name: itemName.trim(),
      quantity: itemQuantity || '1',
      unit: itemUnit || 'Unit',
      category: itemCategory,
      expiryDate: expiryDate || ''
    };

    const updated = [newItem, ...pantryItems];
    savePantryList(updated);
    setItemName('');
    setItemQuantity('1');
    setExpiryDate('');
    setShowAddModal(false);
  };

  const handleUpdateItem = (e?: React.FormEvent | React.KeyboardEvent | React.MouseEvent) => {
    if (e && 'preventDefault' in e) e.preventDefault();
    if (!editingItem || !editingItem.name.trim() || !currentUser) return;

    const updated = pantryItems.map(item => 
      item.id === editingItem.id 
        ? { 
            ...editingItem, 
            userId: currentUser.id, 
            createdBy: currentUser.email 
          } 
        : item
    );

    savePantryList(updated);
    setEditingItem(null);
  };

  const adjustQuantity = (id: string, delta: number, e?: React.MouseEvent) => {
    if (e) e.stopPropagation();
    const updated = pantryItems.map(item => {
      if (item.id !== id) return item;
      const current = parseFloat(item.quantity) || 1;
      const nextVal = Math.max(0, current + delta);
      return { ...item, quantity: String(nextVal) };
    });
    savePantryList(updated);
  };

  const handleDeleteItem = (id: string, e?: React.MouseEvent) => {
    if (e) e.stopPropagation();
    const updated = pantryItems.filter(item => item.id !== id);
    savePantryList(updated);
    setSelectedIds(selectedIds.filter(selectedId => selectedId !== id));
  };

  const handleDeleteSelected = () => {
    if (selectedIds.length === 0) return;
    const confirmTemplate = t('confirmDeleteSelectedIngredients', 'Are you sure you want to delete {count} selected ingredient(s)?');
    if (!confirm(confirmTemplate.replace('{count}', String(selectedIds.length)))) return;
    const updated = pantryItems.filter(item => !selectedIds.includes(item.id));
    savePantryList(updated);
    setSelectedIds([]);
  };

  const toggleSelectAll = () => {
    if (selectedIds.length === filteredItems.length && filteredItems.length > 0) {
      setSelectedIds([]);
    } else {
      setSelectedIds(filteredItems.map(i => i.id));
    }
  };

  const toggleSelectOne = (id: string) => {
    if (selectedIds.includes(id)) {
      setSelectedIds(selectedIds.filter(i => i !== id));
    } else {
      setSelectedIds([...selectedIds, id]);
    }
  };

  const handleDiscoverRecipes = () => {
    if (selectedIds.length === 0) {
      alert(t('selectItemsFirstToDiscover', 'Please select at least one ingredient to discover recipes.'));
      return;
    }
    const selectedNames = pantryItems
      .filter(i => selectedIds.includes(i.id))
      .map(i => i.name.trim())
      .filter(Boolean);

    router.push(`/chef?ingredients=${encodeURIComponent(selectedNames.join(', '))}`);
  };

  const handleCameraScanUpload = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const files = e.target.files;
    if (files && files.length > 0) {
      router.push('/import?tab=image');
    }
  };

  const calculateDaysLeft = (dateStr: string) => {
    if (!dateStr) return null;
    const today = new Date();
    today.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
    const [y, m, d] = dateStr.split('-').map(Number);
    const target = new Date(y, m - 1, d);
    target.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
    const diffTime = target.getTime() - today.getTime();
    return Math.ceil(diffTime / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));
  };

  const getCleanCategoryString = (cat: any): string => {
    if (!cat) return 'Other';
    if (typeof cat === 'string') return cat;
    return cat.name || cat.title || cat.label || 'Other';
  };

  const filteredItems = pantryItems
    .filter(item => {
      const matchesSearch = !search.trim() || 
        item.name.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase().trim()) ||
        getCleanCategoryString(item.category).toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase().trim());
      
      const matchesCategory = selectedCategory === 'ALL' || 
        getCleanCategoryString(item.category).toLowerCase() === selectedCategory.toLowerCase();

      return matchesSearch && matchesCategory;
    })
    .sort((a, b) => {
      const res = a.name.localeCompare(b.name);
      return sortAsc ? res : -res;
    });

  return (
    <div 
      id="zecratary-pantry-canvas"
      role="region"
      aria-label={t('pantryInventory', 'Pantry Inventory')}

          transform: scale(1.15);
          opacity: 1;
        }
      `}} />

      {/* Hidden Camera Input for Environment Capture */}
      <input

        type="file"
        accept="image/*"

        className="hidden"

      {/* PAGE HEADER & TELEMETRY */}
      <div 
        className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-4 border-b pb-4"

          </h1>
          <p className="text-xs" style={{ color: 'var(--color-text-secondary)' }}>

            {t('pantrySubtitle', 'Manage available ingredients, track expiry dates, and discover matching recipes.')}
          </p>
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <button

              }

            className="border font-bold text-xs px-4 py-2.5 rounded-xl transition flex items-center justify-center gap-2 shadow-sm cursor-pointer"

          <button

            style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--color-primary)' }}
          >
            <Plus className="h-4 w-4" /> {t('addIngredientBtn', 'Add Ingredient(s)')}
          </button>

      {/* TOP CONTROLS & SEARCH */}
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-center gap-3 justify-between">

            onChange={(e) => setSearch(e.target.value)}
            className="w-full border rounded-2xl pl-11 pr-4 py-3 text-sm outline-none transition font-medium"
            style={{

                            backgroundColor: 'var(--color-inner-dark)',

                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="flex justify-end gap-3 pt-4 border-t" style={{ borderColor: 'var(--color-border)' }}>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setEditingItem(null)}
                  className="px-5 py-2.5 rounded-xl font-bold transition cursor-pointer"
                  style={{
                    backgroundColor: 'var(--color-inner-dark)',
                    color: 'var(--color-text-secondary)'
                  }}
                >
                  {t('cancel', 'Cancel')}
                </button>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => handleUpdateItem()}
                  className="px-6 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-white font-bold transition flex items-center gap-1.5 shadow-lg cursor-pointer hover:opacity-90"
                  style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--color-primary)' }}
                >
                  <Save className="h-4 w-4" /> {t('saveChanges', 'Save Changes')}
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```typescript
// @ts-nocheck
'use client';

import React, { useState, useEffect, useCallback, useMemo } from 'react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { 
  ShoppingCart, Plus, Trash2, Check, CheckSquare, 
  Search, Edit3, Copy, Bookmark, X, RefreshCw, 
  CheckCircle2, AlertCircle
} from 'lucide-react';
import { getCurrentUser, User, initAuthStorage } from '@/lib/auth';
import { useIngredientCategories, DEFAULT_CATEGORIES } from '@/lib/categories';
import { useTranslation } from '@/components/LanguageProvider';

interface ShoppingItem {
  id: string;
  userId: string;
  name: string;
  item?: string;
  amount: string;
  unit: string;
  category: string;
  staple: boolean;
  checked: boolean;
  recipeId?: string;
  recipeTitle?: string;
}

// Pure Category Name Normalizer: Extracts clean string names from primitives or entity objects
const getCategoryName = (cat: any): string => {
  if (!cat) return 'Produce';
  if (typeof cat === 'string') {
    const trimmed = cat.trim();
    if (trimmed === '[object Object]' || trimmed === '') return 'Produce';
    return trimmed;
  }
  if (typeof cat === 'object') {
    const candidate = cat.name || cat.label || cat.title || cat.slug || cat.id;
    if (typeof candidate === 'string' && candidate.trim() && candidate !== '[object Object]') {
      return candidate.trim();
    }
  }
  return 'Produce';
};

export default function ShoppingPage() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const [currentUser, setCurrentUser] = useState<User | null>(null);

  const [items, setItems] = useState<ShoppingItem[]>([]);
  const [search, setSearch] = useState<string>('');
  const [selectedCategory, setSelectedCategory] = useState<string>('All');
  const [filterStaplesOnly, setFilterStaplesOnly] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState<boolean>(true);
  const [toastMessage, setToastMessage] = useState<{ type: 'success' | 'error'; text: string } | null>(null);

  // Normalize remote category objects into deduplicated clean strings
  const remoteCategories = useIngredientCategories();
  const categoriesList = useMemo(() => {
    const source = Array.isArray(remoteCategories) && remoteCategories.length > 0 
      ? remoteCategories 
      : (Array.isArray(DEFAULT_CATEGORIES) && DEFAULT_CATEGORIES.length > 0 ? DEFAULT_CATEGORIES : []);
    
    const set = new Set<string>();
    const list: string[] = [];

    source.forEach((c: any) => {
      const name = getCategoryName(c);
      if (name && !set.has(name)) {
        set.add(name);
        list.push(name);
      }
    });

    return list.length > 0 
      ? list 
      : ['Produce', 'Meat & Seafood', 'Dairy & Eggs', 'Pantry Staples', 'Bakery', 'Frozen', 'Beverages', 'Condiments & Spices', 'Snacks', 'Other'];
  }, [remoteCategories]);

  const safeDefaultCategory = categoriesList[0] || 'Produce';

  // Category Translation Helper
  const getCategoryLabel = useCallback((cat: any): string => {
    const catName = getCategoryName(cat);
    const keyMap: Record<string, string> = {
      'Produce': 'catProduce',
      'Meat & Seafood': 'catMeatSeafood',
      'Dairy & Eggs': 'catDairyEggs',
      'Pantry Staples': 'catPantryStaples',
      'Bakery': 'catBakery',
      'Frozen': 'catFrozen',
      'Beverages': 'catBeverages',
      'Condiments & Spices': 'catCondimentsSpices',
      'Snacks': 'catSnacks',
      'Other': 'catOther'
    };
    const transKey = keyMap[catName];
    return transKey ? String(t(transKey, catName)) : catName;
  }, [t]);

  // Add Item Modal State (Form-Free Accessible Container)
  const [showAddModal, setShowAddModal] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [itemName, setItemName] = useState<string>('');
  const [itemAmount, setItemAmount] = useState<string>('1');
  const [itemUnit, setItemUnit] = useState<string>('pkg');
  const [itemCategory, setItemCategory] = useState<string>(safeDefaultCategory);
  const [itemStaple, setItemStaple] = useState<boolean>(false);

  // Edit Item Modal State
  const [editingItem, setEditingItem] = useState<ShoppingItem | null>(null);

  const showToast = (text: string, type: 'success' | 'error' = 'success') => {
    setToastMessage({ type, text });
    setTimeout(() => setToastMessage(null), 3500);
  };

  // 1. Non-destructive sync: merge server items with local items from /recipes
  const loadShoppingData = useCallback(async (user: User | null) => {
    const targetUserId = user?.id || 'usr_admin_1';
    setLoading(true);

    let localList: ShoppingItem[] = [];
    if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
      try {
        const raw = localStorage.getItem('zecratary_shopping_list') || localStorage.getItem('zecratary_shopping');
        if (raw) {
          const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
          if (Array.isArray(parsed)) {
            localList = parsed.map((i: any) => ({
              ...i,
              category: getCategoryName(i.category)
            }));
          }
        }
      } catch (_) {}
    }

    try {
      const res = await fetch(`/api/shopping?userId=${encodeURIComponent(targetUserId)}&t=${Date.now()}`, { cache: 'no-store' });
      if (res.ok) {
        const data = await res.json();
        if (Array.isArray(data.items)) {
          const serverItems: ShoppingItem[] = data.items.map((i: any) => ({
            ...i,
            category: getCategoryName(i.category)
          }));

          const serverIdSet = new Set(serverItems.map(i => i.id));
          // Preserve any locally staged items from /recipes that server hasn't committed yet
          const uncommittedLocal = localList.filter(i => !serverIdSet.has(i.id));
          const merged = [...serverItems, ...uncommittedLocal];

          setItems(merged);
          try {
            localStorage.setItem('zecratary_shopping_list', JSON.stringify(merged));
            localStorage.setItem('zecratary_shopping', JSON.stringify(merged));
          } catch (_) {}

          // If there were uncommitted items from /recipes, persist them to PostgreSQL in background
          if (uncommittedLocal.length > 0) {
            fetch('/api/shopping', {
              method: 'POST',
              headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
              body: JSON.stringify({ userId: targetUserId, items: uncommittedLocal })
            }).catch(() => {});
          }
          return;
        }
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('[ShoppingPage] Server fetch note:', e);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }

    // Fallback: render local cached list
    if (localList.length > 0) {
      setItems(localList);
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    document.title = `${t('shoppingListTitle', 'Interactive Shopping List')} - Zecratary`;
    initAuthStorage();
    const user = getCurrentUser();
    if (!user) {
      router.replace('/login');
      return;
    }
    setCurrentUser(user);
    loadShoppingData(user);

    const handleSync = (e: any) => {
      if (e?.detail?.source === 'local_mutation') return;
      const active = getCurrentUser();
      if (active) {
        setCurrentUser(active);
        loadShoppingData(active);
      }
    };

    window.addEventListener('zecratary_shopping_updated', handleSync);
    window.addEventListener('zecratary_shopping_list_updated', handleSync);
    window.addEventListener('storage', handleSync);
    window.addEventListener('zecratary_languages_updated', handleSync);
    window.addEventListener('zecratary_dictionary_updated', handleSync);
    window.addEventListener('zecratary_locale_changed', handleSync);
    window.addEventListener('zecratary_theme_mode_changed', handleSync);

    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('zecratary_shopping_updated', handleSync);
    window.removeEventListener('zecratary_shopping_list_updated', handleSync);
    window.removeEventListener('storage', handleSync);
      window.removeEventListener('zecratary_languages_updated', handleSync);
      window.removeEventListener('zecratary_dictionary_updated', handleSync);
      window.removeEventListener('zecratary_locale_changed', handleSync);
      window.removeEventListener('zecratary_theme_mode_changed', handleSync);
    };
  }, [loadShoppingData, router, t]);

  // Escape Key to Dismiss Open Modals
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.key === 'Escape') {
        setShowAddModal(false);
        setEditingItem(null);
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
  }, []);

  const saveItemsList = async (updatedList: ShoppingItem[], notifyOtherTabs = true) => {
    const sanitizedList = updatedList.map(item => ({
      ...item,
      category: getCategoryName(item.category)
    }));
    setItems(sanitizedList);
    const targetUserId = currentUser?.id || 'usr_admin_1';

    if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
      try {
        localStorage.setItem('zecratary_shopping_list', JSON.stringify(sanitizedList));
        localStorage.setItem('zecratary_shopping', JSON.stringify(sanitizedList));
      } catch (_) {}
    }

    try {
      await fetch('/api/shopping', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ userId: targetUserId, items: sanitizedList })
      });
    } catch (_) {}

    if (notifyOtherTabs) {
      window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('zecratary_shopping_updated', { detail: { source: 'local_mutation' } }));
    }
  };

  // Toggle Checkbox Item
  const handleToggleCheck = async (id: string) => {
    const target = items.find(i => i.id === id);
    if (!target) return;
    const nextVal = !target.checked;

    const updated = items.map(i => i.id === id ? { ...i, checked: nextVal, completed: nextVal } : i);
    await saveItemsList(updated, true);
  };

  // Add Item
  const handleAddItem = async () => {
    const activeUser = currentUser || getCurrentUser();
    if (!itemName.trim() || !activeUser) return;

    const chosenCategory = getCategoryName(itemCategory) || safeDefaultCategory;

    const newItem: ShoppingItem = {
      id: 'shop_' + Date.now().toString(36) + '_' + Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 6),
      userId: activeUser.id || 'usr_admin_1',
      name: itemName.trim(),
      amount: itemAmount.trim() || '1',
      unit: itemUnit.trim() || '',
      category: chosenCategory,
      staple: itemStaple,
      checked: false
    };

    const updated = [newItem, ...items];
    await saveItemsList(updated);

    setItemName('');
    setItemAmount('1');
    setItemUnit('pkg');
    setItemCategory(safeDefaultCategory);
    setItemStaple(false);
    setShowAddModal(false);
    showToast(t('itemAddedToast', 'Item added to your shopping list!'));
  };

  // Update Item
  const handleUpdateItem = async () => {
    if (!editingItem || !editingItem.name.trim()) return;

    const sanitizedEditingItem = {
      ...editingItem,
      category: getCategoryName(editingItem.category) || safeDefaultCategory
    };

    const updated = items.map(i => i.id === sanitizedEditingItem.id ? sanitizedEditingItem : i);
    await saveItemsList(updated);
    setEditingItem(null);
    showToast(t('itemUpdatedToast', 'Item updated successfully!'));
  };

  // Delete Single Item
  const handleDeleteItem = async (e: React.MouseEvent, id: string) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    if (!confirm(t('confirmDeleteItem', 'Are you sure you want to delete this item?'))) return;

    const updated = items.filter(i => i.id !== id);
    await saveItemsList(updated);

    try {
      await fetch(`/api/shopping?id=${encodeURIComponent(id)}`, { method: 'DELETE' });
    } catch (_) {}

    showToast(t('itemDeletedToast', 'Item removed from shopping list.'));
  };

  // Clear All Completed Items
  const handleClearCompleted = async () => {
    const completedItems = items.filter(i => i.checked);
    if (completedItems.length === 0) return;
    if (!confirm(t('confirmClearCompleted', 'Are you sure you want to clear all completed items?'))) return;

    const remaining = items.filter(i => !i.checked);
    await saveItemsList(remaining);

    try {
      await fetch('/api/shopping', {
        method: 'DELETE',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ action: 'remove_completed', ids: completedItems.map(i => i.id) })
      });
    } catch (_) {}

    showToast(t('completedClearedToast', 'Completed items cleared.'));
  };

  // Filtered Pipeline with Pure String Comparison
  const filteredActiveItems = useMemo(() => {
    return items.filter(i => {
      if (i.checked) return false;
      if (filterStaplesOnly && !i.staple) return false;
      const itemCat = getCategoryName(i.category);
      if (selectedCategory !== 'All' && itemCat !== selectedCategory) return false;
      if (search.trim()) {
        const q = search.toLowerCase().trim();
        return i.name.toLowerCase().includes(q) || itemCat.toLowerCase().includes(q);
      }
      return true;
    });
  }, [items, filterStaplesOnly, selectedCategory, search]);

  const filteredCompletedItems = useMemo(() => {
    return items.filter(i => {
      if (!i.checked) return false;
      if (filterStaplesOnly && !i.staple) return false;
      const itemCat = getCategoryName(i.category);
      if (selectedCategory !== 'All' && itemCat !== selectedCategory) return false;
      if (search.trim()) {
        const q = search.toLowerCase().trim();
        return i.name.toLowerCase().includes(q) || itemCat.toLowerCase().includes(q);
      }
      return true;
    });
  }, [items, filterStaplesOnly, selectedCategory, search]);

  // Scoped Toggle Complete All / Incomplete All for Currently Filtered View
  const handleToggleCompleteAll = async () => {
    const totalVisible = filteredActiveItems.length + filteredCompletedItems.length;
    if (totalVisible === 0) return;

    const allFilteredChecked = filteredActiveItems.length === 0;
    const nextVal = !allFilteredChecked;
    const targetIds = new Set([...filteredActiveItems, ...filteredCompletedItems].map(i => i.id));

    const updated = items.map(i => {
      if (targetIds.has(i.id)) {
        return { ...i, checked: nextVal, completed: nextVal };
      }
      return i;
    });

    await saveItemsList(updated);
    showToast(nextVal ? t('allCompletedToast', 'All items marked as completed!') : t('allIncompletedToast', 'All items marked as active.'));
  };

  // Copy Shopping List to Clipboard with Structured Fallback
  const handleCopyList = async () => {
    if (items.length === 0) return;

    let text = `🛒 ${t('shoppingListTitle', 'Interactive Shopping List')}\n\n`;

    const activeList = items.filter(i => !i.checked);
    if (activeList.length > 0) {
      const groups: Record<string, ShoppingItem[]> = {};
      activeList.forEach(item => {
        const cat = getCategoryName(item.category);
        if (!groups[cat]) groups[cat] = [];
        groups[cat].push(item);
      });

      for (const [cat, catItems] of Object.entries(groups)) {
        text += `📁 ${getCategoryLabel(cat)}:\n`;
        catItems.forEach(i => {
          text += `  • [ ] ${i.name} (${i.amount} ${i.unit})\n`;
        });
        text += '\n';
      }
    }

    const completedList = items.filter(i => i.checked);
    if (completedList.length > 0) {
      text += `✅ ${t('completedItemsHeading', 'Completed Items')}:\n`;
      completedList.forEach(i => {
        text += `  • [x] ${i.name} (${i.amount} ${i.unit})\n`;
      });
      text += '\n';
    }

    let success = false;
    try {
      if (navigator.clipboard && navigator.clipboard.writeText) {
        await navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
        success = true;
      }
    } catch (_) {}

    if (!success && typeof document !== 'undefined') {
      try {
        const textarea = document.createElement('textarea');
        textarea.value = text;
        textarea.style.position = 'fixed';
        textarea.style.opacity = '0';
        document.body.appendChild(textarea);
        textarea.select();
        document.execCommand('copy');
        document.body.removeChild(textarea);
        success = true;
      } catch (_) {}
    }

    if (success) {
      showToast(t('listCopiedToast', 'Shopping list copied to clipboard!'));
    } else {
      showToast(t('clipboardError', 'Clipboard access unavailable.'), 'error');
    }
  };

  // Group Active Items by Normalized Category String
  const groupedActiveItems = useMemo(() => {
    const groups: Record<string, ShoppingItem[]> = {};
    filteredActiveItems.forEach(item => {
      const cat = getCategoryName(item.category);
      if (!groups[cat]) groups[cat] = [];
      groups[cat].push({ ...item, category: cat });
    });
    return groups;
  }, [filteredActiveItems]);

  const totalActive = items.filter(i => !i.checked).length;
  const totalCompleted = items.filter(i => i.checked).length;

  return (
    <div 
      id="zecratary-shopping-canvas"
      role="region"
      aria-label={t('shoppingListTitle', 'Interactive Shopping List')}
      data-lpignore="true"
      className="w-full max-w-full px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 xl:px-10 space-y-6 pb-24 font-sans transition-colors duration-200"
      style={{ 
        width: '100%',
        maxWidth: '100%',
        boxSizing: 'border-box',
        color: 'var(--color-text)' 
      }}
    >
      {/* Dynamic Autofill Suppression Guardrail */}
      <style dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: `
        .shopping-input:-webkit-autofill,
        .shopping-input:-webkit-autofill:hover,
        .shopping-input:-webkit-autofill:focus,
        .shopping-input:-webkit-autofill:active {
          -webkit-box-shadow: 0 0 0 1000px var(--color-inner-dark, #0B101D) inset !important;
          box-shadow: 0 0 0 1000px var(--color-inner-dark, #0B101D) inset !important;
          -webkit-text-fill-color: var(--color-text, #ffffff) !important;
          caret-color: var(--color-text, #ffffff) !important;
          transition: background-color 50000s ease-in-out 0s !important;
        }
      `}} />

      {/* Toast Alert Banner */}
      {toastMessage && (
        <div 
          className="fixed top-20 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 z-50 px-5 py-2.5 rounded-2xl text-xs font-bold shadow-2xl flex items-center gap-2 animate-in fade-in slide-in-from-top-3 border"
          style={{
            backgroundColor: 'var(--color-card)',
            borderColor: toastMessage.type === 'success' ? 'var(--color-emerald)' : '#ef4444',
            color: 'var(--color-text)'
          }}
        >
          {toastMessage.type === 'success' ? (
            <CheckCircle2 className="h-4 w-4" style={{ color: 'var(--color-emerald)' }} />
          ) : (
            <AlertCircle className="h-4 w-4 text-red-500" />
          )}
          <span>{toastMessage.text}</span>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Top Header Bar */}
      <div 
        className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-4 border-b pb-4" 
        style={{ borderColor: 'var(--color-border)' }}
      >
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-black tracking-tight flex items-center gap-2" style={{ color: 'var(--color-primary)' }}>
            <ShoppingCart className="h-6 w-6" /> {t('shoppingListTitle', 'Interactive Shopping List')}
          </h1>
          <p className="text-xs" style={{ color: 'var(--color-text-secondary)' }}>
            {t('shoppingListSubtitle', 'Organize your grocery checklist by category and track purchased ingredients.')}
          </p>
        </div>

        {/* Toolbar Buttons */}
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2.5">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => loadShoppingData(currentUser)}
            disabled={loading}
            className="border font-bold text-xs px-3.5 py-2 rounded-xl transition flex items-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer shadow-xs disabled:opacity-50 hover:opacity-80"
            style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--color-inner-dark)', borderColor: 'var(--color-border)', color: 'var(--color-text)' }}
            title={t('reloadBtn', 'Reload')}
          >
            <RefreshCw className={`h-4 w-4 ${loading ? 'animate-spin' : ''}`} style={{ color: 'var(--color-primary)' }} />
          </button>

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={handleCopyList}
            disabled={items.length === 0}
            className="border font-bold text-xs px-3.5 py-2 rounded-xl transition flex items-center gap-1.5 shadow-xs cursor-pointer hover:opacity-80 disabled:opacity-40"
            style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--color-inner-dark)', borderColor: 'var(--color-border)', color: 'var(--color-text)' }}
          >
            <Copy className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
            <span>{t('exportListBtn', 'Copy List')}</span>
          </button>

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={handleToggleCompleteAll}
            disabled={items.length === 0}
            className="border font-bold text-xs px-3.5 py-2 rounded-xl transition flex items-center gap-1.5 shadow-xs cursor-pointer hover:opacity-80 disabled:opacity-40"
            style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--color-inner-dark)', borderColor: 'var(--color-border)', color: 'var(--color-text)' }}
          >
            <CheckSquare className="h-3.5 w-3.5" style={{ color: 'var(--color-emerald)' }} />
            <span>{filteredActiveItems.length === 0 && filteredCompletedItems.length > 0 ? t('incompleteAllBtn', 'Uncheck All') : t('completeAllBtn', 'Mark All Done')}</span>
          </button>

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => {
              setItemCategory(safeDefaultCategory);
              setShowAddModal(true);
            }}
            className="text-white font-bold text-xs px-4 py-2 rounded-xl transition flex items-center gap-1.5 shadow-lg cursor-pointer hover:opacity-90"
            style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--color-primary)' }}
          >
            <Plus className="h-4 w-4" />
            <span>{t('addItemBtn', 'Add Item')}</span>
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Search Bar & Category Filter Strip */}
      <div 
        role="region"
        data-lpignore="true"
        className="w-full max-w-full p-4 sm:p-5 rounded-3xl border space-y-3.5 shadow-sm transition-colors duration-200"
        style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--color-card)', borderColor: 'var(--color-border)', boxSizing: 'border-box' }}
      >
        <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-center gap-3">
          <div className="relative flex-1 w-full">
            <Search className="h-4 w-4 absolute left-3.5 top-3 pointer-events-none opacity-60" />
```

```typescript
// @ts-nocheck
'use client';

import { useState, useEffect, useCallback, useMemo, useRef } from 'react';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { 
  Calendar as CalendarIcon, ChevronLeft, ChevronRight, Plus, 
  Sparkles, Copy, Share2, ShoppingCart, Edit2, Trash2, Clock, 
  Utensils, CheckCircle2, AlertCircle, ShieldCheck, Lock, 
  ArrowRight, X, Flame
} from 'lucide-react';
import { getCurrentUser } from '@/lib/auth';
import { useTranslation } from '@/components/LanguageProvider';

interface PlannedMeal {
  id: string;
  userId: string;
  date: string;
  mealType: string;
  recipeId?: string;
  recipeName: string;
  time: string;
  servings: number;
  notes?: string;
  isLeftover?: boolean;
  calories?: number;
  protein?: number;
  carbs?: number;
  fat?: number;
}

interface SavedRecipe {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  name?: string;
  calories?: number;
  protein?: number;
  carbs?: number;
  fat?: number;
  ingredients?: any[];
}

const MEAL_TYPES = ['Breakfast', 'Lunch', 'Dinner', 'Snack'];

function formatISODate(d: Date): string {
  const year = d.getFullYear();
  const month = String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0');
  const day = String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');
  return `${year}-${month}-${day}`;
}

function getWeekDates(baseDate: Date): Date[] {
  const current = new Date(baseDate);
  const day = current.getDay();
  const diff = current.getDate() - day + (day === 0 ? -6 : 1);
  const monday = new Date(current.setDate(diff));

  const week: Date[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < 7; i++) {
    const nextDay = new Date(monday);
    nextDay.setDate(monday.getDate() + i);
    week.push(nextDay);
  }
  return week;
}

    const d = new Date();
    d.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
    return d;
  });

  const [savedRecipes, setSavedRecipes] = useState<SavedRecipe[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [toast, setToast] = useState<{ type: 'success' | 'error' | 'info'; message: string } | null>(null);
```
