export default function AdminSettingsPage() {
  const { t } = useTranslation();

  // Branding States
  const [siteName, setSiteName] = useState('Zecratary');
  const [siteTagline, setSiteTagline] = useState('Autonomous Culinary Intelligence & Precision Meal Planning');
  const [titlebarEmoji, setTitlebarEmoji] = useState('👨‍🍳');
  const [titlebarImage, setTitlebarImage] = useState('');
  const [faviconEmoji, setFaviconEmoji] = useState('👨‍🍳');
  const [faviconImage, setFaviconImage] = useState('');
  const [fontFamily, setFontFamily] = useState('Inter, sans-serif');

  // Basic SEO States (Task 3)
  const [metaDescription, setMetaDescription] = useState('Autonomous culinary intelligence, precision meal planning, and pantry inventory tracking.');
  const [metaKeywords, setMetaKeywords] = useState('culinary ai, recipe generator, meal planner, pantry management');
  const [metaAuthor, setMetaAuthor] = useState('Zecratary Culinary Intelligence Inc.');

  // Theme Elements Colors State (Multi-Element Variation)
  const [themeColors, setThemeColors] = useState({
    primary: '#E05638',
    primaryHover: '#c94529',
    accentEmerald: '#10b981',
    background: '#070b13',
    card: '#0d131f',
    innerDark: '#080d16',
    border: '#1a2234',
    text: '#ffffff',
    textSecondary: '#94a3b8'
  });

  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<'branding' | 'theme' | 'seo' | 'typography'>('branding');
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [uploadingTitlebar, setUploadingTitlebar] = useState(false);
  const [uploadingFavicon, setUploadingFavicon] = useState(false);
  const [status, setStatus] = useState<{ type: 'success' | 'error'; msg: string } | null>(null);

  const titlebarFileInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const faviconFileInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);

  // Dynamic Header Title String: <Display Name> - <Tagline> (Task 2)
  const dynamicHeaderTitle = `${siteName.trim() || DEFAULT_SITE_NAME} - ${siteTagline.trim() || DEFAULT_SITE_TAGLINE}`;

  // Synchronize document.title dynamically
  useEffect(() => {
    document.title = dynamicHeaderTitle;
  }, [dynamicHeaderTitle]);

  // Apply theme custom properties to document root dynamically
  const applyThemeVariables = useCallback((colors: typeof themeColors, font?: string) => {
    if (typeof document === 'undefined') return;
    const root = document.documentElement;
    if (colors.primary) root.style.setProperty('--color-primary', colors.primary);
    if (colors.primaryHover) root.style.setProperty('--color-primary-hover', colors.primaryHover);
    if (colors.accentEmerald) {
      root.style.setProperty('--color-emerald', colors.accentEmerald);
      root.style.setProperty('--color-accent', colors.accentEmerald);
    }
    if (colors.background) root.style.setProperty('--color-bg', colors.background);
    if (colors.card) root.style.setProperty('--color-card', colors.card);
    if (colors.innerDark) root.style.setProperty('--color-inner-dark', colors.innerDark);
    if (colors.border) root.style.setProperty('--color-border', colors.border);
    if (colors.text) root.style.setProperty('--color-text', colors.text);
    if (colors.textSecondary) root.style.setProperty('--color-text-secondary', colors.textSecondary);
    if (font) root.style.setProperty('--font-custom', font);
  }, []);

  const loadSettings = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      const data = await fetchSiteConfig();
      if (data) {
        if (data.siteName) setSiteName(data.siteName);
        if (data.siteTagline || data.tagline) setSiteTagline(data.siteTagline || data.tagline || '');
        if (data.titlebarEmoji) setTitlebarEmoji(data.titlebarEmoji);
        if (data.titlebarImage) setTitlebarImage(data.titlebarImage);
        if (data.faviconEmoji) setFaviconEmoji(data.faviconEmoji);
        if (data.faviconImage) setFaviconImage(data.faviconImage);
        if (data.fontFamily) setFontFamily(data.fontFamily);
        if (data.metaDescription) setMetaDescription(data.metaDescription);
        if (data.metaKeywords) setMetaKeywords(data.metaKeywords);
        if (data.metaAuthor) setMetaAuthor(data.metaAuthor);
      }

      const res = await fetch(`/api/admin/settings?t=${Date.now()}`, { cache: 'no-store' });
      if (res.ok) {
        const json = await res.json();
        const s = json.settings || json;
        const colors = s.themeColors || s.theme_colors;
        if (colors) {
          const merged = { ...PRESET_THEMES[0], ...colors };
          setThemeColors(merged);
          applyThemeVariables(merged, s.fontFamily || s.font_family);
        }
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn('Failed to load admin settings:', err);
    }
  }, [applyThemeVariables]);

  useEffect(() => {
    loadSettings();

    const handleSync = () => loadSettings();
    window.addEventListener('zecratary_site_config_updated', handleSync);
    window.addEventListener('zecratary_site_settings_changed', handleSync);
    window.addEventListener('storage', handleSync);

    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('zecratary_site_config_updated', handleSync);
      window.removeEventListener('zecratary_site_settings_changed', handleSync);
      window.removeEventListener('storage', handleSync);
    };
  }, [loadSettings]);

  // Handle Logo & Favicon File Uploads
  const handleFileUpload = async (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>, type: 'titlebar' | 'favicon') => {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0];
    if (!file) return;

    if (type === 'titlebar') setUploadingTitlebar(true);
    else setUploadingFavicon(true);
    setStatus(null);

    try {
      const formData = new FormData();
      formData.append('file', file);
      formData.append('type', type);

      const res = await fetch('/api/admin/upload-branding', {
        method: 'POST',
        body: formData
      });

      if (res.ok) {
        const data = await res.json();
        const publicUrl = data.url;

        if (type === 'titlebar') {
          setTitlebarImage(publicUrl);
          await saveSiteConfig({ titlebarImage: publicUrl, titlebar_image: publicUrl });
        } else {
          setFaviconImage(publicUrl);
          updateFavicon(publicUrl);
          await saveSiteConfig({ faviconImage: publicUrl, favicon_image: publicUrl });
        }
        setStatus({
          type: 'success',
          msg: `${type === 'titlebar' ? 'Brand logo' : 'Favicon'} uploaded successfully!`
        });
      } else {
        // Fallback to local Base64 data URL
        const reader = new FileReader();
        reader.onload = () => {
          const base64 = reader.result as string;
          if (type === 'titlebar') {
            setTitlebarImage(base64);
          } else {
            setFaviconImage(base64);
            updateFavicon(base64);
          }
        };
        reader.readAsDataURL(file);
      }
    } catch (uploadErr) {
      // Offline / fallback Base64
      const reader = new FileReader();
      reader.onload = () => {
        const base64 = reader.result as string;
        if (type === 'titlebar') setTitlebarImage(base64);
        else {
          setFaviconImage(base64);
          updateFavicon(base64);
        }
      };
      reader.readAsDataURL(file);
    } finally {
      if (type === 'titlebar') setUploadingTitlebar(false);
      else setUploadingFavicon(false);
      e.target.value = '';
    }
  };

  const handleRevertToEmoji = (type: 'titlebar' | 'favicon') => {
    if (type === 'titlebar') {
      setTitlebarImage('');
    } else {
      setFaviconImage('');
      updateFavicon(faviconEmoji || DEFAULT_FAVICON_EMOJI);
    }
    if (titlebarFileInputRef.current) titlebarFileInputRef.current.value = '';
    if (faviconFileInputRef.current) faviconFileInputRef.current.value = '';
  };

  const handleColorChange = (key: keyof typeof themeColors, val: string) => {
    const updated = { ...themeColors, [key]: val };
    setThemeColors(updated);
    applyThemeVariables(updated, fontFamily);
  };

  const handleSelectPresetTheme = (theme: typeof PRESET_THEMES[0]) => {
    setThemeColors(theme);
    applyThemeVariables(theme, fontFamily);
  };

  const handleSave = async () => {
    setSaving(true);
    setStatus(null);

    const payload = {
      siteName: siteName.trim() || DEFAULT_SITE_NAME,
      site_name: siteName.trim() || DEFAULT_SITE_NAME,
      siteTagline: siteTagline.trim() || DEFAULT_SITE_TAGLINE,
      site_tagline: siteTagline.trim() || DEFAULT_SITE_TAGLINE,
      tagline: siteTagline.trim() || DEFAULT_SITE_TAGLINE,
      titlebarEmoji,
      titlebar_emoji: titlebarEmoji,
      titlebarImage,
      titlebar_image: titlebarImage,
      faviconEmoji,
      favicon_emoji: faviconEmoji,
      faviconImage,
      favicon_image: faviconImage,
      fontFamily,
      font_family: fontFamily,
      themeColors,
      theme_colors: themeColors,
      metaDescription: metaDescription.trim(),
      meta_description: metaDescription.trim(),
      metaKeywords: metaKeywords.trim(),
      meta_keywords: metaKeywords.trim(),
      metaAuthor: metaAuthor.trim(),
      meta_author: metaAuthor.trim()
    };

    try {
      const res = await fetch('/api/admin/settings', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify(payload)
      });

      if (!res.ok) throw new Error('Failed to save settings to server.');

      await saveSiteConfig(payload);
      applyThemeVariables(themeColors, fontFamily);

      setStatus({
        type: 'success',
        msg: t('adminSettingsSaved', 'Settings Saved & Broadcasted!')
      });
    } catch (err: any) {
      setStatus({
        type: 'error',
        msg: err.message || 'Error occurred while saving settings.'
      });
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  };

  const handleResetDefaults = () => {
    setSiteName(DEFAULT_SITE_NAME);
    setSiteTagline(DEFAULT_SITE_TAGLINE);
    setTitlebarEmoji(DEFAULT_TITLEBAR_EMOJI);
    setTitlebarImage('');
    setFaviconEmoji(DEFAULT_FAVICON_EMOJI);
    setFaviconImage('');
    setFontFamily(DEFAULT_FONT_FAMILY);
    setMetaDescription('Autonomous culinary intelligence, precision meal planning, and pantry inventory tracking.');
    setMetaKeywords('culinary ai, recipe generator, meal planner, pantry management');
    setMetaAuthor('Zecratary Culinary Intelligence Inc.');
    handleSelectPresetTheme(PRESET_THEMES[0]);
    updateFavicon(DEFAULT_FAVICON_EMOJI);
  };

  return (
    <div 
      id="zecratary-admin-canvas"
      role="region"
      data-lpignore="true"
      className="w-full max-w-full px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 xl:px-10 pb-24 font-sans transition-colors duration-200"
      style={{ 
        boxSizing: 'border-box',
        color: 'var(--color-text)'
      }}
    >
      {/* Hidden File Inputs for Brand Logo and Favicon */}
      <input
        ref={titlebarFileInputRef}
        type="file"
        accept="image/png,image/jpeg,image/svg+xml,image/webp"
        className="hidden"
        onChange={(e) => handleFileUpload(e, 'titlebar')}
      />
      <input
        ref={faviconFileInputRef}
        type="file"
        accept="image/png,image/svg+xml,image/x-icon,image/vnd.microsoft.icon"
        className="hidden"
        onChange={(e) => handleFileUpload(e, 'favicon')}
      />

      {/* Dynamic Header: <Display Name> - <Tagline> (Task 2) */}
      <div 
        className="flex flex-col lg:flex-row lg:items-center justify-between gap-4 border-b pb-5 pt-2 mb-6"
        style={{ borderColor: 'var(--color-border)' }}
      >
        <div className="space-y-1">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            {titlebarImage ? (
              <img 
                src={titlebarImage} 
                alt="Logo" 
                className="w-9 h-9 object-contain rounded-xl border p-1 shadow-sm shrink-0"
                style={{ borderColor: 'var(--color-border)', backgroundColor: 'var(--color-card)' }}
              />
            ) : (
              <span className="text-3xl shrink-0">{titlebarEmoji || '👨‍🍳'}</span>
            )}
            <h1 className="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-black tracking-tight" style={{ color: 'var(--color-primary)' }}>
              {dynamicHeaderTitle}
            </h1>
          </div>
          <p className="text-xs font-medium" style={{ color: 'var(--color-text-secondary)' }}>
            {t('adminSiteSettingsTitle', 'Site Settings & Identity')} • {t('adminHeaderTitleFormatDesc', 'Every page header title dynamically synchronizes to <Display Name> - <Tagline>')}
          </p>
        </div>

        {/* Global Save and Reset Actions */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={handleResetDefaults}
            className="px-4 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold border transition flex items-center gap-2 cursor-pointer hover:opacity-80"
            style={{ 
              backgroundColor: 'var(--color-inner-dark)', 
              borderColor: 'var(--color-border)', 
              color: 'var(--color-text-secondary)' 
            }}
          >
            <RotateCcw className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
            <span>Reset Defaults</span>
          </button>

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={handleSave}
            disabled={saving}
            className="px-5 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold text-white transition flex items-center gap-2 shadow-lg cursor-pointer hover:opacity-90 disabled:opacity-50"
            style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--color-primary)' }}
          >
            <Save className={`h-4 w-4 ${saving ? 'animate-spin' : ''}`} />
            <span>{saving ? t('adminSaving', 'Saving...') : t('adminSaveSettings', 'Save Settings')}</span>
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Status Toast */}
      {status && (
        <div
          className="mb-6 p-4 rounded-2xl border text-xs font-semibold flex items-center gap-2 animate-in fade-in"
          style={{
            backgroundColor: 'var(--color-inner-dark)',
            borderColor: status.type === 'success' ? 'var(--color-emerald)' : 'rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.4)',
            color: status.type === 'success' ? 'var(--color-emerald)' : '#ef4444'
          }}
        >
          {status.type === 'success' ? (
            <CheckCircle2 className="h-4 w-4 shrink-0" style={{ color: 'var(--color-emerald)' }} />
          ) : (
            <AlertCircle className="h-4 w-4 shrink-0 text-red-500" />
          )}
          <span>{status.msg}</span>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Navigation Sub-Tabs */}
      <div 
        className="flex p-1.5 rounded-2xl border mb-6 transition-colors duration-200 overflow-x-auto"
        style={{
          backgroundColor: 'var(--color-inner-dark)',
          borderColor: 'var(--color-border)'
        }}
      >
        {[
          { id: 'branding', label: 'Identity & Brand Upload', icon: Sparkles },
          { id: 'theme', label: 'Theme & Element Colors', icon: Palette },
          { id: 'seo', label: 'Basic SEO & Meta', icon: Search },
          { id: 'typography', label: 'Global Typography', icon: Type }
        ].map((tab) => {
          const isActive = activeTab === tab.id;
          return (
            <button
              key={tab.id}
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setActiveTab(tab.id as any)}
              className="flex-1 min-w-[140px] py-3 text-xs font-bold rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center gap-2 transition cursor-pointer"
              style={isActive ? {
                backgroundColor: 'var(--color-card)',
                color: 'var(--color-primary)',
                borderColor: 'var(--color-primary)',
                borderWidth: '1px',
                boxShadow: '0 4px 6px -1px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1)'
              } : {
                color: 'var(--color-text-secondary)'
              }}
            >
              <tab.icon className="h-4 w-4" />
              <span>{tab.label}</span>
            </button>
          );
        })}
      </div>

      {/* TAB 1: IDENTITY & BRAND LOGO UPLOAD (RESTORED & ENHANCED) */}
      {activeTab === 'branding' && (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-6">
          <div 
            role="region"
            data-lpignore="true"
            className="rounded-3xl p-6 border shadow-xl space-y-6 transition-colors duration-200"
            style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--color-card)', borderColor: 'var(--color-border)' }}
          >
            <h2 className="text-sm font-black uppercase tracking-wider flex items-center gap-2" style={{ color: 'var(--color-primary)' }}>
              <Sparkles className="h-4 w-4" /> Application Identity & Naming
            </h2>

            {/* Display Name Input */}
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-bold mb-1.5" style={{ color: 'var(--color-text)' }}>
                Application Display Name *
              </label>
              <input
                type="text"
                autoComplete="off"
                data-lpignore="true"
                data-form-type="other"
                spellCheck="false"
                value={siteName}
                onChange={(e) => setSiteName(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="e.g. Zecratary"
                className="w-full border rounded-xl px-4 py-3 text-sm outline-none font-semibold transition"
                style={{
                  backgroundColor: 'var(--color-inner-dark)',
                  borderColor: 'var(--color-border)',
                  color: 'var(--color-text)'
                }}
                onFocus={(e) => (e.currentTarget.style.borderColor = 'var(--color-primary)')}
                onBlur={(e) => (e.currentTarget.style.borderColor = 'var(--color-border)')}
              />
            </div>

            {/* Application Tagline & Subtitle */}

              <div className="text-base font-semibold hover:underline cursor-pointer text-[#1a0dab] leading-snug">
                {dynamicHeaderTitle}
              </div>

              <div className="text-xs text-[#4d5156] leading-relaxed">
                {metaDescription || 'Autonomous culinary intelligence, precision meal planning, and pantry inventory tracking.'}
              </div>
            </div>

            <div 
              className="p-4 rounded-2xl border text-xs space-y-2"
              style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--color-inner-dark)', borderColor: 'var(--color-border)' }}
            >
              <div className="font-bold flex items-center gap-1.5" style={{ color: 'var(--color-primary)' }}>
                <ShieldCheck className="h-4 w-4" /> SEO Indexing Guardrail
              </div>
              <p className="text-[11px] leading-relaxed" style={{ color: 'var(--color-text-secondary)' }}>
                These values are persisted to PostgreSQL `admin_settings`, synchronized to server configuration caches, and consumed by Next.js `generateMetadata()` for search crawlers and social OpenGraph tags.
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* TAB 4: GLOBAL TYPOGRAPHY */}
      {activeTab === 'typography' && (
        <div 
          role="region"
          data-lpignore="true"
          className="rounded-3xl p-6 border shadow-xl space-y-5 transition-colors duration-200 max-w-2xl"
          style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--color-card)', borderColor: 'var(--color-border)' }}
        >
          <h2 className="text-sm font-black uppercase tracking-wider flex items-center gap-2" style={{ color: 'var(--color-primary)' }}>
            <Type className="h-4 w-4" /> Global Typography
          </h2>

          <div className="space-y-3">
            {FONT_OPTIONS.map((f) => (
              <div
                key={f.id}
                onClick={() => {
                  setFontFamily(f.id);
                  applyThemeVariables(themeColors, f.id);
                }}
                className="p-3.5 rounded-2xl border flex items-center justify-between cursor-pointer transition"
                style={{
                  backgroundColor: 'var(--color-inner-dark)',
                  borderColor: fontFamily === f.id ? 'var(--color-primary)' : 'var(--color-border)'
                }}
              >
                <div style={{ fontFamily: f.id }}>
                  <div className="text-xs font-bold" style={{ color: 'var(--color-text)' }}>{f.label}</div>
                  <div className="text-[11px] opacity-70">Sphinx of black quartz, judge my vow.</div>
                </div>
                {fontFamily === f.id && (
                  <CheckCircle2 className="h-4 w-4" style={{ color: 'var(--color-primary)' }} />
                )}
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

  const [host, setHost] = useState('localhost');
  const [port, setPort] = useState('5432');
  const [dbName, setDbName] = useState('zecratary');
  const [username, setUsername] = useState('postgres');
  const [password, setPassword] = useState('postgres');
  const [showPassword, setShowPassword] = useState(false);

  const updateGranularToUri = (h: string, p: string, db: string, u: string, pwd: string, type: 'postgresql' | 'mysql') => {
    if (type === 'postgresql') {
      const auth = u ? (pwd ? `${u}:${encodeURIComponent(pwd)}@` : `${u}@`) : '';
      setLocalhostUri(`postgresql://${auth}${h}:${p}/${db}?schema=public`);
    } else {
      const auth = u ? (pwd ? `${u}:${encodeURIComponent(pwd)}@` : `${u}@`) : '';
      setLocalhostUri(`mysql://${auth}${h}:${p}/${db}`);
    }
  };

  // Load Database Telemetry & Settings
  const loadDatabaseData = useCallback(async () => {
    if (isSavingRef.current) return;
    try {
      setLoading(true);
      const res = await fetch(`/api/admin/database?t=${Date.now()}`, { cache: 'no-store' });
      if (res.ok) {
        const data = await res.json();
        setConnectionStatus(data.status || 'disconnected');
        if (data.activeProfile) setActiveProfile(data.activeProfile);
        if (data.latency) setLatency(data.latency);
        if (data.engine) setEngine(data.engine);
        if (data.errorMessage) {
          setErrorMessage(data.errorMessage);
          setErrorCode(data.errorCode || 'SOCKET_ERROR');
        } else {
          setErrorMessage(null);
          setErrorCode(null);
        }

        if (data.config) {
          if (data.config.postgresUri && data.engine !== 'mysql') setLocalhostUri(data.config.postgresUri);
          if (data.config.mysqlUri && data.engine === 'mysql') setLocalhostUri(data.config.mysqlUri);
          if (data.config.supabaseUrl) setSupabaseUrl(data.config.supabaseUrl);
          if (data.config.supabaseAnonKey) setSupabaseAnonKey(data.config.supabaseAnonKey);
          if (data.config.supabaseServiceKey) setSupabaseServiceKey(data.config.supabaseServiceKey);
          if (data.config.supabasePoolerUri) setSupabasePoolerUri(data.config.supabasePoolerUri);
        }

        if (data.telemetry) setTelemetry(data.telemetry);
        if (Array.isArray(data.tables)) setTables(data.tables);
      }

                      ))}
                    </tbody>

        {/* Status Notification Toast Banner */}
        {toast && (

              color: toast.type === 'success' ? 'var(--color-emerald)' : '#ef4444'
            }}
          >
            {toast.type === 'success' ? (
              <CheckCircle2 className="h-4 w-4 shrink-0" style={{ color: 'var(--color-emerald)' }} />
            ) : (
              <AlertCircle className="h-4 w-4 shrink-0 text-red-500" />
            )}
            <span>{toast.message}</span>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

      if (res.ok) {
        const data = await res.json();
        if (data.walletSettings || data.settings) {
          const loaded = data.walletSettings || data.settings;
          setSettings({
            currency: loaded.currency || 'USD',
            isEnabled: loaded.isEnabled !== undefined ? Boolean(loaded.isEnabled) : true,
            allowPurchases: loaded.allowPurchases !== undefined ? Boolean(loaded.allowPurchases) : true,
            minTopup: Number(loaded.minTopup ?? loaded.min_topup ?? 5),
            maxTopup: Number(loaded.maxTopup ?? loaded.max_topup ?? 1000),
            presetAmounts: Array.isArray(loaded.presetAmounts) ? loaded.presetAmounts : DEFAULT_SETTINGS.presetAmounts,
            bonusRules: Array.isArray(loaded.bonusRules) ? loaded.bonusRules : DEFAULT_SETTINGS.bonusRules,
            ledgerColumns: loaded.ledgerColumns || DEFAULT_SETTINGS.ledgerColumns
          });
        }
        if (Array.isArray(data.users)) setUsers(data.users);
        if (Array.isArray(data.transactions)) setTransactions(data.transactions);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn('[Wallet Settings] Using local configuration defaults:', err);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
      isFetchingRef.current = false;
    }
  }, []);

  // Theme & Data Synchronization Listeners
  useEffect(() => {
    document.title = `${tr('walletSettingsDocTitle', 'Wallet Settings - Admin Console')}`;
    loadWalletData();

    const handleSync = () => loadWalletData();
    window.addEventListener('zecratary_wallet_updated', handleSync);
    window.addEventListener('zecratary_payment_updated', handleSync);
    window.addEventListener('zecratary_languages_updated', handleSync);
    window.addEventListener('zecratary_dictionary_updated', handleSync);
    window.addEventListener('zecratary_locale_changed', handleSync);
    window.addEventListener('zecratary_theme_mode_changed', handleSync);
    window.addEventListener('zecratary_theme_changed', handleSync);
    window.addEventListener('zecratary_theme_updated', handleSync);
    window.addEventListener('storage', handleSync);

    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('zecratary_wallet_updated', handleSync);
      window.removeEventListener('zecratary_payment_updated', handleSync);
      window.removeEventListener('zecratary_languages_updated', handleSync);
      window.removeEventListener('zecratary_dictionary_updated', handleSync);
      window.removeEventListener('zecratary_locale_changed', handleSync);
      window.removeEventListener('zecratary_theme_mode_changed', handleSync);
      window.removeEventListener('zecratary_theme_changed', handleSync);
      window.removeEventListener('zecratary_theme_updated', handleSync);
      window.removeEventListener('storage', handleSync);
    };
  }, [loadWalletData, tr]);

  // Click-Outside & Escape Dismissal for Column Popover
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!showColumnsPopover) return;
    const handleClickOutside = (e: MouseEvent) => {
      if (columnsPopoverRef.current && !columnsPopoverRef.current.contains(e.target as Node)) {
        setShowColumnsPopover(false);
      }
    };
    const handleKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.key === 'Escape') setShowColumnsPopover(false);
    };
    document.addEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
    document.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
      document.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    };
  }, [showColumnsPopover]);

  // Save Settings to Database
  const handleSaveSettings = async () => {
    if (saving || isSavingRef.current) return;
    setSaving(true);
    isSavingRef.current = true;
    setFeedback(null);

    try {
      const res = await fetch('/api/admin/wallet-settings', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          action: 'save_settings',
          walletSettings: settings
        })
      });

      const data = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
      if (res.ok && data.success) {
        if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
          window.dispatchEvent(new Event('zecratary_wallet_updated'));
          window.dispatchEvent(new Event('zecratary_payment_updated'));
          localStorage.setItem('zecratary_wallet_updated_at', Date.now().toString());
        }
        showToast('success', tr('toastWalletSaved', 'Wallet configurations saved and synchronized with PostgreSQL & MySQL!'));
      } else {
        throw new Error(data.error || 'Failed to save configurations.');
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      showToast('error', err.message || 'Error saving wallet settings.');
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
      setTimeout(() => { isSavingRef.current = false; }, 300);
    }
  };

  const handleResetDefaults = () => {
    if (!confirm(tr('confirmResetDefaults', 'Reset wallet settings and bonus rules to default values?'))) return;
    setSettings(DEFAULT_SETTINGS);
    showToast('success', tr('toastWalletReset', 'Wallet settings reset to defaults successfully!'));
  };

  // Add Preset Amount
  const handleAddPreset = () => {
    const val = parseInt(newPresetValue, 10);
    if (isNaN(val) || val <= 0) return;
    if (settings.presetAmounts.includes(val)) {
      setNewPresetValue('');
      return;
    }
    const updated = [...settings.presetAmounts, val].sort((a, b) => a - b);
    setSettings({ ...settings, presetAmounts: updated });
    setNewPresetValue('');
  };

  const handleRemovePreset = (val: number) => {
    if (settings.presetAmounts.length <= 1) {
      showToast('error', tr('errMinOnePreset', 'You must retain at least one quick deposit preset.'));
      return;
    }
    setSettings({
      ...settings,
      presetAmounts: settings.presetAmounts.filter(p => p !== val)
    });
  };

  // Add Bonus Rule
  const handleAddBonusRule = () => {
    const thresh = parseFloat(newTierThreshold);
    const pct = parseFloat(newTierBonus);
    if (isNaN(thresh) || thresh <= 0 || isNaN(pct) || pct <= 0) {
      showToast('error', tr('errInvalidBonusTier', 'Please enter valid numbers for deposit threshold and bonus percentage.'));
      return;
    }

    const newRule: BonusRule = { threshold: thresh, bonus_percent: pct };
    const updated = [...settings.bonusRules.filter(r => r.threshold !== thresh), newRule].sort((a, b) => a.threshold - b.threshold);
    setSettings({ ...settings, bonusRules: updated });
    setNewTierThreshold('');
    setNewTierBonus('');
  };

  const handleRemoveBonusRule = (thresh: number) => {
    setSettings({
      ...settings,
      bonusRules: settings.bonusRules.filter(r => r.threshold !== thresh)
    });
  };

  // Apply Manual Balance Adjustment
  const handleApplyAdjustment = async () => {
    if (!adjustEmail) {
      showToast('error', tr('errSelectCustomer', 'Please choose a customer from the dropdown list.'));
      return;
    }
    const amt = parseFloat(adjustAmount);
    if (isNaN(amt) || amt <= 0) {
      showToast('error', tr('errValidAmount', 'Please enter a valid positive adjustment amount.'));
      return;
    }
    if (!adjustReason.trim()) {
      showToast('error', tr('errReasonRequired', 'Please enter an administrative reason or note for this adjustment.'));
      return;
    }

    setApplyingAdjustment(true);
    try {
      const res = await fetch('/api/admin/wallet-settings', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          action: 'manual_adjustment',
          email: adjustEmail,
          amount: amt,
          isDebit: adjustType === 'debit',
          reason: adjustReason.trim()
        })
      });

      const data = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
      if (res.ok && data.success) {
        showToast('success', tr('toastAdjustmentSuccess', 'Balance adjustment applied successfully!')
          .replace('{amount}', `${adjustType === 'debit' ? '-' : '+'}${activeCurrencySymbol}${amt.toFixed(2)}`)
          .replace('{email}', adjustEmail));
        setAdjustReason('');
        loadWalletData();
        window.dispatchEvent(new Event('zecratary_wallet_updated'));
      } else {
        throw new Error(data.error || 'Failed to apply balance adjustment.');
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      showToast('error', err.message || 'Error executing balance adjustment.');
    } finally {
      setApplyingAdjustment(false);
    }
  };

  // Delete Transactions (Single or Batch)
  const handleDeleteTransactions = async (idsToDelete: string[]) => {
    if (idsToDelete.length === 0) return;
    const promptMsg = idsToDelete.length > 1
      ? tr('confirmDeleteSelected', 'Are you sure you want to delete {count} selected transaction record(s)? This cannot be undone.').replace('{count}', String(idsToDelete.length))
      : tr('confirmDeleteSingle', 'Are you sure you want to delete this transaction record? This cannot be undone.');

    if (!confirm(promptMsg)) return;

    try {
      const res = await fetch('/api/admin/wallet-settings', {
        method: 'DELETE',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ ids: idsToDelete })
      });

      const data = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
      if (res.ok && data.success) {
        setTransactions(prev => prev.filter(t => !idsToDelete.includes(t.id)));
        setSelectedTxIds(prev => prev.filter(id => !idsToDelete.includes(id)));
        showToast('success', tr('toastDeleteSuccess', 'Transaction record(s) deleted successfully.'));
        window.dispatchEvent(new Event('zecratary_wallet_updated'));
      } else {
        throw new Error(data.error || 'Failed to delete transactions.');
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      showToast('error', err.message || 'Error deleting transactions.');
    }
  };

  // Column Visibility Handlers
  const toggleColumn = (colKey: string) => {
    const currentCols = settings.ledgerColumns || DEFAULT_SETTINGS.ledgerColumns;
    const activeCols = Object.values(currentCols).filter(Boolean).length;
    if (currentCols[colKey] && activeCols <= 1) return;

    const updatedCols = {
      ...currentCols,
      [colKey]: !currentCols[colKey]
    };
    setSettings({ ...settings, ledgerColumns: updatedCols });
  };

  // Filtered & Paginated Ledger Slices
  const filteredTransactions = useMemo(() => {
    return transactions.filter(t => {
      if (typeFilter !== 'all' && (t.type || '').toLowerCase() !== typeFilter.toLowerCase()) return false;
      if (search.trim()) {
        const q = search.toLowerCase().trim();
        const mEmail = (t.customer_email || '').toLowerCase().includes(q);
        const mName = (t.customer_name || '').toLowerCase().includes(q);
        const mDesc = (t.description || '').toLowerCase().includes(q);
        const mId = (t.id || '').toLowerCase().includes(q);
        if (!mEmail && !mName && !mDesc && !mId) return false;
      }
      return true;
    });
  }, [transactions, search, typeFilter]);

  const totalPages = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(filteredTransactions.length / rowsPerPage));
  const startIndex = (currentPage - 1) * rowsPerPage;
  const paginatedTxs = filteredTransactions.slice(startIndex, startIndex + rowsPerPage);

  // Checkbox Selection Helpers
  const isAllOnPageSelected = paginatedTxs.length > 0 && paginatedTxs.every(t => selectedTxIds.includes(t.id));
  const isIndeterminate = paginatedTxs.some(t => selectedTxIds.includes(t.id)) && !isAllOnPageSelected;

  const handleToggleSelectAll = () => {
    const pageIds = paginatedTxs.map(t => t.id);
    if (isAllOnPageSelected) {
      setSelectedTxIds(prev => prev.filter(id => !pageIds.includes(id)));
    } else {
      setSelectedTxIds(prev => Array.from(new Set([...prev, ...pageIds])));
    }
  };

  const toggleSelectTx = (id: string) => {
    setSelectedTxIds(prev => prev.includes(id) ? prev.filter(x => x !== id) : [...prev, id]);
  };

  const activeColumnsCount = 1 + Object.values(settings.ledgerColumns || DEFAULT_SETTINGS.ledgerColumns).filter(Boolean).length;

  return (
    <div 
      className="w-full max-w-full px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 xl:px-10 space-y-6 pb-24 pt-2 font-sans transition-colors duration-200"
      style={{ color: 'var(--color-text)' }}
    >
      {/* Scoped Autofill Guardrail Style */}
      <style jsx global>{`
        .wallet-input:-webkit-autofill,
        .wallet-input:-webkit-autofill:hover,
        .wallet-input:-webkit-autofill:focus {
          -webkit-text-fill-color: var(--color-text) !important;
          -webkit-box-shadow: 0 0 0px 1000px var(--color-inner-dark) inset !important;
          box-shadow: 0 0 0px 1000px var(--color-inner-dark) inset !important;
          transition: background-color 5000s ease-in-out 0s;
        }
      `}</style>

      {/* 1. Header & Quick Actions */}
      <div 
        className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-4 border-b pb-4" 
        style={{ borderColor: 'var(--color-border)' }}
      >
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-black tracking-tight flex items-center gap-2" style={{ color: 'var(--color-primary)' }}>
            <Wallet className="h-6 w-6" style={{ color: 'var(--color-primary)' }} />
            {tr('walletSettingsTitle', 'Store Wallet & Financial Configurations')}
          </h1>
          <p className="text-xs" style={{ color: 'var(--color-text-secondary)' }}>
            {tr('walletSettingsSubtitle', 'Configure store credit top-up boundaries, bonus incentives, customer balance adjustments, and audit transaction ledgers.')}
          </p>
        </div>

        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2.5">
          <div 
            className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl border text-[11px] font-bold shadow-sm"
            style={{ 
              backgroundColor: 'var(--color-inner-dark)', 
              borderColor: 'var(--color-border)', 
              color: 'var(--color-text)' 
            }}
          >
            <Database className="h-3.5 w-3.5" style={{ color: 'var(--color-emerald, #10b981)' }} />
            <span>{tr('syncStatusPostgres', 'Synced with PostgreSQL & MySQL')}</span>
          </div>

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={loadWalletData}
            disabled={loading}
            className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-xl border text-xs font-bold transition hover:opacity-80 cursor-pointer shadow-sm disabled:opacity-50"
            style={{ 
              backgroundColor: 'var(--color-inner-dark)', 
              borderColor: 'var(--color-border)',
              color: 'var(--color-text)'
            }}
          >
            <RefreshCw className={`h-3.5 w-3.5 ${loading ? 'animate-spin' : ''}`} />
            <span>{tr('btnReload', 'Reload')}</span>
          </button>

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={handleResetDefaults}
            className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-xl border text-xs font-bold transition hover:opacity-80 cursor-pointer shadow-sm"
            style={{ 
              backgroundColor: 'var(--color-inner-dark)', 
              borderColor: 'var(--color-border)',
              color: 'var(--color-text-secondary)'
            }}
          >
            <span>{tr('btnResetDefaults', 'Reset Defaults')}</span>
          </button>

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={handleSaveSettings}
            disabled={saving}
            className="flex items-center gap-2 px-5 py-1.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold text-white shadow-lg transition hover:opacity-90 cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-50"
            style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--color-primary)' }}
          >
            <Save className={`h-4 w-4 ${saving ? 'animate-spin' : ''}`} />
            <span>{saving ? tr('btnSaving', 'Saving...') : tr('btnSaveWalletConfig', 'Save Wallet Configurations')}</span>
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Feedback Toast Banner */}
      {feedback && (
        <div
          className="p-3.5 rounded-2xl text-xs font-semibold flex items-center gap-2 border shadow-sm animate-in fade-in"
          style={{
            backgroundColor: 'var(--color-inner-dark)',
            borderColor: feedback.type === 'success' ? 'var(--color-emerald, #10b981)' : '#ef4444',
            color: feedback.type === 'success' ? 'var(--color-emerald, #10b981)' : '#ef4444'
          }}
        >
          {feedback.type === 'success' ? (
            <CheckCircle2 className="h-4 w-4 shrink-0" style={{ color: 'var(--color-emerald, #10b981)' }} />
          ) : (
            <AlertCircle className="h-4 w-4 shrink-0 text-red-500" />
          )}
          <span>{feedback.msg}</span>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* 2. Wallet Engine Monitor & Cross-Module Shortcuts */}
      <div 
        className="p-3.5 px-4 rounded-2xl border flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 text-xs shadow-xs transition-colors duration-200"
        style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--color-card)', borderColor: 'var(--color-border)' }}
      >
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5 font-bold" style={{ color: 'var(--color-text)' }}>
            <Activity className="h-4 w-4 text-emerald-500 animate-pulse" />
            {tr('walletMonitorHeading', 'Wallet Engine Monitor')}
          </span>
          <span 
            className="font-bold px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] border shadow-xs"
            style={{
              backgroundColor: 'var(--color-inner-dark)',
              borderColor: settings.isEnabled ? 'var(--color-emerald, #10b981)' : '#ef4444',
              color: settings.isEnabled ? 'var(--color-emerald, #10b981)' : '#ef4444'
            }}
          >
            {settings.isEnabled ? tr('walletStatusEnabled', 'System Active') : tr('walletStatusDisabled', 'System Disabled')}
          </span>
        </div>

        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-4 font-semibold text-[11px]" style={{ color: 'var(--color-text-secondary)' }}>
          <div>
            {tr('walletActiveCurrency', 'Store Currency:')}{' '}
            <span className="font-bold" style={{ color: 'var(--color-text)' }}>
              {settings.currency} ({activeCurrencySymbol})
            </span>
          </div>
          <div>
            {tr('walletActiveBonusTiers', 'Bonus Tiers:')}{' '}
            <span className="font-bold font-mono" style={{ color: 'var(--color-primary)' }}>
              {settings.bonusRules.length} Tiers Active
            </span>
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 pl-2 border-l" style={{ borderColor: 'var(--color-border)' }}>
            <Link
              href="/admin/payment-gateway"
              className="flex items-center gap-1 text-[11px] font-bold hover:underline"
              style={{ color: 'var(--color-primary)' }}
            >
              <CreditCard className="h-3 w-3" />
              <span>{tr('navPaymentGateways', 'Payment Gateways')}</span>
              <ExternalLink className="h-2.5 w-2.5" />
            </Link>

            <span className="opacity-40">•</span>

            <Link
              href="/wallet"
              className="flex items-center gap-1 text-[11px] font-bold hover:underline"
              style={{ color: 'var(--color-primary)' }}
            >
              <Wallet className="h-3 w-3" />
              <span>{tr('navViewStoreWallet', 'Store Wallet Portal')}</span>
              <ExternalLink className="h-2.5 w-2.5" />
            </Link>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* 3. Workspace Sub-Tabs */}
      <div 
        className="flex p-1.5 rounded-2xl border transition-colors duration-200"
        style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--color-inner-dark)', borderColor: 'var(--color-border)' }}
      >
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => setActiveTab('config')}
          className="flex-1 py-2.5 text-xs font-bold rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center gap-2 transition cursor-pointer"
          style={activeTab === 'config' ? {
            backgroundColor: 'var(--color-card)',
            color: 'var(--color-primary)',
            borderColor: 'var(--color-primary)',
            borderWidth: '1px',
            boxShadow: '0 4px 6px -1px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1)'
          } : { color: 'var(--color-text-secondary)' }}
        >
          <Sliders className="h-4 w-4" />
          <span>{tr('tabWalletConfig', 'Configuration & Rules')}</span>
        </button>

        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => setActiveTab('ledger')}
          className="flex-1 py-2.5 text-xs font-bold rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center gap-2 transition cursor-pointer"
          style={activeTab === 'ledger' ? {
            backgroundColor: 'var(--color-card)',
            color: 'var(--color-primary)',
            borderColor: 'var(--color-primary)',
            borderWidth: '1px',
            boxShadow: '0 4px 6px -1px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1)'
          } : { color: 'var(--color-text-secondary)' }}
        >
          <History className="h-4 w-4" />
          <span>{tr('tabWalletLedger', 'Wallet Transactions Ledger')}</span>
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* TAB 1: CONFIGURATION & RULES */}
      {activeTab === 'config' && (
        <div 
          role="region"
          aria-label={tr('walletRegionConfig', 'Wallet Configuration and Rules')}
          className="space-y-6"
        >
          {/* Section 1: General Wallet Controls */}
          <div 
            className="p-6 rounded-3xl border shadow-sm space-y-5 transition-colors duration-200"
            style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--color-card)', borderColor: 'var(--color-border)' }}
          >
            <div className="border-b pb-3" style={{ borderColor: 'var(--color-border)' }}>
              <h2 className="text-sm font-bold flex items-center gap-2" style={{ color: 'var(--color-text)' }}>
                <Wallet className="h-4 w-4" style={{ color: 'var(--color-primary)' }} />
                {tr('generalControlsHeading', 'General Wallet Controls')}
              </h2>
              <p className="text-xs" style={{ color: 'var(--color-text-secondary)' }}>
                {tr('generalControlsDesc', 'Toggle store credit operations, spending permissions, and currency parameters.')}
              </p>
            </div>

            {/* Slide Button Switch Controls */}
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
              <div 
                className="p-4 rounded-2xl border flex items-center justify-between"
                style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--color-inner-dark)', borderColor: 'var(--color-border)' }}
              >
                <div className="pr-3">
                  <span className="font-bold text-xs block" style={{ color: 'var(--color-text)' }}>
                    {tr('enableWalletLabel', 'Enable Wallet System')}
                  </span>
                  <span className="text-[11px]" style={{ color: 'var(--color-text-secondary)' }}>
                    {tr('enableWalletDesc', 'Allow customers to hold store credit and top up balances.')}
                  </span>
                </div>

                <button
                  type="button"
                  role="switch"
                  aria-checked={settings.isEnabled}
                  onClick={() => setSettings({ ...settings, isEnabled: !settings.isEnabled })}
                  className="relative inline-flex h-6 w-11 shrink-0 cursor-pointer rounded-full border-2 border-transparent transition-colors duration-300 ease-in-out"
                  style={{ backgroundColor: settings.isEnabled ? 'var(--color-primary)' : 'var(--color-border)' }}
                >
                  <span
                    aria-hidden="true"
                    className={`pointer-events-none inline-block h-5 w-5 transform rounded-full bg-white shadow-md transition duration-300 ease-in-out ${
                      settings.isEnabled ? 'translate-x-5' : 'translate-x-0'
                    }`}
                  />
                </button>
              </div>

              <div 
                className="p-4 rounded-2xl border flex items-center justify-between"
                style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--color-inner-dark)', borderColor: 'var(--color-border)' }}
              >
                <div className="pr-3">
                  <span className="font-bold text-xs block" style={{ color: 'var(--color-text)' }}>
                    {tr('allowPurchasesLabel', 'Allow Balance for Purchases')}
                  </span>
                  <span className="text-[11px]" style={{ color: 'var(--color-text-secondary)' }}>
                    {tr('allowPurchasesDesc', 'Permit spending store wallet credits on recipe plans, tokens, and store items.')}
                  </span>
                </div>

                <button
                  type="button"
                  role="switch"
                  aria-checked={settings.allowPurchases}
                  onClick={() => setSettings({ ...settings, allowPurchases: !settings.allowPurchases })}
                  className="relative inline-flex h-6 w-11 shrink-0 cursor-pointer rounded-full border-2 border-transparent transition-colors duration-300 ease-in-out"
                  style={{ backgroundColor: settings.allowPurchases ? 'var(--color-primary)' : 'var(--color-border)' }}
                >
                  <span
                    aria-hidden="true"
                    className={`pointer-events-none inline-block h-5 w-5 transform rounded-full bg-white shadow-md transition duration-300 ease-in-out ${
                      settings.allowPurchases ? 'translate-x-5' : 'translate-x-0'
                    }`}
                  />
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Currency & Min/Max Deposit Caps */}
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-4 text-xs font-mono pt-1">
              <div>
                <label className="block font-bold mb-1.5 font-sans" style={{ color: 'var(--color-text)' }}>
                  {tr('processingCurrencyLabel', 'Processing Currency')}
                </label>
                <select
                  value={settings.currency}
                  onChange={(e) => setSettings({ ...settings, currency: e.target.value })}

                  style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--color-inner-dark)', borderColor: 'var(--color-border)', color: 'var(--color-text)' }}

                </label>
                <input

                  style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--color-inner-dark)', borderColor: 'var(--color-border)', color: 'var(--color-text)' }}
                />
              </div>

                    <span>{activeCurrencySymbol}{preset}</span>
                    <button

                      onClick={() => handleRemovePreset(preset)}
                      className="text-red-400 hover:text-red-300 transition cursor-pointer p-0.5"

                      <X className="h-3 w-3" />
                    </button>
                  </div>

                    style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--color-inner-dark)', borderColor: 'var(--color-border)', color: 'var(--color-text)' }}
                  />
                  <button
                    type="button"

                    style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--color-inner-dark)', borderColor: 'var(--color-primary)', color: 'var(--color-primary)' }}
                  >
                    {tr('btnAddPreset', '+ Add Preset')}
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

              <p className="text-xs" style={{ color: 'var(--color-text-secondary)' }}>
                {tr('bonusTiersDesc', 'Reward customers with bonus credit percentages based on deposit thresholds.')}
              </p>
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-3">
              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-3">

                    style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--color-inner-dark)', borderColor: 'var(--color-border)' }}

                      <div className="font-bold text-xs" style={{ color: 'var(--color-text)' }}>

                      <Trash2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                    </button>
                  </div>

                  <input

                    data-lpignore="true"

                    style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--color-card)', borderColor: 'var(--color-border)', color: 'var(--color-text)' }}
                  />
                </div>

                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={handleAddBonusRule}
                  className="px-4 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold text-white shadow transition hover:opacity-90 flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer"
                  style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--color-primary)' }}
                >
                  <Plus className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                  <span>{tr('btnAddBonusTier', '+ Add Bonus Tier')}</span>
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Section 3: Manual Customer Balance Adjustment */}
          <div 
            className="p-6 rounded-3xl border shadow-sm space-y-4 transition-colors duration-200"
            style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--color-card)', borderColor: 'var(--color-border)' }}

            <div className="border-b pb-3" style={{ borderColor: 'var(--color-border)' }}>

                <Coins className="h-4 w-4" style={{ color: 'var(--color-primary)' }} />
