                }}
              >
                <ShieldCheck className={`h-4 w-4 ${verifyingStripe ? 'animate-spin' : ''}`} />
                <span>{verifyingStripe ? tr('verifying', 'Verifying...') : tr('verifyStripeKey', 'Verify Stripe Key')}</span>
              </button>

              <span className={`px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full text-[10px] font-black uppercase border ${config.stripeKeysVerified ? 'bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-400 border-emerald-500/30' : 'bg-amber-500/10 text-amber-400 border-amber-500/30'}`}>
                {config.stripeKeysVerified ? tr('keysVerified', 'Keys Verified') : tr('keysUnverified', 'Keys Unverified')}
              </span>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Stripe Sandbox Mode Switch */}
          <div 
            className="p-4 rounded-2xl border flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-start sm:items-center justify-between gap-3"
            style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--color-inner-dark)', borderColor: 'var(--color-border)' }}
          >
            <div>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <span className="text-xs font-bold">{tr('stripeSandboxTitle', 'Stripe Sandbox (Test Mode)')}</span>
                <span className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-mono border ${normalizeBool(config.stripe.testMode) ? 'bg-amber-500/10 text-amber-400 border-amber-500/30' : 'bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-400 border-emerald-500/30'}`}>
                  {normalizeBool(config.stripe.testMode) ? 'SANDBOX ACTIVE' : 'LIVE PRODUCTION'}
                </span>
              </div>
              <p className="text-[11px] opacity-70 mt-0.5">
                {tr('stripeSandboxDesc', 'Process payments against Stripe Test API using test credit cards.')}
              </p>
            </div>

            <button
              type="button"
              role="switch"
              aria-checked={normalizeBool(config.stripe.testMode)}
              onClick={handleToggleStripeSandbox}
              className={`relative inline-flex h-6 w-11 shrink-0 cursor-pointer rounded-full border-2 border-transparent transition-colors duration-200 ease-in-out focus:outline-none shadow-md ${
                normalizeBool(config.stripe.testMode) ? 'bg-[#f59e0b]' : 'bg-slate-300 dark:bg-slate-700'
              }`}
            >
              <span
                aria-hidden="true"
                className={`pointer-events-none inline-block h-5 w-5 transform rounded-full bg-white shadow-md ring-0 transition duration-200 ease-in-out ${
                  normalizeBool(config.stripe.testMode) ? 'translate-x-5' : 'translate-x-0'
                }`}
              />
            </button>
          </div>

          {normalizeBool(config.stripe.testMode) && config.stripe.secretKey && !config.stripe.secretKey.startsWith('sk_test_') && (
            <div 
              className="p-3.5 rounded-2xl border flex items-start gap-2.5 text-xs font-semibold shadow-xs"
              style={{ backgroundColor: 'rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.08)', borderColor: '#f59e0b', color: '#fbbf24' }}
            >
              <AlertTriangle className="h-4 w-4 shrink-0 mt-0.5 text-amber-500" />
              <div>
                <div className="font-bold">{tr('testKeyMismatchAlert', 'Stripe Test Mode Key Alert')}</div>
                <div className="text-[11px] font-normal opacity-90 mt-0.5 leading-relaxed">
                  {tr('testKeyMismatchDesc', "Sandbox Test Mode is active, but your Secret Key does not start with 'sk_test_'. Payments will fail until valid test keys are entered.")}
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {normalizeBool(config.stripe.testMode) && (
            <div 
              className="p-3.5 rounded-2xl border space-y-1.5"
              style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--color-inner-dark)', borderColor: 'var(--color-border)' }}
            >
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <span className="font-bold text-xs flex items-center gap-1.5 text-amber-400">
                  <CreditCard className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                  {tr('sandboxTestCard', 'Stripe Test Card Helper')}
                </span>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => handleCopy('4242424242424242', 'test_card')}
                  className="text-[10px] font-mono px-2 py-0.5 rounded border flex items-center gap-1 cursor-pointer hover:opacity-80"
                  style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--color-card)', borderColor: 'var(--color-border)', color: 'var(--color-text)' }}
                >
                  <Copy className="h-2.5 w-2.5" />
                  <span>{copiedCliKey === 'test_card' ? tr('copiedBtn', 'Copied!') : tr('copyBtn', 'Copy Card')}</span>
                </button>
              </div>
              <p className="text-[11px] leading-relaxed" style={{ color: 'var(--color-text-secondary)' }}>
                Use card number <code className="px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded font-mono font-bold text-[11px] border">4242 4242 4242 4242</code>, {tr('testCardMeta', 'Any future MM/YY and any 3-digit CVC (e.g. 123)')}.
              </p>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Credential Inputs */}
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4 text-xs">
            <div>
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-1">
                <label className="font-bold">Publishable Key *</label>
                {config.stripeKeysVerified && (
                  <span className="text-[10px] font-bold text-emerald-400 flex items-center gap-1">
                    <Check className="h-3 w-3" /> Verified
                  </span>
                )}
              </div>
              <div className="relative">
                <input
                  type={visibleFields['stripePublishable'] ? 'text' : 'password'}
                  autoComplete="off"
                  data-lpignore="true"
                  data-form-type="other"
                  spellCheck="false"
                  value={config.stripe.publishableKey}
                  onChange={(e) => setConfig({ ...config, stripe: { ...config.stripe, publishableKey: e.target.value } })}
                  placeholder="pk_test_... or pk_live_..."
                  className="w-full px-3 py-2.5 pr-10 rounded-xl border font-mono outline-none"
                  style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--color-inner-dark)', borderColor: 'var(--color-border)', color: 'var(--color-text)' }}
                />
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => toggleVisibility('stripePublishable')}
                  className="absolute right-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 opacity-60 hover:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"
                >
                  {visibleFields['stripePublishable'] ? <EyeOff className="h-4 w-4" /> : <Eye className="h-4 w-4" />}
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>

                        </td>

                    ) : (
                      filteredManualTransactions.map(tx => {
                        const s = (tx.status || '').toLowerCase();

                        const isApproved = s === 'succeeded' || s === 'approved' || s === 'completed';
                        const ref = tx.transfer_reference || tx.transferReference || '—';

                        return (
                          <tr key={tx.id} className="transition hover:opacity-90">
                            <td className="px-4 py-3.5 font-mono text-[11px] font-bold">
                              {tx.id}

                            </td>
                            <td className="px-4 py-3.5 font-mono text-[11px]">
                              {ref}
                            </td>
                            <td className="px-4 py-3.5">
                              {isPending ? (
                                <span className="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full text-[10px] font-black uppercase bg-amber-500/10 text-amber-400 border border-amber-500/30 flex items-center gap-1 w-fit">
                                  <Clock className="h-3 w-3 animate-spin" />
                                  <span>Pending</span>
                                </span>
                              ) : isApproved ? (
                                <span className="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full text-[10px] font-black uppercase bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-400 border border-emerald-500/30 flex items-center gap-1 w-fit">
                                  <Check className="h-3 w-3" />
                                  <span>Approved</span>
                                </span>
                              ) : (
                                <span className="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full text-[10px] font-black uppercase bg-rose-500/10 text-rose-400 border border-rose-500/30 flex items-center gap-1 w-fit">
                                  <X className="h-3 w-3" />
                                  <span>Rejected</span>
                                </span>
                              )}
                            </td>
                            <td className="px-4 py-3.5 text-right">
                              <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-1.5">
                                <button
                                  type="button"
                                  onClick={() => setViewTx(tx)}
                                  className="p-1.5 rounded-lg border transition shadow-xs cursor-pointer hover:opacity-80"
                                  style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--color-card)', borderColor: 'var(--color-border)', color: 'var(--color-text)' }}
                                  title={tr('btnView', 'View Details')}
                                >
                                  <Eye className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                                </button>
                                <button
                                  type="button"
                                  onClick={() => handleOpenEdit(tx)}
                                  className="p-1.5 rounded-lg border transition shadow-xs cursor-pointer hover:opacity-80"
                                  style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--color-card)', borderColor: 'var(--color-border)', color: 'var(--color-text)' }}
                                  title={tr('btnEdit', 'Edit Transaction')}
                                >
                                  <Edit3 className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-blue-400" />
                                </button>
                                {isPending && (
                                  <>
                                    <button
                                      type="button"
                                      disabled={actionLoadingId === tx.id}
                                      onClick={() => handleApprovePayment(tx)}
                                      className="p-1.5 rounded-lg border transition shadow-xs cursor-pointer hover:opacity-80 bg-emerald-500/10 border-emerald-500/30 text-emerald-400"
                                      title={tr('btnApprove', 'Approve & Credit')}

                                    </button>

                                      type="button"
                                      disabled={actionLoadingId === tx.id}
                                      onClick={() => handleRejectPayment(tx)}

                                      title={tr('btnReject', 'Reject')}
                                    >
                                      <XCircle className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                                    </button>
                                  </>
                                )}
                                <button
                                  type="button"
                                  disabled={actionLoadingId === tx.id}
                                  onClick={() => handleDeleteTransaction(tx.id)}
                                  className="p-1.5 rounded-lg border transition shadow-xs cursor-pointer hover:opacity-80 text-rose-400 border-rose-500/30 bg-rose-500/10"
                                  title={tr('btnDelete', 'Delete Record')}
                                >
                                  <Trash2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                                </button>
                              </div>
                            </td>
                          </tr>
                        );
                      })
                    )}
                  </tbody>
                </table>
              </div>

                    style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--color-inner-dark)', borderColor: 'var(--color-border)' }}
                  />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label className="font-bold block mb-1">Status</label>
                  <select
                    value={editForm.status}
                    onChange={(e) => setEditForm({ ...editForm, status: e.target.value })}
                    className="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-xl border outline-none font-bold cursor-pointer"
                    style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--color-inner-dark)', borderColor: 'var(--color-border)' }}
                  >
                    <option value="pending">Pending</option>
                    <option value="succeeded">Succeeded / Approved</option>
                    <option value="rejected">Rejected</option>
                  </select>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="font-bold block mb-1">Transfer Reference</label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={editForm.transfer_reference}
                  onChange={(e) => setEditForm({ ...editForm, transfer_reference: e.target.value })}
                  className="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-xl border outline-none font-mono"
                  style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--color-inner-dark)', borderColor: 'var(--color-border)' }}
                />
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="font-bold block mb-1">Admin Notes</label>
                <textarea
                  rows={2}
                  value={editForm.notes}
                  onChange={(e) => setEditForm({ ...editForm, notes: e.target.value })}
                  className="w-full p-2.5 rounded-xl border outline-none"
                  style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--color-inner-dark)', borderColor: 'var(--color-border)' }}
                />
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-2 pt-3 border-t" style={{ borderColor: 'var(--color-border)' }}>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setEditTx(null)}
                className="px-4 py-1.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold border cursor-pointer"
                style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--color-inner-dark)', borderColor: 'var(--color-border)' }}
              >
                Cancel
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                disabled={isSavingEdit}
                onClick={handleSaveEdit}
                className="px-4 py-1.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold text-white cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-50"
                style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--color-primary)' }}
              >
                {isSavingEdit ? 'Saving...' : 'Save Changes'}
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Floating Status Feedback Toast */}
      {feedback && (
        <div 
          className="fixed bottom-6 right-6 p-4 rounded-2xl border text-xs font-semibold flex items-center gap-2.5 shadow-2xl z-50 animate-in slide-in-from-bottom-5"
          style={{
            backgroundColor: 'var(--color-card)',
            borderColor: feedback.type === 'success' ? 'var(--color-emerald, #10b981)' : 'rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.4)',
            color: feedback.type === 'success' ? 'var(--color-emerald, #10b981)' : '#ef4444'
          }}
        >
          {feedback.type === 'success' ? <CheckCircle2 className="h-4 w-4 shrink-0" /> : <AlertCircle className="h-4 w-4 shrink-0" />}
          <span>{feedback.msg}</span>
          <button 
            type="button" 
            onClick={() => setFeedback(null)} 
            className="ml-2 opacity-60 hover:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"
          >
            ✕
          </button>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

// @ts-nocheck
'use client';

import { useState, useEffect, useMemo, useCallback } from 'react';
import { 
  Globe, Plus, Edit2, Trash2, Check, RefreshCw, 
  Search, CheckCircle2, AlertCircle, ShieldAlert,
  ArrowRightLeft, Sparkles, Database, FileText
} from 'lucide-react';
import { useTranslation } from '@/components/LanguageProvider';

interface LanguageItem {
  id: string;
  code: string;
  name: string;
  native: string;
  nativeName?: string;
  flag: string;
  direction: 'ltr' | 'rtl';
  status: 'active' | 'inactive';
  is_default: boolean;
  isDefault?: boolean;
}

export default function AdminLanguagePage() {
  const { t, locale, setLocale } = useTranslation();
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<'languages' | 'words'>('languages');
  
  const [languages, setLanguages] = useState<LanguageItem[]>([]);
  const [translations, setTranslations] = useState<Record<string, Record<string, string>>>({});
  const [defaultLanguage, setDefaultLanguage] = useState('en');
  
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [status, setStatus] = useState<{ type: 'success' | 'error'; msg: string } | null>(null);

  // Translation words filter & pagination
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('');
  const [selectedWordLocale, setSelectedWordLocale] = useState('en');

  // Language Edit / Add Modal
  const [isModalOpen, setIsModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [modalMode, setModalMode] = useState<'add' | 'edit'>('add');
  const [editingLang, setEditingLang] = useState<LanguageItem>({
    id: '',
    code: '',
    name: '',
    native: '',
    flag: '🌐',
    direction: 'ltr',
    status: 'active',
    is_default: false
  });

  // Translation Word Add Modal
  const [isWordModalOpen, setIsWordModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [newKey, setNewKey] = useState('');
  const [newVal, setNewVal] = useState('');

  // Fetch languages & dictionary from API
  const fetchLanguageData = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      setLoading(true);
      const res = await fetch(`/api/admin/languages?t=${Date.now()}`, { cache: 'no-store' });
      if (res.ok) {
        const data = await res.json();
        const rawLangs = data.supportedLanguages || data.languages || [];
        
        // Defensive normalization for string-or-object languages
        const cleanLangs: LanguageItem[] = rawLangs.map((l: any, idx: number) => {
          if (typeof l === 'string') {
            return {
              id: `lang_${l}`,
              code: l.toLowerCase(),
              name: l.toUpperCase(),
              native: l.toUpperCase(),
              flag: '🌐',
              direction: 'ltr',
              status: 'active',
              is_default: l.toLowerCase() === 'en'
            };
          }
          return {
            id: l.id || `lang_${l.code || idx}`,
            code: (l.code || '').toLowerCase(),
            name: l.name || (l.code || '').toUpperCase(),
            native: l.native || l.nativeName || l.name || '',
            flag: l.flag || '🌐',
            direction: l.direction || 'ltr',
            status: l.status === 'active' ? 'active' : 'inactive',
            is_default: Boolean(l.is_default ?? l.isDefault)
          };
        });

        setLanguages(cleanLangs);
        if (data.translations && typeof data.translations === 'object') {
          setTranslations(data.translations);
        }
        if (data.defaultLanguage) {
          setDefaultLanguage(data.defaultLanguage);
        }
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.warn('Notice loading language data:', err);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchLanguageData();

    const handleSync = () => fetchLanguageData();
    window.addEventListener('zecratary_languages_updated', handleSync);
    window.addEventListener('zecratary_dictionary_updated', handleSync);
    window.addEventListener('storage', handleSync);

    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('zecratary_languages_updated', handleSync);
      window.removeEventListener('zecratary_dictionary_updated', handleSync);
      window.removeEventListener('storage', handleSync);
    };
  }, [fetchLanguageData]);

  const activeCount = useMemo(() => {
    return languages.filter(l => l.status === 'active').length;
  }, [languages]);

  // Total unique phrases across all dictionaries
  const allPhraseKeys = useMemo(() => {
    const keys = new Set<string>();
    Object.values(translations).forEach(dict => {
      if (dict && typeof dict === 'object') {
        Object.keys(dict).forEach(k => keys.add(k));
      }
    });
    return Array.from(keys);
  }, [translations]);

  // Filtered phrase keys for search
  const filteredPhraseKeys = useMemo(() => {
    if (!searchQuery.trim()) return allPhraseKeys;
    const q = searchQuery.toLowerCase();
    return allPhraseKeys.filter(k => {
      if (k.toLowerCase().includes(q)) return true;
      const val = translations[selectedWordLocale]?.[k] || '';
      return val.toLowerCase().includes(q);
    });
  }, [allPhraseKeys, searchQuery, translations, selectedWordLocale]);

  // Save changes to API & PostgreSQL
  const handleSaveChanges = async () => {
    try {
      setSaving(true);
      setStatus(null);

      const res = await fetch('/api/admin/languages', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          supportedLanguages: languages,
          translations,
          defaultLanguage
        })
      });

      if (!res.ok) throw new Error('Failed to save language settings.');

      window.dispatchEvent(new Event('zecratary_languages_updated'));
      window.dispatchEvent(new Event('zecratary_dictionary_updated'));
      window.dispatchEvent(new Event('storage'));

      setStatus({ type: 'success', msg: t('settingsSavedToast', 'Language settings saved & broadcasted successfully!') });
    } catch (err: any) {
      setStatus({ type: 'error', msg: err.message || 'Error saving changes.' });
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  };

  const handleToggleStatus = (code: string) => {
    setLanguages(prev => prev.map(l => {
      if (l.code === code) {
        if (l.is_default) return l; // Default locale must remain active
        return { ...l, status: l.status === 'active' ? 'inactive' : 'active' };
      }
      return l;
    }));
  };

  const handleSetDefault = (code: string) => {
    setDefaultLanguage(code);
    setLanguages(prev => prev.map(l => ({
      ...l,
      is_default: l.code === code,
      isDefault: l.code === code,
      status: l.code === code ? 'active' : l.status
    })));
  };

  const handleDeleteLanguage = (code: string) => {
    const target = languages.find(l => l.code === code);
    if (target?.is_default) {
      alert('Cannot delete the default system language.');
      return;
    }
    setLanguages(prev => prev.filter(l => l.code !== code));
  };

  const handleSaveLanguageModal = () => {
    if (!editingLang.code.trim() || !editingLang.name.trim()) {
      alert('Language code and name are required.');
      return;
    }

    if (modalMode === 'add') {
      const code = editingLang.code.trim().toLowerCase();
      if (languages.some(l => l.code === code)) {
        alert('A language with this code already exists.');
        return;
      }
      setLanguages(prev => [...prev, {
        ...editingLang,
        id: `lang_${code}`,
        code,
        native: editingLang.native || editingLang.name
      }]);
    } else {
      setLanguages(prev => prev.map(l => l.code === editingLang.code ? { ...editingLang } : l));
    }

    setIsModalOpen(false);
  };

  const handleAddTranslationWord = () => {
    if (!newKey.trim()) return;
    const key = newKey.trim();
    setTranslations(prev => {
      const updated = { ...prev };
      if (!updated[selectedWordLocale]) updated[selectedWordLocale] = {};
      updated[selectedWordLocale][key] = newVal.trim() || key;
      return updated;
    });
    setNewKey('');
    setNewVal('');
    setIsWordModalOpen(false);
  };

  return (
    <div 
      className="max-w-6xl mx-auto space-y-6 pb-24 px-4 font-sans transition-colors duration-200"
      style={{ color: 'var(--color-text)' }}
    >
      {/* Top Header & Telemetry Badges */}
      <div 
        className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-4 border-b pb-4" 
        style={{ borderColor: 'var(--color-border)' }}
      >
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-black tracking-tight flex items-center gap-2" style={{ color: 'var(--color-primary)' }}>
            <Globe className="h-6 w-6" /> {t('adminLanguageTitle', 'Language & Localization')}
          </h1>
          <p className="text-xs" style={{ color: 'var(--color-text-secondary)' }}>
            {t('adminLanguageSubtitle', 'Manage supported languages, default locale, and system translation dictionaries.')}
          </p>
        </div>

        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2.5">
          <div 
            className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl border text-[11px] font-bold shadow-sm"
            style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--color-inner-dark)', borderColor: 'var(--color-border)', color: 'var(--color-text)' }}
          >
            <Sparkles className="h-3.5 w-3.5" style={{ color: 'var(--color-primary)' }} />
            <span>Full-Width Canvas</span>
          </div>

          <div 
            className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl border text-[11px] font-bold shadow-sm"
            style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--color-inner-dark)', borderColor: 'var(--color-border)', color: 'var(--color-text)' }}
          >
            <Database className="h-3.5 w-3.5" style={{ color: 'var(--color-emerald, #10b981)' }} />
            <span>PostgreSQL Synchronized</span>
          </div>

          <div 
            className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl border text-[11px] font-bold shadow-sm"
            style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--color-inner-dark)', borderColor: 'var(--color-border)', color: 'var(--color-text)' }}
          >
            <CheckCircle2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5" style={{ color: 'var(--color-primary)' }} />
            <span>{activeCount} Active Locales</span>
          </div>

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={fetchLanguageData}
            className="p-2 rounded-xl border transition hover:opacity-80 cursor-pointer shadow-sm"
            style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--color-inner-dark)', borderColor: 'var(--color-border)', color: 'var(--color-text)' }}
            title="Reload languages"
          >
            <RefreshCw className={`h-4 w-4 ${loading ? 'animate-spin' : ''}`} />
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Main Accessible Form-Free Container (Constraint 9) */}
      <div 
        role="region"
        data-lpignore="true"
        className="rounded-3xl p-6 space-y-6 shadow-xl border transition-colors duration-200"
        style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--color-card)', borderColor: 'var(--color-border)' }}
      >
        {/* Navigation Tabs Bar */}
        <div 
          className="flex p-1.5 rounded-2xl border transition-colors duration-200"
          style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--color-inner-dark)', borderColor: 'var(--color-border)' }}
        >
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setActiveTab('languages')}
            className="flex-1 py-3 text-xs font-bold rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center gap-2 transition cursor-pointer"
            style={activeTab === 'languages' ? {
              backgroundColor: 'var(--color-card)',
              color: 'var(--color-primary)',
              borderColor: 'var(--color-primary)',
              borderWidth: '1px',
              boxShadow: '0 4px 6px -1px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1)'
            } : { color: 'var(--color-text-secondary)' }}
          >
            <Globe className="h-4 w-4" />
            <span>Supported Languages</span>
            <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-bold" style={{ backgroundColor: 'rgba(224, 86, 56, 0.15)', color: 'var(--color-primary)' }}>
              {languages.length}
            </span>
          </button>

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setActiveTab('words')}
            className="flex-1 py-3 text-xs font-bold rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center gap-2 transition cursor-pointer"
            style={activeTab === 'words' ? {
              backgroundColor: 'var(--color-card)',
              color: 'var(--color-primary)',
              borderColor: 'var(--color-primary)',
              borderWidth: '1px',
              boxShadow: '0 4px 6px -1px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1)'
            } : { color: 'var(--color-text-secondary)' }}
          >
            <FileText className="h-4 w-4" />
            <span>System Words & Translations</span>
            <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-bold" style={{ backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08)', color: 'var(--color-text)' }}>
              {allPhraseKeys.length}
            </span>
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* TAB 1: SUPPORTED LANGUAGES TABLE */}
        {activeTab === 'languages' && (
          <div className="space-y-4">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <div>
                <h3 className="text-sm font-bold" style={{ color: 'var(--color-text)' }}>Installed System Locales</h3>
                <p className="text-[11px]" style={{ color: 'var(--color-text-secondary)' }}>
                  Installed system locales and writing directions.
                </p>
              </div>

              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => {
                  setModalMode('add');
                  setEditingLang({
                    id: '',
                    code: '',
                    name: '',
                    native: '',
                    flag: '🌐',
                    direction: 'ltr',
                    status: 'active',
                    is_default: false
                  });
                  setIsModalOpen(true);
                }}
                className="px-4 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold text-white flex items-center gap-1.5 transition hover:opacity-90 shadow cursor-pointer"
                style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--color-primary)' }}
              >
                <Plus className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                <span>Add Language</span>
              </button>
            </div>

            {/* Language Table */}
            <div className="rounded-2xl border overflow-x-auto" style={{ borderColor: 'var(--color-border)' }}>
              <table className="w-full text-left text-xs border-collapse">
                <thead>
                  <tr className="border-b" style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--color-inner-dark)', borderColor: 'var(--color-border)' }}>
                    <th className="py-3 px-4 font-bold" style={{ color: 'var(--color-text)' }}>Language & Identifier</th>
                    <th className="py-3 px-4 font-bold" style={{ color: 'var(--color-text)' }}>Code</th>
                    <th className="py-3 px-4 font-bold" style={{ color: 'var(--color-text)' }}>Native Name</th>
                    <th className="py-3 px-4 font-bold" style={{ color: 'var(--color-text)' }}>Direction</th>
                    <th className="py-3 px-4 font-bold" style={{ color: 'var(--color-text)' }}>Status</th>
                    <th className="py-3 px-4 font-bold text-right" style={{ color: 'var(--color-text)' }}>Actions</th>
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody className="divide-y" style={{ borderColor: 'var(--color-border)' }}>
                  {languages.map((item) => (
                    <tr 
                      key={item.code} 
                      className="transition hover:bg-white/[0.02]"
                      style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--color-card)' }}
                    >
                      <td className="py-3.5 px-4 font-bold flex items-center gap-2.5">
                        <span className="text-xl">{item.flag || '🌐'}</span>
                        <span style={{ color: 'var(--color-text)' }}>{item.name}</span>
                        {item.is_default && (
                          <span 
                            className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[9px] font-black uppercase tracking-wider border"
                            style={{ 
                              backgroundColor: 'rgba(224, 86, 56, 0.15)', 
                              borderColor: 'var(--color-primary)', 
                              color: 'var(--color-primary)' 
                            }}
                          >
                            DEFAULT
                          </span>
                        )}
                      </td>

                      <td className="py-3.5 px-4 font-mono font-bold" style={{ color: 'var(--color-text)' }}>
                        {item.code.toUpperCase()}
                      </td>

                      <td className="py-3.5 px-4 font-medium" style={{ color: 'var(--color-text)' }}>
                        {item.native || item.nativeName || item.name}
                      </td>

                      <td className="py-3.5 px-4 font-mono uppercase text-[11px]" style={{ color: 'var(--color-text-secondary)' }}>
                        {item.direction || 'LTR'}
                      </td>

                      <td className="py-3.5 px-4">
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => handleToggleStatus(item.code)}
                          disabled={item.is_default}
                          className="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full text-[10px] font-bold border transition cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-50"
                          style={item.status === 'active' ? {
                            backgroundColor: 'rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.15)',
                            borderColor: '#10b981',
                            color: '#10b981'
                          } : {
                            backgroundColor: 'rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.15)',
                            borderColor: '#ef4444',
                            color: '#ef4444'
                          }}
                        >
                          {item.status === 'active' ? 'Active' : 'Inactive'}
                        </button>
                      </td>

                      <td className="py-3.5 px-4 text-right space-x-1">
                        {!item.is_default && (
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            onClick={() => handleSetDefault(item.code)}
                            className="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg border text-[11px] font-bold transition hover:opacity-80 cursor-pointer mr-1"
                            style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--color-inner-dark)', borderColor: 'var(--color-border)', color: 'var(--color-text)' }}
                          >
                            Set Default
                          </button>
                        )}

                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => {
                            setModalMode('edit');
                            setEditingLang({ ...item });
                            setIsModalOpen(true);
                          }}
                          className="p-1.5 rounded-lg border transition hover:opacity-80 cursor-pointer inline-block"
                          style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--color-inner-dark)', borderColor: 'var(--color-border)', color: 'var(--color-text)' }}
                          title="Edit Language"
                        >
                          <Edit2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                        </button>

                        {!item.is_default && (
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            onClick={() => handleDeleteLanguage(item.code)}
                            className="p-1.5 rounded-lg border text-red-400 hover:text-red-300 transition cursor-pointer inline-block"
                            style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--color-inner-dark)', borderColor: 'rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.3)' }}
                            title="Delete Language"
                          >
                            <Trash2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                          </button>
                        )}
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  ))}
                </tbody>
              </table>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* TAB 2: SYSTEM WORDS & TRANSLATIONS */}
        {activeTab === 'words' && (
          <div className="space-y-4">
            <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-3">
              {/* Search Box */}
              <div className="relative flex-1 max-w-md">
                <Search className="h-4 w-4 absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2" style={{ color: 'var(--color-text-secondary)' }} />
                <input
                  type="text"
                  autoComplete="off"
                  data-lpignore="true"
                  data-form-type="other"
                  placeholder="Search phrases or translation keys..."
                  value={searchQuery}
                  onChange={(e) => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full pl-9 pr-4 py-2 rounded-xl border text-xs outline-none font-medium"
                  style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--color-inner-dark)', borderColor: 'var(--color-border)', color: 'var(--color-text)' }}
                />
              </div>

              {/* Language Selector Tabs */}
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 overflow-x-auto pb-1">
                {languages.map(l => (
                  <button
                    key={l.code}
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => setSelectedWordLocale(l.code)}
                    className="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl border text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-1.5 transition cursor-pointer shrink-0"
                    style={selectedWordLocale === l.code ? {
                      backgroundColor: 'var(--color-primary)',
                      color: '#ffffff',
                      borderColor: 'var(--color-primary)'
                    } : {
                      backgroundColor: 'var(--color-inner-dark)',
                      borderColor: 'var(--color-border)',
                      color: 'var(--color-text)'
                    }}
                  >
                    <span>{l.flag}</span>
                    <span>{l.name}</span>
                  </button>
                ))}

                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setIsWordModalOpen(true)}
                  className="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl border text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-1.5 transition hover:opacity-90 cursor-pointer text-white shrink-0"
                  style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--color-primary)' }}
                >
                  <Plus className="h-3 w-3" />
                  <span>Add Key</span>
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Translation Dictionary Table */}
            <div className="rounded-2xl border overflow-x-auto max-h-[550px] overflow-y-auto" style={{ borderColor: 'var(--color-border)' }}>
              <table className="w-full text-left text-xs border-collapse">
                <thead className="sticky top-0 z-10" style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--color-inner-dark)', borderColor: 'var(--color-border)' }}>
                  <tr className="border-b" style={{ borderColor: 'var(--color-border)' }}>
                    <th className="py-3 px-4 font-bold w-1/3" style={{ color: 'var(--color-text)' }}>Translation Key Identifier</th>
                    <th className="py-3 px-4 font-bold" style={{ color: 'var(--color-text)' }}>
                      Phrase Translation ({languages.find(l => l.code === selectedWordLocale)?.name || selectedWordLocale.toUpperCase()})
                    </th>
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody className="divide-y" style={{ borderColor: 'var(--color-border)' }}>
                  {filteredPhraseKeys.slice(0, 250).map((key) => {
                    const currentVal = translations[selectedWordLocale]?.[key] || '';
                    return (
                      <tr key={key} className="hover:bg-white/[0.02]" style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--color-card)' }}>
                        <td className="py-2.5 px-4 font-mono font-semibold" style={{ color: 'var(--color-primary)' }}>
                          {key}
                        </td>
                        <td className="py-2.5 px-4">
                          <input
                            type="text"
                            autoComplete="off"
                            data-lpignore="true"
                            data-form-type="other"
                            value={currentVal}
                            placeholder={translations['en']?.[key] || key}
                            onChange={(e) => {
                              const val = e.target.value;
                              setTranslations(prev => {
                                const next = { ...prev };
                                if (!next[selectedWordLocale]) next[selectedWordLocale] = {};
                                next[selectedWordLocale][key] = val;
                                return next;
                              });
                            }}
                            className="w-full px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg border text-xs outline-none transition"
                            style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--color-inner-dark)', borderColor: 'var(--color-border)', color: 'var(--color-text)' }}
                          />
                        </td>
                      </tr>
                    );
                  })}
                </tbody>
              </table>
            </div>

            {filteredPhraseKeys.length > 250 && (
              <p className="text-[11px] text-center" style={{ color: 'var(--color-text-secondary)' }}>
                Showing first 250 of {filteredPhraseKeys.length} matching phrases. Use search to filter specific keys.
              </p>
            )}
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Status Toast Banner */}
        {status && (
          <div
            className="p-4 rounded-2xl border text-xs font-semibold flex items-center gap-2 animate-in fade-in"
            style={{
              backgroundColor: 'var(--color-inner-dark)',
              borderColor: status.type === 'success' ? '#10b981' : 'rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.4)',
              color: status.type === 'success' ? '#10b981' : '#ef4444'
            }}
          >
            {status.type === 'success' ? <CheckCircle2 className="h-4 w-4 shrink-0" /> : <AlertCircle className="h-4 w-4 shrink-0" />}
            <span>{status.msg}</span>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Bottom Persistent Action Bar */}
        <div 
          className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-center justify-between gap-4 pt-4 border-t" 
          style={{ borderColor: 'var(--color-border)' }}
        >
          <div className="text-xs font-bold" style={{ color: 'var(--color-text-secondary)' }}>
            Total Phrases: <span className="font-mono text-sm" style={{ color: 'var(--color-text)' }}>{allPhraseKeys.length}</span>
          </div>

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={handleSaveChanges}
            disabled={saving}
            className="w-full sm:w-auto px-6 py-3 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold text-white shadow-lg transition hover:opacity-90 flex items-center justify-center gap-2 cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-50"
            style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--color-primary)' }}
          >
            <Check className={`h-4 w-4 ${saving ? 'animate-spin' : ''}`} />
            <span>{saving ? 'Saving Changes...' : 'Save Changes'}</span>
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* MODAL: ADD / EDIT LANGUAGE */}
      {isModalOpen && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-sm">
          <div 
            role="region"
            data-lpignore="true"
            className="w-full max-w-md rounded-3xl p-6 border shadow-2xl space-y-4"
            style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--color-card)', borderColor: 'var(--color-border)' }}
          >
            <h3 className="text-base font-bold" style={{ color: 'var(--color-text)' }}>
              {modalMode === 'add' ? 'Add Supported Language' : 'Edit Language Configuration'}
            </h3>

            <div className="space-y-3 text-xs font-bold">
              <div>
                <label className="block mb-1" style={{ color: 'var(--color-text-secondary)' }}>Language Code (e.g. en, th, es)</label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  autoComplete="off"
                  data-lpignore="true"
                  data-form-type="other"
                  disabled={modalMode === 'edit'}
                  value={editingLang.code}
                  onChange={(e) => setEditingLang({ ...editingLang, code: e.target.value })}
                  className="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-xl border outline-none font-mono"
                  style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--color-inner-dark)', borderColor: 'var(--color-border)', color: 'var(--color-text)' }}
                />
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="block mb-1" style={{ color: 'var(--color-text-secondary)' }}>Display Name (English)</label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  autoComplete="off"
                  data-lpignore="true"
                  data-form-type="other"
                  value={editingLang.name}
                  onChange={(e) => setEditingLang({ ...editingLang, name: e.target.value })}
                  className="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-xl border outline-none"
                  style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--color-inner-dark)', borderColor: 'var(--color-border)', color: 'var(--color-text)' }}
                />
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="block mb-1" style={{ color: 'var(--color-text-secondary)' }}>Native Script (e.g. ไทย, Español)</label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  autoComplete="off"
                  data-lpignore="true"
                  data-form-type="other"
                  value={editingLang.native}
                  onChange={(e) => setEditingLang({ ...editingLang, native: e.target.value })}
                  className="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-xl border outline-none"
                  style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--color-inner-dark)', borderColor: 'var(--color-border)', color: 'var(--color-text)' }}
                />
              </div>

              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                <div>
                  <label className="block mb-1" style={{ color: 'var(--color-text-secondary)' }}>Flag Emoji</label>
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    autoComplete="off"
                    data-lpignore="true"
                    data-form-type="other"
                    maxLength={4}
                    value={editingLang.flag}
                    onChange={(e) => setEditingLang({ ...editingLang, flag: e.target.value })}
                    className="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-xl border outline-none text-center text-base"
                    style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--color-inner-dark)', borderColor: 'var(--color-border)', color: 'var(--color-text)' }}
                  />
                </div>

                <div>
                  <label className="block mb-1" style={{ color: 'var(--color-text-secondary)' }}>Direction</label>
                  <select
                    value={editingLang.direction}
                    onChange={(e) => setEditingLang({ ...editingLang, direction: e.target.value as any })}
                    className="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-xl border outline-none cursor-pointer"
                    style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--color-inner-dark)', borderColor: 'var(--color-border)', color: 'var(--color-text)' }}
                  >
                    <option value="ltr">LTR (Left to Right)</option>
                    <option value="rtl">RTL (Right to Left)</option>
                  </select>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-2 pt-4 border-t" style={{ borderColor: 'var(--color-border)' }}>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setIsModalOpen(false)}
                className="px-4 py-2 rounded-xl border text-xs font-bold transition hover:opacity-80 cursor-pointer"
                style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--color-inner-dark)', borderColor: 'var(--color-border)', color: 'var(--color-text)' }}
              >
                Cancel
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={handleSaveLanguageModal}
                className="px-4 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold text-white shadow transition hover:opacity-90 cursor-pointer"
                style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--color-primary)' }}
              >
                Save
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* MODAL: ADD TRANSLATION KEY */}
      {isWordModalOpen && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-sm">
          <div 
            role="region"
            data-lpignore="true"
            className="w-full max-w-md rounded-3xl p-6 border shadow-2xl space-y-4"
            style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--color-card)', borderColor: 'var(--color-border)' }}
          >
            <h3 className="text-base font-bold" style={{ color: 'var(--color-text)' }}>Add New System Word Key</h3>
            
            <div className="space-y-3 text-xs font-bold">
              <div>
                <label className="block mb-1" style={{ color: 'var(--color-text-secondary)' }}>Translation Key Identifier</label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  autoComplete="off"
                  data-lpignore="true"
                  data-form-type="other"
                  placeholder="e.g. welcomeHeaderSubtitle"
                  value={newKey}
                  onChange={(e) => setNewKey(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-xl border outline-none font-mono"
                  style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--color-inner-dark)', borderColor: 'var(--color-border)', color: 'var(--color-text)' }}
                />
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="block mb-1" style={{ color: 'var(--color-text-secondary)' }}>
                  Phrase Value for ({selectedWordLocale.toUpperCase()})
                </label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  autoComplete="off"
                  data-lpignore="true"
                  data-form-type="other"
                  placeholder="Enter localized text..."
                  value={newVal}
                  onChange={(e) => setNewVal(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-xl border outline-none"
                  style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--color-inner-dark)', borderColor: 'var(--color-border)', color: 'var(--color-text)' }}
                />
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-2 pt-4 border-t" style={{ borderColor: 'var(--color-border)' }}>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setIsWordModalOpen(false)}
                className="px-4 py-2 rounded-xl border text-xs font-bold transition hover:opacity-80 cursor-pointer"
                style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--color-inner-dark)', borderColor: 'var(--color-border)', color: 'var(--color-text)' }}
              >
                Cancel
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={handleAddTranslationWord}
                className="px-4 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold text-white shadow transition hover:opacity-90 cursor-pointer"
                style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--color-primary)' }}
              >
                Add Key
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

// @ts-nocheck
'use client';

import React, { useState, useEffect, useCallback, useRef } from 'react';

} from 'lucide-react';

}

export interface StorageSettings {

}

export interface DiskDiagnostics {

    resolvedPath: string;
    exists: boolean;
    writable: boolean;
    fileCount: number;
  };

}

const DEFAULT_STORAGE_SETTINGS: StorageSettings = {
  provider: 'localhost',
  localhost: {
    recipesJsonDir: 'apps/web/public/recipes',
    uploadDir: 'apps/web/public/recipes/images',

    publicServingUrl: '/recipes/images',
    maxFileSizeMb: 10
  },
  supabase: {
    endpoint: 'https://tnhrkjtujdfgvwhsuuxb.storage.supabase.co/storage/v1/s3',
    region: 'us-west-1',
    accessKeyId: 'f3e0affef5c74972a535153349eb24cc',
    secretAccessKey: '',
    bucketName: 'recipes',
    bucket: 'recipes',
    publicUrlPrefix: 'https://tnhrkjtujdfgvwhsuuxb.supabase.co/storage/v1/object/public/recipes',
    publicUrl: 'https://tnhrkjtujdfgvwhsuuxb.supabase.co/storage/v1/object/public/recipes',
    maxFileSizeMb: 25,
    enabled: false
  },
  allowedFormats: ['jpg', 'jpeg', 'png', 'webp', 'svg'],
  isConnected: false
};

const STANDARD_REGIONS = [
  { id: 'us-west-1', label: 'us-west-1 (N. California / Supabase Default)' },
  { id: 'us-east-1', label: 'us-east-1 (N. Virginia)' },
  { id: 'us-east-2', label: 'us-east-2 (Ohio)' },
  { id: 'eu-central-1', label: 'eu-central-1 (Frankfurt)' },
  { id: 'eu-west-1', label: 'eu-west-1 (Ireland)' },
  { id: 'eu-west-2', label: 'eu-west-2 (London)' },
  { id: 'eu-west-3', label: 'eu-west-3 (Paris)' },
  { id: 'ap-southeast-1', label: 'ap-southeast-1 (Singapore)' },
  { id: 'ap-southeast-2', label: 'ap-southeast-2 (Sydney)' },
  { id: 'ap-northeast-1', label: 'ap-northeast-1 (Tokyo)' },
  { id: 'ap-northeast-2', label: 'ap-northeast-2 (Seoul)' },
  { id: 'sa-east-1', label: 'sa-east-1 (São Paulo)' },
  { id: 'custom', label: 'Custom / Other Region...' }
];

export default function AdminStoragePage() {
  const { t } = useTranslation();

  const tr = useCallback((key: string, fallback: string): string => {
    if (typeof t === 'function') {
      const val = t(key);
      if (val && val !== key) return val;
    }
    return fallback;
  }, [t]);

  const [settings, setSettings] = useState<StorageSettings>(DEFAULT_STORAGE_SETTINGS);
  const [diagnostics, setDiagnostics] = useState<DiskDiagnostics | null>(null);

  const [showSecretKey, setShowSecretKey] = useState<boolean>(false);

  const isFetchingRef = useRef<boolean>(false);
  const isSavingRef = useRef<boolean>(false);

  const showToast = (type: 'success' | 'error', msg: string) => {
    setFeedback({ type, msg });
    setTimeout(() => setFeedback(null), 4500);
  };

  const loadStorageSettings = useCallback(async () => {
    if (isFetchingRef.current || isSavingRef.current) return;
    isFetchingRef.current = true;
    setLoading(true);

    try {
      const res = await fetch('/api/admin/storage?t=' + Date.now(), { cache: 'no-store' });
      if (res.ok) {
        const data = await res.json();
        if (data.storageSettings || data.settings) {
          const loaded = data.storageSettings || data.settings;
          setSettings(prev => ({
            ...prev,
            ...loaded,
            localhost: {
              ...prev.localhost,
              ...(loaded.localhost || {}),
              recipesJsonDir: loaded.localhost?.recipesJsonDir || prev.localhost.recipesJsonDir,
              uploadDir: loaded.localhost?.uploadDir || loaded.localhost?.uploadPath || prev.localhost.uploadDir,
              publicPrefix: loaded.localhost?.publicPrefix || loaded.localhost?.publicServingUrl || prev.localhost.publicPrefix
            },
            supabase: { ...prev.supabase, ...(loaded.supabase || {}) },
            allowedFormats: Array.isArray(loaded.allowedFormats) ? loaded.allowedFormats : prev.allowedFormats
          }));
          const reg = loaded.supabase?.region || 'us-west-1';
          setIsCustomRegion(!STANDARD_REGIONS.some(r => r.id === reg));
        }
        if (data.diagnostics) {
          setDiagnostics(data.diagnostics);
        }
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn('[Storage Settings] Fallback to client state:', err);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
      isFetchingRef.current = false;
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    document.title = `${tr('storageTitle', 'Media & Asset Storage Configuration')} - Admin`;
    loadStorageSettings();

    const handleSync = () => loadStorageSettings();
    window.addEventListener('zecratary_storage_updated', handleSync);
    window.addEventListener('zecratary_admin_settings_updated', handleSync);
    window.addEventListener('zecratary_languages_updated', handleSync);
    window.addEventListener('zecratary_dictionary_updated', handleSync);
    window.addEventListener('zecratary_locale_changed', handleSync);
    window.addEventListener('zecratary_theme_mode_changed', handleSync);

    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('zecratary_storage_updated', handleSync);
      window.removeEventListener('zecratary_admin_settings_updated', handleSync);
      window.removeEventListener('zecratary_languages_updated', handleSync);
      window.removeEventListener('zecratary_dictionary_updated', handleSync);
      window.removeEventListener('zecratary_locale_changed', handleSync);
      window.removeEventListener('zecratary_theme_mode_changed', handleSync);
    };
  }, [loadStorageSettings, tr]);

  const handleSaveSettings = async () => {
    if (saving || isSavingRef.current) return;
    setSaving(true);

    try {

        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ storageSettings: settings })
      });

          window.dispatchEvent(new Event('zecratary_admin_settings_updated'));
          try {
            localStorage.setItem('zecratary_storage_updated_at', Date.now().toString());
          } catch (_) {}
        }
        showToast('success', tr('storageSaveSuccess', 'Storage settings saved and synchronized with PostgreSQL & MySQL!'));
      } else {
        throw new Error(data.error || 'Failed to save storage settings.');
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      showToast('error', err.message || tr('storageSaveError', 'Failed to save storage settings. Please try again.'));
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
      setTimeout(() => { isSavingRef.current = false; }, 300);
    }
  };

  const handleTestS3Connection = async () => {
    if (testingConnection) return;
    const secretKey = settings.supabase.secretAccessKey?.trim();

    if (!secretKey) {
      setTestResult({
        success: false,
        msg: tr('storageEnterSecretKeyToTest', 'Please enter your Secret Access Key before testing the connection.')
      });
      return;
    }

    setTestingConnection(true);
    setTestResult(null);

    try {
      const res = await fetch('/api/admin/storage/test', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify(settings.supabase)
      });

      const data = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
      if (res.ok && data.success) {
        setTestResult({
          success: true,
          msg: tr('storageTestSuccess', 'Successfully connected to Supabase S3! Bucket "{bucket}" is reachable and ready.').replace('{bucket}', settings.supabase.bucketName || 'recipes')
        });
        setSettings(prev => ({ ...prev, isConnected: true }));
      } else {

          success: false,
          msg: tr('storageTestFailed', 'Connection failed: {error}').replace('{error}', data.error || 'Could not verify S3 bucket.')
        });
        setSettings(prev => ({ ...prev, isConnected: false }));

    } catch (err: any) {
      setTestResult({

        msg: tr('storageTestFailed', 'Connection failed: {error}').replace('{error}', err.message || 'Network timeout.')
      });
      setSettings(prev => ({ ...prev, isConnected: false }));

      }

      data-lpignore="true"
    >
      {/* 1. Top Header & Action Controls */}
      <div

      >
        <div>

            <HardDrive className="h-6 w-6" style={{ color: 'var(--color-primary)' }} />
            {tr('storageTitle', 'Media & Asset Storage Configuration')}
          </h1>
          <p className="text-xs mt-1" style={{ color: 'var(--color-text-secondary)' }}>
            {tr('storageSubtitle', 'Configure storage destinations for recipe scrapers, user uploads, AI generated dishes, and branding assets.')}
          </p>
        </div>

        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2.5">
          <div 
            className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl border text-[11px] font-bold shadow-xs select-none"

          >
