'use client';

import React, { useState, useEffect, useCallback, useRef } from 'react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { 
  SquarePen, Plus, Trash2, Save, ArrowLeft, Image as ImageIcon,
  Upload, CheckCircle2, AlertCircle, HardDrive, Cloud, RefreshCw,
  ArrowUp, ArrowDown, GripVertical, Sparkles, ChefHat
} from 'lucide-react';
import { getCurrentUser, User, initAuthStorage } from '@/lib/auth';
import { useRecipeTypes, useIngredientCategories } from '@/lib/recipe_types';
import { useTranslation } from '@/components/LanguageProvider';

interface IngredientItem {
  amount: string;
  unit: string;
  item: string;
  category: string;
}

const DEFAULT_RECIPE_TYPES = [
  'Main Dish', 'Breakfast', 'Lunch', 'Dinner', 'Appetizer', 
  'Side Dish', 'Dessert', 'Snacks', 'Beverages', 'Soup', 'Salad'
];

const DEFAULT_CATEGORIES = [
  'Pantry Staples', 'Produce', 'Meat & Seafood', 'Dairy & Eggs', 
  'Spices & Seasonings', 'Canned Goods', 'Grains & Pasta', 'Condiments & Sauces', 'Other'
];

export default function ManualRecipePage() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const [currentUser, setCurrentUser] = useState<User | null>(null);
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<'info' | 'ingredients' | 'steps'>('info');

  const remoteRecipeTypes = useRecipeTypes?.() || [];
  const remoteCategories = useIngredientCategories?.() || [];

  const recipeTypes = Array.isArray(remoteRecipeTypes) && remoteRecipeTypes.length > 0 
    ? remoteRecipeTypes 
    : DEFAULT_RECIPE_TYPES;
  const ingredientCategories = Array.isArray(remoteCategories) && remoteCategories.length > 0 
    ? remoteCategories 
    : DEFAULT_CATEGORIES;

  // Recipe Form State
  const [form, setForm] = useState({
    title: '',
    description: '',
    recipeType: 'Main Dish',
    servings: 2,
    prepTimeMinutes: 15,
    cookTimeMinutes: 30,
    calories: 450,
    proteinGrams: 25,
    carbsGrams: 40,
    fatGrams: 15,
    imageUrl: '',
    ingredients: [
      { amount: '2', unit: 'tbsp', item: 'Olive oil', category: 'Pantry Staples' },
      { amount: '3', unit: 'cloves', item: 'Garlic, minced', category: 'Produce' }
    ] as IngredientItem[],
    instructions: [
      'Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium heat.',
      'Sauté minced garlic until aromatic, then combine remaining ingredients.'
    ] as string[]
  });

  // Storage Engine Telemetry (Synced with /admin/storage)
  const [storageProvider, setStorageProvider] = useState<'local' | 'supabase'>('local');
  const [storagePath, setStoragePath] = useState<string>('/recipes/images/');
  const [isUploadingImage, setIsUploadingImage] = useState(false);
  const [isDownloadingRemote, setIsDownloadingRemote] = useState(false);
  const [isDragging, setIsDragging] = useState(false);
  const fileInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement | null>(null);

  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [isReorderingIngredients, setIsReorderingIngredients] = useState(false);
  const [isReorderingSteps, setIsReorderingSteps] = useState(false);
  const [draggedIndex, setDraggedIndex] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [toastMessage, setToastMessage] = useState<{ type: 'success' | 'error' | 'warning'; text: string } | null>(null);

  const showToast = (text: string, type: 'success' | 'error' | 'warning' = 'success') => {
    setToastMessage({ type, text });
    setTimeout(() => setToastMessage(null), 3800);
  };

  // Sync Storage Engine with /admin/storage
  const fetchStorageSettings = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`/api/admin/storage?t=${Date.now()}`, { cache: 'no-store' });
      if (res.ok) {
        const data = await res.json();
        const s = data.storage || data.settings || data;
        const provider = s.provider || s.activeProvider || (s.supabase?.enabled ? 'supabase' : 'local');
        setStorageProvider(provider === 'supabase' ? 'supabase' : 'local');
        if (s.localPath) setStoragePath(s.localPath);
      }
    } catch (_) {
      try {
        const adminRes = await fetch(`/api/admin/settings?t=${Date.now()}`, { cache: 'no-store' });
        if (adminRes.ok) {
          const adm = await adminRes.json();
          const s = adm.storage || adm.settings?.storage || {};
          if (s.provider) setStorageProvider(s.provider);
        }
      } catch (_) {}
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    document.title = `${t('createRecipe', 'Create Recipe')} - Zecratary`;
    initAuthStorage();
    const user = getCurrentUser();
    if (!user) {
      router.replace('/login');
      return;
    }
    setCurrentUser(user);
    fetchStorageSettings();

    const handleSync = () => {
      const u = getCurrentUser();
      if (u) setCurrentUser(u);
      fetchStorageSettings();
    };

    window.addEventListener('storage', handleSync);
    window.addEventListener('zecratary_storage_settings_updated', handleSync);
    window.addEventListener('zecratary_admin_settings_updated', handleSync);
    window.addEventListener('zecratary_theme_mode_changed', handleSync);
    window.addEventListener('zecratary_languages_updated', handleSync);
    window.addEventListener('zecratary_dictionary_updated', handleSync);
    window.addEventListener('zecratary_locale_changed', handleSync);

    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('storage', handleSync);
      window.removeEventListener('zecratary_storage_settings_updated', handleSync);
      window.removeEventListener('zecratary_admin_settings_updated', handleSync);
      window.removeEventListener('zecratary_theme_mode_changed', handleSync);
      window.removeEventListener('zecratary_languages_updated', handleSync);
      window.removeEventListener('zecratary_dictionary_updated', handleSync);
      window.removeEventListener('zecratary_locale_changed', handleSync);
    };
  }, [router, t, fetchStorageSettings]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (recipeTypes.length > 0 && !recipeTypes.includes(form.recipeType)) {
      setForm(prev => ({ ...prev, recipeType: recipeTypes[0] }));
    }
  }, [recipeTypes, form.recipeType]);

  // Handle Drag & Drop Image Upload with Center Click Trigger
  const processImageFile = async (file: File) => {
    if (!file.type.startsWith('image/')) {
      showToast(t('invalidImageFormat', 'Please select a valid image file (PNG, JPG, WEBP).'), 'error');
      return;
    }

    setIsUploadingImage(true);
    try {
      const formData = new FormData();
      formData.append('file', file);
      formData.append('provider', storageProvider);

      const res = await fetch('/api/recipes/upload', {
        method: 'POST',
        body: formData
      });

      const data = await res.json();
      if (res.ok && (data.url || data.localUrl || data.path)) {
        const finalUrl = data.url || data.localUrl || data.path;
        setForm(prev => ({ ...prev, imageUrl: finalUrl }));
        showToast(t('imageUploadSuccess', 'Cover image uploaded and synced with /admin/storage!'), 'success');
      } else {
        // Fallback to local DataURL preview
        const reader = new FileReader();
        reader.onloadend = () => {
          setForm(prev => ({ ...prev, imageUrl: reader.result as string }));
        };
        reader.readAsDataURL(file);
        showToast(t('imageUploadFailed', 'Image upload failed. Storing image preview locally.'), 'warning');
      }
    } catch (_) {
      const reader = new FileReader();
      reader.onloadend = () => {
        setForm(prev => ({ ...prev, imageUrl: reader.result as string }));
      };
      reader.readAsDataURL(file);
    } finally {
      setIsUploadingImage(false);
    }
  };

  const handleDragOver = (e: React.DragEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    e.stopPropagation();
    setIsDragging(true);
  };

  const handleDragLeave = (e: React.DragEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    e.stopPropagation();
    setIsDragging(false);
  };

  const handleDrop = (e: React.DragEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    e.stopPropagation();
    setIsDragging(false);
    if (e.dataTransfer.files && e.dataTransfer.files[0]) {
      processImageFile(e.dataTransfer.files[0]);
    }
  };

  // Sync Remote Image with /admin/storage to prevent broken hotlinks
  const handleRemoteImageSync = async () => {
    const rawUrl = form.imageUrl.trim();
    if (!rawUrl || (!rawUrl.startsWith('http://') && !rawUrl.startsWith('https://'))) return;

    setIsDownloadingRemote(true);
    try {
      const res = await fetch('/api/recipes/save-remote-image', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ imageUrl: rawUrl })
      });
      const data = await res.json();
      if (res.ok && data.success && (data.localPath || data.localUrl)) {
        setForm(prev => ({ ...prev, imageUrl: data.localPath || data.localUrl }));
        showToast(t('imageUploadSuccess', 'Remote image downloaded and synced with /admin/storage!'), 'success');
      }
    } catch (_) {
      // Keep existing URL if remote fetch fails
    } finally {
      setIsDownloadingRemote(false);
    }
  };

  // Drag and Drop Reordering Handlers
  const handleItemDragStart = (index: number) => {
    setDraggedIndex(index);
  };

  const handleItemDragOver = (e: React.DragEvent, index: number, type: 'ingredients' | 'steps') => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (draggedIndex === null || draggedIndex === index) return;

    if (type === 'ingredients') {
      const list = [...form.ingredients];
      const item = list[draggedIndex];
      list.splice(draggedIndex, 1);
      list.splice(index, 0, item);
      setForm({ ...form, ingredients: list });
      setDraggedIndex(index);
    } else {
      const list = [...form.instructions];
      const item = list[draggedIndex];
      list.splice(draggedIndex, 1);
      list.splice(index, 0, item);
      setForm({ ...form, instructions: list });
      setDraggedIndex(index);
    }
  };

  const handleItemDrop = () => {
    setDraggedIndex(null);
  };

  const moveIngredient = (idx: number, direction: 'up' | 'down') => {
    const targetIdx = direction === 'up' ? idx - 1 : idx + 1;
    if (targetIdx < 0 || targetIdx >= form.ingredients.length) return;
    const list = [...form.ingredients];
    const item = list[idx];
    list.splice(idx, 1);
    list.splice(targetIdx, 0, item);
    setForm({ ...form, ingredients: list });
  };

  const moveStep = (idx: number, direction: 'up' | 'down') => {
    const targetIdx = direction === 'up' ? idx - 1 : idx + 1;
    if (targetIdx < 0 || targetIdx >= form.instructions.length) return;
    const list = [...form.instructions];
    const item = list[idx];
    list.splice(idx, 1);
    list.splice(targetIdx, 0, item);
    setForm({ ...form, instructions: list });
  };

  const handleSave = async () => {
    if (!form.title.trim()) {
      showToast(t('enterRecipeTitleAlert', 'Please enter a recipe title before saving.'), 'error');
      setActiveTab('info');
      return;
    }

    const validIngredients = form.ingredients.filter(ing => ing.item && ing.item.trim().length > 0);
    if (validIngredients.length === 0) {
      showToast(t('atLeastOneIngredientAlert', 'Please add at least one ingredient item.'), 'error');
      setActiveTab('ingredients');
      return;
    }

    const validInstructions = form.instructions.filter(i => i && i.trim().length > 0);
    if (validInstructions.length === 0) {
      showToast(t('atLeastOneStepAlert', 'Please describe at least one cooking instruction step.'), 'error');
      setActiveTab('steps');
      return;
    }

    if (!currentUser) return;
    setSaving(true);

    try {
      const recipeId = 'manual_' + Date.now().toString(36) + Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 6);
      const targetUserId = (currentUser.id || currentUser.email || 'usr_admin_1').trim();
      const createdBy = (currentUser.email || targetUserId).trim();
      const creatorName = (currentUser.name || 'Chef').trim();

      const newRecipe = {
        id: recipeId,
        userId: targetUserId,
        user_id: targetUserId,
        createdBy,
        created_by: createdBy,
        creatorName,
        creator_name: creatorName,
        ownership: 'personal',
        owner: creatorName,
        ownerId: targetUserId,
        ownerName: creatorName,
        ownerEmail: createdBy,
        visibility: 'public',
        isPublic: true,
        title: form.title.trim(),
        name: form.title.trim(),
        description: form.description.trim() || 'Handmade recipe created in manual mode',
        recipeType: form.recipeType,
        category: form.recipeType,
        tags: [form.recipeType, 'Manual'],
        servings: Number(form.servings) || 2,
        prepTimeMinutes: Number(form.prepTimeMinutes) || 15,
        cookTimeMinutes: Number(form.cookTimeMinutes) || 30,
        calories: Number(form.calories) || 450,
        proteinGrams: Number(form.proteinGrams) || 25,
        carbsGrams: Number(form.carbsGrams) || 40,
        fatGrams: Number(form.fatGrams) || 15,
        imageUrl: form.imageUrl || '/uploads/recipes/default.jpg',
        image: form.imageUrl || '/uploads/recipes/default.jpg',
        image_url: form.imageUrl || '/uploads/recipes/default.jpg',
        ingredients: validIngredients.map((ing, idx) => ({
          id: `ing_${Date.now()}_${idx}`,
          amount: ing.amount || '1',
          unit: ing.unit || '',
          name: ing.item.trim(),
          item: ing.item.trim(),
          category: ing.category || 'Pantry Staples'
        })),
        instructions: validInstructions,
        steps: validInstructions,
        isFavorite: false,
        isCooked: false,
        rating: 5,
        sourceUrl: '',
        storageProvider,
        createdAt: new Date().toISOString()
      };

      // 1. Persist to PostgreSQL via /api/saved-recipes & /api/recipes
      await Promise.allSettled([
        fetch('/api/saved-recipes', {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
          body: JSON.stringify(newRecipe)
        }),
        fetch('/api/recipes', {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
          body: JSON.stringify(newRecipe)
        })
      ]);

      // 2. Hydrate client localStorage for instant offline access
      const storageKeys = ['zecratary_recipes', 'zecratary_saved_recipes', 'saved_recipes'];
      storageKeys.forEach((key) => {
        try {
          const raw = localStorage.getItem(key);
          const currentList = raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : [];
          const filtered = Array.isArray(currentList) ? currentList.filter((r: any) => r.id !== newRecipe.id) : [];
          localStorage.setItem(key, JSON.stringify([newRecipe, ...filtered]));
        } catch (_) {}
      });

      // 3. Dispatch global synchronization events
      window.dispatchEvent(new Event('zecratary_recipes_updated'));
      window.dispatchEvent(new Event('zecratary_saved_recipes_updated'));
      window.dispatchEvent(new Event('storage'));

      showToast(t('recipeCreatedSuccessToast', 'Recipe saved successfully to your culinary library!'), 'success');
      setTimeout(() => {
        router.push('/recipes');
      }, 750);
    } catch (err: any) {
      showToast(err.message || 'Failed to save manual recipe', 'error');
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div 
      id="zecratary-manual-canvas"
      role="region"
      aria-label={t('createRecipe', 'Create Recipe')}
      data-lpignore="true"
      className="w-full max-w-full px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 xl:px-10 space-y-6 pb-24 font-sans transition-colors duration-200"
      style={{ 
        width: '100%',
        maxWidth: '100%',
        boxSizing: 'border-box',
        color: 'var(--color-text)' 
      }}
    >
      {/* Toast Banner */}
      {toastMessage && (
        <div 
          className="fixed top-20 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 z-50 px-5 py-3 rounded-2xl text-xs font-bold shadow-2xl flex items-center gap-2 animate-in fade-in slide-in-from-top-3 border"
          style={{
            backgroundColor: 'var(--color-card)',
            borderColor: toastMessage.type === 'success' 
              ? 'var(--color-emerald)' 
              : toastMessage.type === 'warning' 
                ? '#f59e0b' 
                : '#ef4444',
            color: 'var(--color-text)'
          }}
        >
          {toastMessage.type === 'success' ? (
            <CheckCircle2 className="h-4 w-4" style={{ color: 'var(--color-emerald)' }} />
          ) : (
            <AlertCircle className="h-4 w-4 text-amber-500" />
          )}
          <span>{toastMessage.text}</span>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Top Header with /admin/storage Engine Sync Telemetry */}
      <div 
        className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-4 border-b pb-4"
        style={{ borderColor: 'var(--color-border)' }}
      >
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <Link 
            href="/recipes" 
            className="p-2.5 rounded-xl transition shadow-xs border cursor-pointer hover:opacity-80"
            style={{
              backgroundColor: 'var(--color-card)',
              borderColor: 'var(--color-border)',
              color: 'var(--color-text-secondary)'
            }}
            title={t('backBtn', '← Back')}
          >
            <ArrowLeft className="h-4 w-4" />
          </Link>
          <div>
            <h1 className="text-2xl font-black tracking-tight flex items-center gap-2" style={{ color: 'var(--color-primary)' }}>
              <SquarePen className="h-6 w-6" /> {t('createRecipe', 'Create Recipe')}
            </h1>
            <p className="text-xs" style={{ color: 'var(--color-text-secondary)' }}>
              {t('createRecipeSubtitle', 'Craft and customize dishes with ingredients, categories, and instructions')}
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* /admin/storage Telemetry Pill */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <div 
            className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl border text-[11px] font-bold shadow-xs"
            style={{ 
              backgroundColor: 'var(--color-inner-dark)', 
              borderColor: 'var(--color-border)', 
              color: 'var(--color-text)' 
            }}
            title={`Active Storage Provider: ${storageProvider.toUpperCase()} (/admin/storage)`}
          >
            {storageProvider === 'supabase' ? (
              <Cloud className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-emerald-400" />
            ) : (
              <HardDrive className="h-3.5 w-3.5" style={{ color: 'var(--color-primary)' }} />
            )}
            <span className="font-mono uppercase tracking-wider text-[10px]">
              {storageProvider === 'supabase' ? 'Supabase S3' : 'Local Disk'}
            </span>
            <span 
              className="text-[9px] px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-md font-bold uppercase"
              style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--color-card)', color: 'var(--color-emerald)' }}
            >
              {t('storageSyncedBadge', 'Storage Synced')}
            </span>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Main Fluid Container */}
      <div 
        role="region"
        data-lpignore="true"
        className="w-full max-w-full rounded-3xl p-6 space-y-6 shadow-xl border transition-colors duration-200"
        style={{
          backgroundColor: 'var(--color-card)',
          borderColor: 'var(--color-border)',
          boxSizing: 'border-box'
        }}
      >
        {/* Method Tab Bar */}
        <div 
          className="flex p-1.5 rounded-2xl border transition-colors duration-200"
          style={{
            backgroundColor: 'var(--color-inner-dark)',
            borderColor: 'var(--color-border)'
          }}
        >
          {[
            { id: 'info', label: t('basicInfoTab', 'Basic Info') },
            { id: 'ingredients', label: t('ingredientsTab', 'Ingredients') },
            { id: 'steps', label: t('stepsTab', 'Preparation Steps') }
          ].map((tab) => {
            const isActive = activeTab === tab.id;
            return (
              <button
                key={tab.id}
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setActiveTab(tab.id as any)}
                className="flex-1 py-3 text-xs font-bold rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center gap-2 transition cursor-pointer"
                style={isActive ? {
                  backgroundColor: 'var(--color-card)',
                  color: 'var(--color-primary)',
                  borderColor: 'var(--color-primary)',
                  borderWidth: '1px',
                  boxShadow: '0 4px 6px -1px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1)'
                } : {
                  color: 'var(--color-text-secondary)'
                }}
              >
                <span>{tab.label}</span>
              </button>
            );
          })}
        </div>

        {/* Accessible Autofill-Safe Form Free Region */}
        <div role="region" data-lpignore="true" className="space-y-6">

          {/* TAB 1: BASIC INFO & RESTORED DRAG & DROP PHOTO UPLOAD */}
          {activeTab === 'info' && (
            <div className="space-y-6 animate-in fade-in">
              {/* Task 4: Restored Drag & Drop with Click Center Upload */}
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <label className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider" style={{ color: 'var(--color-primary)' }}>
                  {t('photoLabel', 'Recipe Photo')}
                </label>

                {form.imageUrl ? (
                  <div 
                    className="relative w-full h-56 rounded-2xl overflow-hidden border group shadow-md"
                    style={{ borderColor: 'var(--color-border)' }}
                  >
                    <img src={form.imageUrl} alt="Recipe Preview" className="w-full h-full object-cover" />
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => setForm(prev => ({ ...prev, imageUrl: '' }))}
                      className="absolute top-3 right-3 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-black/75 hover:bg-red-600 text-white transition cursor-pointer shadow-lg flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-bold"
                    >
                      <Trash2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                      <span>{t('removeImage', 'Remove Photo')}</span>
                    </button>
                  </div>
                ) : (
                  <div
                    onDragOver={handleDragOver}
                    onDragLeave={handleDragLeave}
                    onDrop={handleDrop}
                    onClick={() => fileInputRef.current?.click()}
                    className="border-2 border-dashed rounded-2xl py-12 px-6 flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-center cursor-pointer transition relative group"
                    style={{
                      borderColor: isDragging ? 'var(--color-primary)' : 'var(--color-border)',
                      backgroundColor: isDragging ? 'var(--color-card)' : 'var(--color-inner-dark)'
                    }}
                  >
                    <input
                      ref={fileInputRef}
                      type="file"
                      accept="image/png, image/jpeg, image/webp"
                      onChange={(e) => e.target.files?.[0] && processImageFile(e.target.files[0])}
                      className="hidden"
                    />
                    
                    <div 
                      className="w-14 h-14 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center mb-3 transition transform group-hover:scale-105"
                      style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--color-card)' }}
                    >
                      <Upload 
                        className={`h-7 w-7 ${isUploadingImage ? 'animate-spin' : ''}`} 
                        style={{ color: 'var(--color-primary)' }} 
                      />
                    </div>

                    <p className="text-xs sm:text-sm font-semibold tracking-wide" style={{ color: 'var(--color-text)' }}>
                      <span style={{ color: 'var(--color-primary)' }} className="font-bold">
                        {t('clickToUploadCenter', 'Click center to browse or drag file here')}
                      </span>
                    </p>
                    <p className="text-[11px] font-medium mt-1" style={{ color: 'var(--color-text-secondary)' }}>
                      {t('uploadOrDragHint', 'Supports PNG, JPG, WEBP (Max 10MB)')}
                    </p>
                  </div>
                )}

                {/* Alternate Image URL Input with /admin/storage Remote Sync */}
                <div 
                  className="w-full mt-3 p-3 rounded-xl border flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-stretch sm:items-center gap-2"
                  style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--color-inner-dark)', borderColor: 'var(--color-border)' }}
                >
                  <span className="text-[11px] font-bold shrink-0 opacity-80" style={{ color: 'var(--color-text-secondary)' }}>
                    {t('imageUrlOrUpload', 'Or enter Image URL')}:
                  </span>
                  <input
                    type="url"
                    autoComplete="off"
                    data-lpignore="true"
                    data-form-type="other"
                    placeholder={t('imageUrlPlaceholder', 'https://example.com/recipe-photo.jpg')}
                    value={form.imageUrl}
                    onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, imageUrl: e.target.value })}
                    className="flex-1 bg-transparent border-none text-xs outline-none font-medium"
                    style={{ color: 'var(--color-text)' }}
                  />
                  {form.imageUrl.startsWith('http') && (
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={handleRemoteImageSync}
                      disabled={isDownloadingRemote}
                      className="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-white font-bold text-[11px] flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 transition cursor-pointer shadow-xs disabled:opacity-50"
                      style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--color-primary)' }}
                      title="Download image and store directly into /admin/storage engine"
                    >
                      <RefreshCw className={`h-3 w-3 ${isDownloadingRemote ? 'animate-spin' : ''}`} />
                      <span>{isDownloadingRemote ? t('downloadingRemote', 'Downloading...') : t('downloadRemoteBtn', 'Sync Image')}</span>
                    </button>
                  )}
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Title, Description & Metadata */}
              <div 
                className="border rounded-2xl p-6 space-y-4 text-xs shadow-xs"
                style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--color-card)', borderColor: 'var(--color-border)' }}
              >
                <div>
                  <label className="block font-bold mb-1.5" style={{ color: 'var(--color-text)' }}>
                    {t('recipeTitleRequired', 'Recipe Title *')}
                  </label>
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    autoComplete="off"
                    data-lpignore="true"
                    data-form-type="other"
                    spellCheck="false"
                    placeholder={t('recipeTitlePlaceholder', 'e.g. Authentic Pad Thai')}
                    value={form.title}
                    onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, title: e.target.value })}
                    className="w-full border rounded-xl p-3.5 text-sm outline-none transition font-bold"
                    style={{
                      backgroundColor: 'var(--color-inner-dark)',
                      borderColor: 'var(--color-border)',
                      color: 'var(--color-text)'
                    }}
                    onFocus={(e) => (e.currentTarget.style.borderColor = 'var(--color-primary)')}
                    onBlur={(e) => (e.currentTarget.style.borderColor = 'var(--color-border)')}
                  />
                </div>

                <div>
                  <label className="block font-bold mb-1.5" style={{ color: 'var(--color-text)' }}>
                    {t('description', 'Description & Story')}
                  </label>
                  <textarea
                    rows={3}
                    autoComplete="off"
                    data-lpignore="true"
                    data-form-type="other"
                    spellCheck="false"
                    placeholder={t('descriptionPlaceholder', 'Describe the taste, occasion, or special culinary techniques...')}
                    value={form.description}
                    onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, description: e.target.value })}
                    className="w-full border rounded-xl p-3.5 text-xs outline-none resize-y transition font-medium"
                    style={{
                      backgroundColor: 'var(--color-inner-dark)',
                      borderColor: 'var(--color-border)',
                      color: 'var(--color-text)'
                    }}
                    onFocus={(e) => (e.currentTarget.style.borderColor = 'var(--color-primary)')}

                <button

                >
                  <Save className="h-4 w-4" /> 
                  {saving ? t('savingRecipe', 'Saving to Database...') : t('saveRecipe', 'Save Recipe to Library')}
                </button>
              </div>

          )}

        </div>
      </div>

}

import { useTranslation } from '@/components/LanguageProvider';
import FontAwesomeIcon from '@/components/FontAwesomeIcon';

type SocialProvider = 'google' | 'facebook' | 'apple';

interface SocialAccountStatus {
  id: SocialProvider;
  name: string;
  unicode: string; // f1a0, f09a, f179
  brandColor: string;
}

// Exactly mapped to requested Font Awesome unicodes
const SOCIAL_PROVIDERS: SocialAccountStatus[] = [
  { id: 'google', name: 'Google', unicode: 'f1a0', brandColor: '#EA4335' },
  { id: 'facebook', name: 'Facebook', unicode: 'f09a', brandColor: '#1877F2' },
  { id: 'apple', name: 'Apple', unicode: 'f179', brandColor: 'var(--color-text)' }
];

const CURRENCY_SYMBOLS: Record<string, string> = {
  USD: '$', EUR: '€', GBP: '£', CAD: 'CA$', AUD: 'AU$', JPY: '¥', THB: '฿'
};

const detectUserSocialProviders = (u: any): SocialProvider[] => {
  if (!u) return [];
  const providers = new Set<SocialProvider>();

  const parseProviderList = (val: any) => {
    if (!val) return;
    if (Array.isArray(val)) {
      val.forEach((p: any) => {
        const low = String(p).toLowerCase().trim();
        if (low === 'google' || low === 'facebook' || low === 'apple') providers.add(low as SocialProvider);
      });
      return;
    }
    if (typeof val === 'string') {
      let str = val.trim();
      if (str.startsWith('{') && str.endsWith('}')) str = str.slice(1, -1);
      if (str.startsWith('[') && str.endsWith(']')) {
        try {
          const parsed = JSON.parse(str);
          if (Array.isArray(parsed)) {
            parsed.forEach((p: any) => {
              const low = String(p).toLowerCase().trim();
              if (low === 'google' || low === 'facebook' || low === 'apple') providers.add(low as SocialProvider);
            });
            return;
          }
        } catch (_) {}
      }
      str.split(',').forEach(item => {
        const clean = item.replace(/["'{}]/g, '').toLowerCase().trim();
        if (clean === 'google' || clean === 'facebook' || clean === 'apple') providers.add(clean as SocialProvider);
      });
    }
  };

  parseProviderList(u.linkedProviders);
  parseProviderList(u.linked_providers);

  const mainProv = String(
    u.provider || u.authProvider || u.auth_provider || 
    u.socialProvider || u.social_provider || 
    u.oauthProvider || u.oauth_provider || 
    u.loginMethod || u.login_method || ''
  ).toLowerCase();
  if (mainProv.includes('google')) providers.add('google');
  if (mainProv.includes('facebook')) providers.add('facebook');
  if (mainProv.includes('apple')) providers.add('apple');

  const uid = String(u.id || '').toLowerCase();
  if (uid.startsWith('usr_g_') || uid.startsWith('usr_goog') || uid.startsWith('g_') || uid.includes('google')) providers.add('google');
  if (uid.startsWith('usr_fb_') || uid.startsWith('usr_f_') || uid.startsWith('fb_') || uid.includes('facebook')) providers.add('facebook');
  if (uid.startsWith('usr_apple') || uid.startsWith('usr_a_') || uid.startsWith('apple_') || uid.includes('apple')) providers.add('apple');

  return Array.from(providers);
};

const getActiveLoginProvider = (u: any): SocialProvider | null => {
  if (!u) return null;
  const mainProv = String(
    u.provider || u.authProvider || u.auth_provider || 
    u.socialProvider || u.social_provider || 
    u.oauthProvider || u.oauth_provider || 
    u.loginMethod || u.login_method || ''
  ).toLowerCase();
  if (mainProv.includes('google')) return 'google';
  if (mainProv.includes('facebook')) return 'facebook';
  if (mainProv.includes('apple')) return 'apple';

  const uid = String(u.id || '').toLowerCase();
  if (uid.startsWith('usr_g_') || uid.startsWith('usr_goog') || uid.startsWith('g_') || uid.includes('google')) return 'google';
  if (uid.startsWith('usr_fb_') || uid.startsWith('usr_f_') || uid.startsWith('fb_') || uid.includes('facebook')) return 'facebook';
  if (uid.startsWith('usr_apple') || uid.startsWith('usr_a_') || uid.startsWith('apple_') || uid.includes('apple')) return 'apple';

  const detected = detectUserSocialProviders(u);
  if (detected.length > 0 && (!u.password || u.password === '')) {
    return detected[0];
  }
  return null;
};

function ProfileContent() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const searchParams = useSearchParams();
  const { t } = useTranslation();

  const [currentUser, setCurrentUser] = useState<User | null>(null);
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<'overview' | 'tokens' | 'wallet'>('overview');

  // Form State (Autofill Safe)
  const [name, setName] = useState<string>('');
  const [email, setEmail] = useState<string>('');
  const [newPassword, setNewPassword] = useState<string>('');
  const [confirmPassword, setConfirmPassword] = useState<string>('');
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState<boolean>(true);
  const [toastMessage, setToastMessage] = useState<{ type: 'success' | 'error'; text: string } | null>(null);

  // Balances & Currency
  const [tokenBalance, setTokenBalance] = useState<number>(50);
  const [walletBalance, setWalletBalance] = useState<number>(0.00);
  const [currencySymbol, setCurrencySymbol] = useState<string>('$');
  const [stats, setStats] = useState({ totalDeducted: 0, totalGranted: 0, totalEvents: 0 });

  // Social Login Enabled Config
  const [socialConfig, setSocialConfig] = useState({ google: true, facebook: true, apple: true });

  // Modals State
  const [unlinkModalProvider, setUnlinkModalProvider] = useState<SocialAccountStatus | null>(null);
  const [linkModalProvider, setLinkModalProvider] = useState<SocialAccountStatus | null>(null);
  const [showDeleteModal, setShowDeleteModal] = useState<boolean>(false);

  // Tab 2 & 3 Ledger State
  const [tabTransactions, setTabTransactions] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [tabSearch, setTabSearch] = useState<string>('');
  const [tabTypeFilter, setTabTypeFilter] = useState<string>('all');
  const [tabLimit, setTabLimit] = useState<number>(10);
  const [tabTotalPages, setTabTotalPages] = useState<number>(1);
  const [tabTotalCount, setTabTotalCount] = useState<number>(0);

  // Re-entrancy guards
  const isFetchingRef = useRef<boolean>(false);
  const syncTimeoutRef = useRef<any>(null);

  const showToast = (text: string, type: 'success' | 'error' = 'success') => {
    setToastMessage({ type, text });
    setTimeout(() => setToastMessage(null), 3800);
  };

  // 1. Fetch User Data & Balances Idempotently
  const fetchProfileData = useCallback(async (activeUser: User | null) => {
    if (isFetchingRef.current) return;
    isFetchingRef.current = true;
    setLoading(true);

    const targetUserId = activeUser?.id || 'usr_admin_1';
    const targetEmail = activeUser?.email || 'admin@zecratary.com';

    try {
      if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
        const cur = localStorage.getItem('zecratary_currency') || 'USD';
        setCurrencySymbol(CURRENCY_SYMBOLS[cur] || '$');
      }

      // Fetch User & Social Config
      try {
        const sRes = await fetch('/api/admin/settings', { cache: 'no-store' });
        if (sRes.ok) {
          const sData = await sRes.json();
          const sc = sData?.socialLogin || sData?.settings?.socialLogin;
          if (sc) {
            setSocialConfig({
              google: sc.google?.enabled !== false,
              facebook: sc.facebook?.enabled !== false,
              apple: sc.apple?.enabled !== false
            });
          }
        }
      } catch (_) {}

      // Fetch Balances & Telemetry
      try {
        const tRes = await fetch(`/api/tokens?userId=${encodeURIComponent(targetUserId)}&email=${encodeURIComponent(targetEmail)}&limit=1`, { cache: 'no-store' });
        if (tRes.ok) {
          const tData = await tRes.json();
          if (tData.success) {
            if (tData.balance !== undefined) setTokenBalance(Number(tData.balance));
            if (tData.stats) setStats(tData.stats);
          }
        }
      } catch (_) {}

      try {
        const wRes = await fetch(`/api/wallet?userId=${encodeURIComponent(targetUserId)}&email=${encodeURIComponent(targetEmail)}&limit=1`, { cache: 'no-store' });
        if (wRes.ok) {
          const wData = await wRes.json();
          const wBal = typeof wData.wallet_balance === 'number' 
            ? wData.wallet_balance 
            : (typeof wData.balance === 'number' ? wData.balance : Number(wData.user?.wallet_balance || 0));
          setWalletBalance(wBal);
          if (wData.settings?.currency) setCurrencySymbol(CURRENCY_SYMBOLS[wData.settings.currency] || '$');
        }
      } catch (_) {}

    } catch (err) {
      console.warn('[ProfilePage] Fetch notice:', err);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
      isFetchingRef.current = false;
    }
  }, []);

  const fetchRef = useRef(fetchProfileData);
  useEffect(() => {
    fetchRef.current = fetchProfileData;
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    document.title = `${t('accountProfileTitle', 'User Profile & Account')} - Zecratary`;
  }, [t]);

  // Initial Mount Effect
  useEffect(() => {
    initAuthStorage();
    const u = getCurrentUser();
    if (!u) {
      router.replace('/login');
      return;
    }
    setCurrentUser(u);
    setName(u.name || '');
    setEmail(u.email || '');

    // Check OAuth Return Parameters
    const verifyProvider = searchParams?.get('verify_link');
    const isVerified = searchParams?.get('verified') === 'true';
    if (verifyProvider && isVerified) {
      showToast(`Successfully verified and linked ${verifyProvider.toUpperCase()} account!`, 'success');
      try {
        window.history.replaceState({}, '', '/profile');
      } catch (_) {}
    }

    fetchRef.current(u);

    const handleDebouncedSync = () => {
      if (syncTimeoutRef.current) clearTimeout(syncTimeoutRef.current);
      syncTimeoutRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
        const active = getCurrentUser();
        if (active) {
          setCurrentUser(active);
          setName(active.name || '');
          setEmail(active.email || '');
          fetchRef.current(active);
        }
      }, 300);
    };

    window.addEventListener('storage', handleDebouncedSync);
    window.addEventListener('zecratary_users_updated', handleDebouncedSync);
    window.addEventListener('zecratary_tokens_updated', handleDebouncedSync);
    window.addEventListener('zecratary_wallet_updated', handleDebouncedSync);
    window.addEventListener('zecratary_languages_updated', handleDebouncedSync);
    window.addEventListener('zecratary_dictionary_updated', handleDebouncedSync);
    window.addEventListener('zecratary_locale_changed', handleDebouncedSync);

    return () => {
      if (syncTimeoutRef.current) clearTimeout(syncTimeoutRef.current);
      window.removeEventListener('storage', handleDebouncedSync);
      window.removeEventListener('zecratary_users_updated', handleDebouncedSync);
      window.removeEventListener('zecratary_tokens_updated', handleDebouncedSync);
      window.removeEventListener('zecratary_wallet_updated', handleDebouncedSync);
      window.removeEventListener('zecratary_languages_updated', handleDebouncedSync);
      window.removeEventListener('zecratary_dictionary_updated', handleDebouncedSync);
      window.removeEventListener('zecratary_locale_changed', handleDebouncedSync);
    };
  }, []); // Mount strictly once: []

  // 2. Fetch Ledger Records on Tab 2 (Tokens) or Tab 3 (Wallet)
  const fetchLedgerData = useCallback(async (targetPage = 1, currentTab = activeTab, query = tabSearch, filter = tabTypeFilter) => {
    if (currentTab === 'overview' || !currentUser) return;

    const targetUserId = currentUser.id || 'usr_admin_1';
    const targetEmail = currentUser.email || 'admin@zecratary.com';

    try {
      if (currentTab === 'tokens') {
        const qParams = new URLSearchParams({
          userId: targetUserId,
          email: targetEmail,
          page: String(targetPage),
          limit: String(tabLimit),
          search: query,
          type: filter
        });
        const res = await fetch(`/api/tokens?${qParams.toString()}`, { cache: 'no-store' });
        if (res.ok) {
          const data = await res.json();
          if (data.success) {
            setTabTransactions(data.transactions || []);
            setTabTotalPages(data.totalPages || 1);
            setTabTotalCount(data.totalCount || 0);
          }
        }
      } else if (currentTab === 'wallet') {
        const qParams = new URLSearchParams({
          userId: targetUserId,
          email: targetEmail,
          page: String(targetPage),
          limit: String(tabLimit),
          search: query,
          type: filter
        });
        const res = await fetch(`/api/wallet?${qParams.toString()}`, { cache: 'no-store' });
        if (res.ok) {
          const data = await res.json();
          if (data.success) {
            setTabTransactions(data.transactions || []);
            setTabTotalPages(data.totalPages || 1);
            setTabTotalCount(data.totalCount || 0);
          }
        }
      }
    } catch (_) {}
  }, [currentUser, activeTab, tabSearch, tabTypeFilter, tabLimit]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (activeTab !== 'overview') {
      fetchLedgerData(1, activeTab, tabSearch, tabTypeFilter);
    }
  }, [activeTab, tabSearch, tabTypeFilter, fetchLedgerData]);

  // Social Identity Detection
  const linkedProviders = useMemo(() => {
    return detectUserSocialProviders(currentUser);
  }, [currentUser]);

  const activeLoginProvider = useMemo(() => {
    return getActiveLoginProvider(currentUser);
  }, [currentUser]);

  // Save Profile Credentials
  const handleSaveProfile = async () => {
    if (newPassword && newPassword !== confirmPassword) {
      showToast(t('passwordMismatchError', 'New passwords do not match.'), 'error');
      return;
    }
    if (!currentUser || submitting) return;
    setSubmitting(true);

    try {
      const payload: any = {
        id: currentUser.id,
        email: currentUser.email,
        name: name.trim()
      };
      if (newPassword) payload.password = newPassword;

      const res = await fetch('/api/admin/users', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify(payload)
      });

      const data = await res.json();
      if (!res.ok || !data.success) {
        throw new Error(data.error || 'Failed to save profile changes.');
      }

      const updatedUser = {
        ...currentUser,
        name: name.trim()
      };
      setCurrentUser(updatedUser);

      if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
        localStorage.setItem('zecratary_user', JSON.stringify(updatedUser));
        window.dispatchEvent(new Event('zecratary_users_updated'));
        window.dispatchEvent(new Event('storage'));
      }

      setNewPassword('');
      setConfirmPassword('');
      showToast(t('profileSavedSuccessToast', 'Profile updated successfully!'), 'success');
    } catch (err: any) {
      showToast(err.message || 'Error saving profile.', 'error');
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  // Social Account Linking Flow
  const handleInitiateLink = (providerObj: SocialAccountStatus) => {
    if (!socialConfig[providerObj.id]) {
      showToast(`${providerObj.name} login is disabled by the administrator.`, 'error');
      return;
    }
    setLinkModalProvider(providerObj);
  };

  const handleConfirmVerifyLink = () => {
    if (!linkModalProvider) return;
    const provider = linkModalProvider.id;
    setLinkModalProvider(null);

    // Direct to OAuth Provider Link Handshake
    const returnUrl = encodeURIComponent(`${window.location.origin}/profile?verify_link=${provider}&verified=true`);
    window.location.href = `/api/auth/login/${provider}?action=link&callbackUrl=${returnUrl}`;
  };

  // Social Account Unlinking Flow
  const handleInitiateUnlink = (providerObj: SocialAccountStatus) => {
    const isPrimary = activeLoginProvider === providerObj.id;
    if (isPrimary && (!currentUser?.password || currentUser?.password === '')) {
      showToast(
        (t('unlinkActiveProviderError', 'Cannot unlink {provider}: This is your active social login method. Please set a password first before disconnecting.'))
          .replace('{provider}', providerObj.name),
        'error'
      );
      return;
    }
    setUnlinkModalProvider(providerObj);
  };

  const handleConfirmUnlink = async () => {
    if (!unlinkModalProvider || !currentUser) return;
    const provider = unlinkModalProvider.id;
    setUnlinkModalProvider(null);

    const updatedProviders = linkedProviders.filter(p => p !== provider);
    const updatedUser = {
      ...currentUser,
      linkedProviders: updatedProviders,
      linked_providers: updatedProviders
    };

    setCurrentUser(updatedUser);

    try {
      await fetch('/api/admin/users', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          ...updatedUser,
          action: 'unlink_provider',
          providerToUnlink: provider
        })
      });

      if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
        localStorage.setItem('zecratary_user', JSON.stringify(updatedUser));
        window.dispatchEvent(new Event('zecratary_users_updated'));
      }
      showToast(`Disconnected ${unlinkModalProvider.name} account successfully.`, 'success');
    } catch (_) {
      showToast('Error updating account providers.', 'error');
    }
  };

  // Delete Account
  const handleConfirmDeleteAccount = async () => {
    if (!currentUser) return;
    setShowDeleteModal(false);

    try {
      await fetch(`/api/admin/users?id=${encodeURIComponent(currentUser.id)}`, { method: 'DELETE' });
      logoutUser();
      window.location.href = '/login';
    } catch (_) {
      showToast('Error deleting account.', 'error');
    }
  };

  return (
    <div 
      className="max-w-6xl mx-auto space-y-6 pb-24 px-4 font-sans transition-colors duration-200"
      style={{ color: 'var(--color-text)' }}
    >
      {/* Toast Alert Banner */}
      {toastMessage && (
        <div 
          className="fixed top-20 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 z-50 px-5 py-2.5 rounded-2xl text-xs font-bold shadow-2xl flex items-center gap-2 animate-in fade-in slide-in-from-top-3 border"
          style={{
            backgroundColor: 'var(--color-card)',
            borderColor: toastMessage.type === 'success' ? 'var(--color-emerald)' : '#ef4444',
            color: 'var(--color-text)'
          }}
        >
          {toastMessage.type === 'success' ? (
            <CheckCircle2 className="h-4 w-4" style={{ color: 'var(--color-emerald)' }} />
          ) : (
            <AlertCircle className="h-4 w-4 text-red-500" />
          )}
          <span>{toastMessage.text}</span>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Top Header Bar */}
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-4 border-b pb-4" style={{ borderColor: 'var(--color-border)' }}>
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-black tracking-tight" style={{ color: 'var(--color-primary)' }}>
            {t('accountProfileTitle', 'User Profile & Account')}
          </h1>
          <p className="text-xs" style={{ color: 'var(--color-text-secondary)' }}>
            {t('accountProfileSubtitle', 'Manage your personal information, security credentials, and connected accounts.')}
          </p>
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => fetchRef.current(currentUser)}
            disabled={loading}
            className="border font-bold text-xs px-3.5 py-2.5 rounded-xl transition flex items-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer shadow-xs disabled:opacity-50 hover:opacity-80"
            style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--color-inner-dark)', borderColor: 'var(--color-border)', color: 'var(--color-text)' }}
            title={t('reloadBtn', 'Reload')}
          >
            <RefreshCw className={`h-4 w-4 ${loading ? 'animate-spin' : ''}`} style={{ color: 'var(--color-primary)' }} />
            <span>{t('reloadBtn', 'Reload')}</span>
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Executive KPI Summary Cards Banner */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4">
        {/* Card 1: Token Balance */}
        <div 
          className="p-5 rounded-3xl border shadow-xs flex flex-col justify-between space-y-3"
          style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--color-card)', borderColor: 'var(--color-border)' }}
        >
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
            <span className="text-xs font-bold opacity-75">{t('currentTokens', 'Foodie Token Balance')}</span>
            <Link href="/token" className="text-[10px] font-bold text-amber-500 hover:underline">
              {t('topUpTokens', '+ Top Up')}
            </Link>
          </div>
          <div className="text-2xl font-black font-mono">
            {tokenBalance.toLocaleString()} <span className="text-amber-500 text-xs"><DynamicTokenIcon size={16} className="w-4 h-4 inline-block" /></span>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Card 2: Store Credit */}
        <div 
          className="p-5 rounded-3xl border shadow-xs flex flex-col justify-between space-y-3"
          style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--color-card)', borderColor: 'var(--color-border)' }}
        >
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
            <span className="text-xs font-bold opacity-75">{t('storeCredit', 'Store Credit')}</span>
            <Link href="/wallet" className="text-[10px] font-bold text-emerald-400 hover:underline">
              {t('addFunds', '+ Add Funds')}
            </Link>
          </div>
          <div className="text-2xl font-black font-mono text-emerald-400">
            {currencySymbol}{walletBalance.toFixed(2)}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Card 3: Membership Tier */}
        <div 
          className="p-5 rounded-3xl border shadow-xs flex flex-col justify-between space-y-3"
          style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--color-card)', borderColor: 'var(--color-border)' }}
        >
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
            <span className="text-xs font-bold opacity-75">{t('membershipTier', 'Membership Tier')}</span>
            <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[9px] font-black uppercase text-emerald-400 border border-emerald-500/30 bg-emerald-500/10">
              {t('activePlanBadge', 'ACTIVE')}
            </span>
          </div>
          <div className="text-base font-black capitalize truncate" style={{ color: 'var(--color-primary)' }}>
            {(currentUser?.subscription_plan || 'Taster').replace(/-/g, ' ')}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Card 4: Total Activity */}
        <div 
          className="p-5 rounded-3xl border shadow-xs flex flex-col justify-between space-y-3"
          style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--color-card)', borderColor: 'var(--color-border)' }}
        >
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
            <span className="text-xs font-bold opacity-75">{t('totalActivity', 'Total Activity')}</span>
            <button type="button" onClick={() => setActiveTab('tokens')} className="text-[10px] font-bold text-[var(--color-primary)] hover:underline cursor-pointer">
              {t('viewLedger', 'View Ledger')}
            </button>
          </div>
          <div className="text-2xl font-black font-mono">
            {stats.totalEvents || stats.totalDeducted || 0}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Tab Navigation Switcher */}
      <div 
        className="flex p-1.5 rounded-2xl border shadow-xs"
        style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--color-inner-dark)', borderColor: 'var(--color-border)' }}
      >
        {[
          { id: 'overview', label: t('profileOverviewTab', 'Profile Overview'), icon: UserIcon },
          { id: 'tokens', label: t('tokenLedgerTab', 'Token Transactions'), icon: Coins },
          { id: 'wallet', label: t('walletLedgerTab', 'Wallet Transactions'), icon: Wallet }
        ].map(tab => {
          const isActive = activeTab === tab.id;
          return (
            <button
              key={tab.id}
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setActiveTab(tab.id as any)}
              className="flex-1 py-2.5 text-xs font-bold rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center gap-2 transition cursor-pointer border"
              style={isActive ? {
                backgroundColor: 'var(--color-card)',
                color: 'var(--color-primary)',
                borderColor: 'var(--color-border)'
              } : {
                backgroundColor: 'transparent',
                borderColor: 'transparent',
                color: 'var(--color-text-secondary)'
              }}
            >
              <tab.icon className="h-4 w-4" />
              <span>{tab.label}</span>
            </button>
          );
        })}
      </div>

      {/* TAB 1: PROFILE OVERVIEW (Form-Free Container, Constraint 9) */}
      {activeTab === 'overview' && (
        <div 
          role="region"
          data-lpignore="true"
          className="space-y-6 animate-in fade-in"
        >
          {/* Section 1: Credentials & Information */}
          <div 
            className="p-6 rounded-3xl border shadow-sm space-y-5"
            style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--color-card)', borderColor: 'var(--color-border)' }}
          >
            <h3 className="font-extrabold text-sm border-b pb-3" style={{ borderColor: 'var(--color-border)', color: 'var(--color-primary)' }}>
              {t('personalInfoHeading', 'Personal Information')}
            </h3>

            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-4 text-xs">
              <div>
                <label className="block font-bold mb-1 opacity-80">{t('fullNameLabel', 'Full Name')}</label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  autoComplete="off"
                  data-lpignore="true"
                  data-form-type="other"
                  spellCheck="false"
                  placeholder={t('fullNamePlaceholder', 'Enter your full name')}
                  value={name}
                  onChange={(e) => setName(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full border rounded-xl p-2.5 text-xs outline-none font-bold"
                  style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--color-inner-dark)', borderColor: 'var(--color-border)', color: 'var(--color-text)' }}
                />
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="block font-bold mb-1 opacity-80">{t('emailAddressLabel', 'Email Address')}</label>
                <input
                  type="email"
                  disabled
                  value={email}
                  className="w-full border rounded-xl p-2.5 text-xs outline-none font-bold opacity-60 cursor-not-allowed"
                  style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--color-inner-dark)', borderColor: 'var(--color-border)', color: 'var(--color-text)' }}
                />
                <span className="text-[10px] opacity-60 mt-1 block">{t('emailNote', 'Email address cannot be changed directly.')}</span>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="pt-3 border-t space-y-3" style={{ borderColor: 'var(--color-border)' }}>
              <h4 className="font-extrabold text-xs uppercase tracking-wider text-[var(--color-primary)]">
                {t('securityCredentialsHeading', 'Security & Password')}
              </h4>

              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-4 text-xs">
                <div>
                  <label className="block font-bold mb-1 opacity-80">{t('newPasswordLabel', 'New Password')}</label>
                  <input
                    type="password"
                    autoComplete="off"
                    data-lpignore="true"
                    data-form-type="other"
                    spellCheck="false"
                    placeholder={t('newPasswordPlaceholder', 'Leave blank to keep current password')}
                    value={newPassword}
                    onChange={(e) => setNewPassword(e.target.value)}
                    className="w-full border rounded-xl p-2.5 text-xs outline-none"
                    style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--color-inner-dark)', borderColor: 'var(--color-border)', color: 'var(--color-text)' }}
                  />
                </div>

                <div>
                  <label className="block font-bold mb-1 opacity-80">{t('confirmPasswordLabel', 'Confirm New Password')}</label>
                  <input
                    type="password"
                    autoComplete="off"
                    data-lpignore="true"
                    data-form-type="other"
                    spellCheck="false"
                    placeholder={t('confirmPasswordPlaceholder', 'Confirm your new password')}
                    value={confirmPassword}
                    onChange={(e) => setConfirmPassword(e.target.value)}
                    className="w-full border rounded-xl p-2.5 text-xs outline-none"
                    style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--color-inner-dark)', borderColor: 'var(--color-border)', color: 'var(--color-text)' }}
                  />
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="flex justify-end pt-2 border-t" style={{ borderColor: 'var(--color-border)' }}>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={handleSaveProfile}
                disabled={submitting}
                className="px-6 py-2.5 text-white font-bold text-xs rounded-xl shadow cursor-pointer hover:opacity-90 disabled:opacity-40"
                style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--color-primary)' }}
              >

              </p>
            </div>

            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
              {SOCIAL_PROVIDERS.map(prov => {
                const isPrimary = activeLoginProvider === prov.id;

                const isEnabledByAdmin = socialConfig[prov.id];

                return (
                  <div
                    key={prov.id}
                    className="p-4 rounded-2xl border flex flex-col justify-between space-y-3 shadow-xs"
                    style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--color-inner-dark)', borderColor: 'var(--color-border)' }}
                  >
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">

                        <div 
                          className="w-9 h-9 rounded-xl border flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 shadow-xs"
                          style={{
                            backgroundColor: 'var(--color-card)',
                            borderColor: 'var(--color-border)'
                          }}
                        >
                          <FontAwesomeIcon
                            unicode={prov.unicode}
                            name={prov.id}
                            size={18}
                            className="shrink-0"
                            style={{
                              color: prov.id === 'google'

                          />
                        </div>

                        <div>
                          <span className="font-bold text-xs block" style={{ color: 'var(--color-text)' }}>{prov.name}</span>
                          {!isEnabledByAdmin && (
                            <span className="text-[9px] text-amber-500 font-bold block">
                              ({t('disabledByAdmin', 'Disabled by Admin')})
                            </span>
                          )}
                        </div>
                      </div>

                      <span className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[9px] font-black uppercase tracking-wider border ${
                        isLinked 
                          ? 'text-emerald-400 border-emerald-500/30 bg-emerald-500/10' 
                          : 'opacity-50 border-slate-700'
                      }`}>
                        {isPrimary 
                          ? t('linkedLoginMethod', 'Linked (Login Method)') 
                          : isLinked 
                          ? t('linked', 'Linked') 
                          : t('notLinked', 'Not Linked')}
                      </span>
                    </div>

                    <div>
                      {isLinked ? (
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => handleInitiateUnlink(prov)}
                          className="w-full py-2 rounded-xl border text-[11px] font-bold text-red-400 hover:bg-red-500/10 transition cursor-pointer"

                        </button>
                      ) : (

                          disabled={!isEnabledByAdmin}
                          className="w-full py-2 rounded-xl text-[11px] font-bold transition shadow cursor-pointer text-white hover:opacity-90 disabled:opacity-40"
                          style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--color-primary)' }}

                          {t('linkBtn', 'Link')}

                      )}
                    </div>

                );
              })}
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Section 3: Danger Zone */}
          <div

              </p>

                  className="px-5 py-2 text-white font-bold rounded-xl shadow cursor-pointer bg-red-600 hover:bg-red-700"
                >
                  {t('confirmDeleteBtn', 'Permanently Delete Account')}
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

export default function ProfilePage() {
  return (
    <Suspense fallback={
      <div className="p-12 text-center text-xs opacity-50">
        Loading Profile...
      </div>
    }>
      <ProfileContent />
    </Suspense>
  );
}

      window.dispatchEvent(new Event('zecratary_theme_updated'));
    } catch (_) {}
  }, []);

  const getCleanRecipeType = (rec: any): string => {
    const raw = rec.recipeType || rec.category || (Array.isArray(rec.tags) ? rec.tags[0] : 'Main Dish');
    if (raw === 'Appetizer' || raw === 'Appetiser') return 'Appetiser';
    if (RECIPE_TYPES.includes(raw)) return raw;
    return 'Main Dish';
  };

  const getSafeHostname = (urlStr: string) => {
    if (!urlStr || typeof urlStr !== 'string') return 'source website';
    try {
      const normalized = urlStr.startsWith('http://') || urlStr.startsWith('https://') 
        ? urlStr 
        : `https://${urlStr}`;
      return new URL(normalized).hostname.replace('www.', '');
    } catch {
      return urlStr.replace(/^https?:\/\//i, '').replace(/^www\./i, '').split('/')[0] || 'source website';
    }
  };

  const getSafeHref = (urlStr: string) => {
    if (!urlStr) return '#';
    if (urlStr.startsWith('http://') || urlStr.startsWith('https://')) return urlStr;
    return `https://${urlStr}`;
  };

  const loadData = useCallback(async (user: User | null) => {
    if (!user) return;
    setCategories(getStoredCategories());
    const targetUserId = (user.id || 'usr_admin_1').trim();

    try {
      setLoading(true);
      const rawRecipes = await syncUserSavedRecipes(targetUserId);

      const userRecipes = rawRecipes.map((r: any) => {
        const cleanType = getCleanRecipeType(r);
        return {
          ...r,
          userId: targetUserId,
          recipeType: cleanType,
          category: cleanType,
          bookId: r.book_id || r.bookId || null,
          isFavorite: Boolean(r.is_favorite || r.isFavorite),
          is_favorite: Boolean(r.is_favorite || r.isFavorite),
          isCooked: Boolean(r.is_cooked || r.isCooked),
          is_cooked: Boolean(r.is_cooked || r.isCooked),
          rating: Number(r.rating) || 0,
          note: r.note || '',
          sourceUrl: r.source_url || r.sourceUrl || '',
          source_url: r.source_url || r.sourceUrl || '',
          tags: [cleanType, ...(Array.isArray(r.tags) ? r.tags.filter((t: string) => t !== 'Imported' && t !== cleanType) : [])]
        };
      });

      setRecipes(userRecipes);

      let parsedBooks = defaultBooks;
      try {
        const bRes = await fetch(`/api/books?userId=${encodeURIComponent(targetUserId)}`, { cache: 'no-store' });
        if (bRes.ok) {
          const bData = await bRes.json();
          if (Array.isArray(bData.books) && bData.books.length > 0) parsedBooks = bData.books;
        }
      } catch (_) {}

      const localBooks = localStorage.getItem('zecratary_recipe_books') || localStorage.getItem('zecratary_cookbooks');
      if (localBooks) {
        try {
          const parsed = JSON.parse(localBooks);
          if (Array.isArray(parsed) && parsed.length > 0) parsedBooks = parsed;
        } catch (_) {}
      }

      const userBooks = parsedBooks.filter((b: any) => {
        if (!b.userId && !b.createdBy) return true;
        if (b.userId) return b.userId === targetUserId;
        return b.createdBy === user.email || b.createdBy === targetUserId;
      });

      setBooks(userBooks.map((b: any) => ({
        ...b,
        recipeCount: userRecipes.filter((r: any) => r.bookId === b.id || (Array.isArray(b.recipeIds) && b.recipeIds.includes(r.id))).length
      })));
    } catch (e) {
      console.error('[RecipesPage] Load error:', e);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    applyGlobalTheme();
    window.addEventListener('zecratary_theme_mode_changed', applyGlobalTheme);
    window.addEventListener('zecratary_theme_changed', applyGlobalTheme);
    window.addEventListener('zecratary_theme_updated', applyGlobalTheme);
    window.addEventListener('storage', applyGlobalTheme);

    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('zecratary_theme_mode_changed', applyGlobalTheme);
      window.removeEventListener('zecratary_theme_changed', applyGlobalTheme);
      window.removeEventListener('zecratary_theme_updated', applyGlobalTheme);
      window.removeEventListener('storage', applyGlobalTheme);
    };
  }, [applyGlobalTheme]);

  useEffect(() => {
    document.title = `${t('recipesTitle') || t('savedRecipesTitle') || 'Recipes'} - FoodiePrep`;
    initAuthStorage();
    const user = getCurrentUser();
    if (!user) {
      router.replace('/login');
      return;
    }
    setCurrentUser(user);
    loadData(user);

    const handleSync = () => {
      const activeUser = getCurrentUser();
      if (activeUser) {
        setCurrentUser(activeUser);
        loadData(activeUser);
      }
    };

    window.addEventListener('zecratary_saved_recipes_updated', handleSync);
    window.addEventListener('zecratary_recipes_updated', handleSync);
    window.addEventListener('zecratary_recipe_books_updated', handleSync);
    window.addEventListener('zecratary_categories_changed', handleSync);
    window.addEventListener('zecratary_auth_changed', handleSync);
    window.addEventListener('storage', handleSync);

    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('zecratary_saved_recipes_updated', handleSync);
      window.removeEventListener('zecratary_recipes_updated', handleSync);
      window.removeEventListener('zecratary_recipe_books_updated', handleSync);
      window.removeEventListener('zecratary_categories_changed', handleSync);
      window.removeEventListener('zecratary_auth_changed', handleSync);
      window.removeEventListener('storage', handleSync);
    };

  const saveAllRecipes = (updatedUserList: any[]) => {
    if (!currentUser) return;
    const targetUserId = currentUser.id || 'usr_admin_1';

    const updatedWithId = updatedUserList.map(r => ({
      ...r,
      userId: targetUserId,
      user_id: targetUserId,
      bookId: r.bookId || r.book_id || null,
      book_id: r.bookId || r.book_id || null,
      isFavorite: Boolean(r.isFavorite ?? r.is_favorite),
      is_favorite: Boolean(r.isFavorite ?? r.is_favorite),
      isCooked: Boolean(r.isCooked ?? r.is_cooked),
      is_cooked: Boolean(r.isCooked ?? r.is_cooked),
      rating: Number(r.rating) || 0,
      note: r.note || '',
      sourceUrl: r.sourceUrl || r.source_url || '',
      source_url: r.sourceUrl || r.source_url || ''
    }));

    setRecipes(updatedWithId);

    persistSavedRecipe(targetUserId, updatedWithId).then(() => {
      if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
        window.dispatchEvent(new Event('zecratary_recipes_updated'));
      }
    }).catch((err) => {
      console.error('[RecipesPage] Error saving recipes:', err);
    });

    const updatedBooks = books.map((b: any) => ({
      ...b,
      recipeCount: updatedWithId.filter((r: any) => r.bookId === b.id || (Array.isArray(b.recipeIds) && b.recipeIds.includes(r.id))).length
    }));
    setBooks(updatedBooks);
  };

  const toggleFavorite = async (e: React.MouseEvent, id: string) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    const target = recipes.find(r => r.id === id);
    if (!target) return;
    const newFav = !target.isFavorite;

    const updated = recipes.map(r => r.id === id ? { ...r, isFavorite: newFav, is_favorite: newFav } : r);
    setRecipes(updated);

    if (selectedRecipe?.id === id) {
      setSelectedRecipe({ ...selectedRecipe, isFavorite: newFav, is_favorite: newFav });
    }

    saveAllRecipes(updated);

    try {
      await fetch('/api/recipes/saved', {
        method: 'PATCH',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ id, isFavorite: newFav, is_favorite: newFav })
      });
      window.dispatchEvent(new Event('zecratary_recipes_updated'));
    } catch (_) {}
  };

  const toggleCooked = async (e: React.MouseEvent, id: string) => {
    e.stopPropagation();

    if (!target) return;
    const newCooked = !target.isCooked;

    const updated = recipes.map(r => r.id === id ? { ...r, isCooked: newCooked, is_cooked: newCooked } : r);
    setRecipes(updated);

    if (selectedRecipe?.id === id) {
      setSelectedRecipe({ ...selectedRecipe, isCooked: newCooked, is_cooked: newCooked });
    }

    saveAllRecipes(updated);

    try {
      await fetch('/api/recipes/saved', {
        method: 'PATCH',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ id, isCooked: newCooked, is_cooked: newCooked })
      });
      window.dispatchEvent(new Event('zecratary_recipes_updated'));
    } catch (_) {}
  };

        method: 'PATCH',

        body: JSON.stringify({ id: selectedRecipe.id, bookId: targetBookId, book_id: targetBookId })
      });

      window.dispatchEvent(new Event('zecratary_saved_recipes_updated'));
      window.dispatchEvent(new Event('zecratary_recipe_books_updated'));

  const openAddToPlanModal = () => {
    const todayStr = new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0];
    setPlanDate(todayStr);

  const handleSaveToCalendar = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!selectedRecipe || !currentUser) return;

    const recName = selectedRecipe.title || selectedRecipe.name || 'Untitled Recipe';
    const recImage = selectedRecipe.imageUrl || selectedRecipe.image || selectedRecipe.image_url || 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1559847844-5315695dadae?auto=format&fit=crop&w=1000&q=80';
    const targetUserId = currentUser.id || 'usr_admin_1';

    const newPlanItem = {
      id: 'plan_' + Date.now() + '_' + Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 7),
      userId: targetUserId,
      user_id: targetUserId,
      createdBy: currentUser.email || 'user@zecratary.local',
      creatorName: currentUser.name || 'User',
      date: planDate,
      recipeId: selectedRecipe.id,
      recipe_id: selectedRecipe.id,
      recipeName: recName,
      title: recName,
      image: recImage,
      imageUrl: recImage,
      image_url: recImage,
      mealType: planMealType,
      time: planTime || '',
      notes: planNotes || '',
      servings: currentTotalServings || selectedRecipe.servings || 4,
      prepTimeMinutes: selectedRecipe.prepTimeMinutes || 15,
      cookTimeMinutes: selectedRecipe.cookTimeMinutes || 25,
      recipe: selectedRecipe,
      isLeftover: false,
      createdAt: new Date().toISOString()
    };

    try {
      const planKeys = ['zecratary_meal_plan', 'zecratary_meal_plans'];
      for (const k of planKeys) {
        const raw = localStorage.getItem(k);
        const currentPlan = raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : [];
        const updated = Array.isArray(currentPlan) ? [...currentPlan, newPlanItem] : [newPlanItem];
        localStorage.setItem(k, JSON.stringify(updated));
      }
    } catch (_) {}

    try {
      await Promise.allSettled([
        fetch('/api/planner', {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
          body: JSON.stringify(newPlanItem)
        }),
        fetch('/api/meal-plans', {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
          body: JSON.stringify(newPlanItem)
        }),
        fetch('/api/meal-plan', {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
          body: JSON.stringify(newPlanItem)
        })
      ]);
    } catch (_) {}

    if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
      window.dispatchEvent(new Event('zecratary_planner_updated'));
      window.dispatchEvent(new Event('zecratary_meal_plan_updated'));
      window.dispatchEvent(new Event('zecratary_meal_plans_updated'));
      window.dispatchEvent(new Event('storage'));

  const updateSelectedRecipeState = async (key: string, val: any) => {

    if (key === 'isFavorite') updatedRec.is_favorite = val;
    if (key === 'isCooked') updatedRec.is_cooked = val;
    if (key === 'bookId') updatedRec.book_id = val;

    setSelectedRecipe(updatedRec);
    const updatedList = recipes.map(r => r.id === updatedRec.id ? updatedRec : r);
    saveAllRecipes(updatedList);

    try {
      await fetch('/api/recipes/saved', {
        method: 'PATCH',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ id: selectedRecipe.id, [key]: val })
      });
      window.dispatchEvent(new Event('zecratary_recipes_updated'));
    } catch (_) {}
  };

  const handleDeleteRecipe = async (id: string) => {
    if (!confirm(t('confirmDeleteRecipe') || 'Are you sure you want to delete this recipe?')) return;
    
    try {
      await Promise.allSettled([
        fetch(`/api/recipes/saved?id=${encodeURIComponent(id)}`, { 
          method: 'DELETE',
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
          body: JSON.stringify({ id })
        }),
        fetch(`/api/saved-recipes?id=${encodeURIComponent(id)}`, { 
          method: 'DELETE',
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
          body: JSON.stringify({ id })
        }),
        fetch(`/api/recipes?id=${encodeURIComponent(id)}`, { 
          method: 'DELETE',
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
          body: JSON.stringify({ id })
        })
      ]);

      if (typeof deleteSavedRecipe === 'function') {
        await deleteSavedRecipe(currentUser?.id || 'usr_admin_1', id).catch(() => {});
      }

      const updated = recipes.filter(r => r.id !== id);
      setRecipes(updated);
      setSelectedRecipe(null);
      setIsEditing(false);

      const updatedBooks = books.map((b: any) => ({
        ...b,
        recipeCount: updated.filter((r: any) => r.bookId === b.id || (Array.isArray(b.recipeIds) && b.recipeIds.includes(r.id))).length
      }));
      setBooks(updatedBooks);

      try {
        const localKeys = ['zecratary_saved_recipes', 'zecratary_recipes', 'zecratary_user_recipes', 'saved_recipes', 'zecratary_imported_recipes'];
        for (const k of localKeys) {
          const raw = localStorage.getItem(k);
          if (raw) {
            const arr = JSON.parse(raw);
            if (Array.isArray(arr)) {
              const cleaned = arr.filter((x: any) => x.id !== id);
              localStorage.setItem(k, JSON.stringify(cleaned));
            }
          }
        }
      } catch (_) {}

      if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
        window.dispatchEvent(new Event('zecratary_recipes_updated'));
        window.dispatchEvent(new Event('zecratary_saved_recipes_updated'));
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('[RecipesPage] Error deleting recipe:', err);
      alert(t('errorDeletingRecipe') || 'Failed to delete recipe. Please try again.');
    }
  };

  const handleImageUpload = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {

      const reader = new FileReader();
      reader.onloadend = () => {

      };
      reader.readAsDataURL(file);

  };

  const handleDragStart = (index: number) => {

  };

  const handleDragOver = (e: React.DragEvent, index: number, type: 'ingredients' | 'steps') => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (draggedIndex === null || draggedIndex === index) return;

    if (type === 'ingredients') {
      const list = [...editForm.ingredients];
      const item = list[draggedIndex];
      list.splice(draggedIndex, 1);
      list.splice(index, 0, item);
      setEditForm({ ...editForm, ingredients: list });
      setDraggedIndex(index);
    } else {
      const list = [...editForm.instructions];
      const item = list[draggedIndex];
      list.splice(draggedIndex, 1);
      list.splice(index, 0, item);
      setEditForm({ ...editForm, instructions: list });
      setDraggedIndex(index);
    }
  };

  const handleDrop = () => {

  const handleOpenEdit = () => {
    if (!selectedRecipe) return;
    const defaultCat = categories[0] || 'Produce';
    const cleanType = getCleanRecipeType(selectedRecipe);

    let rawIngredients = selectedRecipe.ingredients;
    if (typeof rawIngredients === 'string') {
      try { rawIngredients = JSON.parse(rawIngredients); } catch (_) { rawIngredients = [rawIngredients]; }
    }
    if (!Array.isArray(rawIngredients)) rawIngredients = [];

    setEditForm({
      title: selectedRecipe.title || selectedRecipe.name || '',
      description: selectedRecipe.description || '',
      recipeType: cleanType,
