```typescript
export const LanguageContext = createContext<LanguageContextType>({
  locale: 'en',
  currentLanguage: 'en',
  language: 'en',
  setLocale: () => {},
  setLanguage: () => {},
  changeLanguage: () => {},
  t: (key: string, fallback?: string) => fallback || key,
  version: 1,
  availableLanguages: DEFAULT_SUPPORTED_LANGUAGES,
  languages: DEFAULT_SUPPORTED_LANGUAGES,
  supportedLanguages: DEFAULT_SUPPORTED_LANGUAGES,
  direction: 'ltr',
  translations: BUILTIN_DICTIONARIES
});

export function LanguageProvider({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
  const [locale, setLocaleState] = useState<string>('en');
  const [translations, setTranslations] = useState<Record<string, Record<string, string>>>(BUILTIN_DICTIONARIES);
  const [supportedLanguages, setSupportedLanguages] = useState<SupportedLanguage[]>(DEFAULT_SUPPORTED_LANGUAGES);
  const [version, setVersion] = useState<number>(1);

  // Initialize from client storage
  useEffect(() => {
    if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
      try {
        const savedLocale = localStorage.getItem('zecratary_locale') || localStorage.getItem('app_lang');
        if (savedLocale && DEFAULT_SUPPORTED_LANGUAGES.some(l => l.code === savedLocale)) {
          setLocaleState(savedLocale);
          document.documentElement.lang = savedLocale;
        }
      } catch (_) {}
    }

    const loadServerTranslations = async () => {
      try {
        const res = await fetch('/api/admin/languages?t=' + Date.now(), { cache: 'no-store' });
        if (res.ok) {
          const data = await res.json();
          if (data && data.translations && typeof data.translations === 'object') {
            setTranslations(prev => {
              const next: Record<string, Record<string, string>> = { ...prev };
              for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(data.translations)) {
                if (v && typeof v === 'object') {
                  next[k] = { ...(next[k] || {}), ...(v as Record<string, string>) };
                }
              }
              return next;
            });
            setVersion(v => v + 1);
          }
          if (Array.isArray(data?.languages) && data.languages.length > 0) {
            setSupportedLanguages(data.languages);
          }
        }
      } catch (_) {}
    };

    loadServerTranslations();

    const handleSync = () => {
      loadServerTranslations();
    };

    window.addEventListener('zecratary_languages_updated', handleSync);
    window.addEventListener('zecratary_settings_updated', handleSync);
    window.addEventListener('storage', handleSync);

    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('zecratary_languages_updated', handleSync);
      window.removeEventListener('zecratary_settings_updated', handleSync);
      window.removeEventListener('storage', handleSync);
    };
  }, []);

  const setLocale = useCallback((newLocale: string) => {
    setLocaleState(newLocale);
    if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
      try {
        localStorage.setItem('zecratary_locale', newLocale);
        localStorage.setItem('app_lang', newLocale);
        document.documentElement.lang = newLocale;
        window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('zecratary_locale_changed', { detail: newLocale }));
        window.dispatchEvent(new Event('storage'));
      } catch (_) {}
    }
    setVersion(v => v + 1);
  }, []);

  const t = useCallback((key: string, fallback?: string): string => {
    if (!key) return fallback || '';
    
    // 1. Current locale in dynamic translations
    const locMap = translations[locale];
    if (locMap && typeof locMap[key] === 'string' && locMap[key].trim().length > 0) {
      return locMap[key];
    }
    
    // 2. Current locale in builtin dictionary
    const bMap = BUILTIN_DICTIONARIES[locale];
    if (bMap && typeof bMap[key] === 'string' && bMap[key].trim().length > 0) {
      return bMap[key];
    }
    
    // 3. Fallback to English dynamic
    if (locale !== 'en') {
      const enMap = translations['en'];
      if (enMap && typeof enMap[key] === 'string' && enMap[key].trim().length > 0) {
        return enMap[key];
      }
      const bEnMap = BUILTIN_DICTIONARIES['en'];
      if (bEnMap && typeof bEnMap[key] === 'string' && bEnMap[key].trim().length > 0) {
        return bEnMap[key];
      }
    }

    return fallback !== undefined ? fallback : key;
  }, [locale, translations]);

  const contextValue: LanguageContextType = useMemo(() => ({
    locale,
    currentLanguage: locale,
    language: locale,
    setLocale,
    setLanguage: setLocale,
    changeLanguage: setLocale,
    t,
    version,
    availableLanguages: supportedLanguages,
    languages: supportedLanguages,
    supportedLanguages,
    direction: (locale === 'ar' || locale === 'he') ? 'rtl' : 'ltr',
    translations
  }), [locale, setLocale, t, version, supportedLanguages, translations]);

  return (
    <LanguageContext.Provider value={contextValue}>
      {children}
    </LanguageContext.Provider>
  );
}

export function useTranslation(): LanguageContextType {
  const context = useContext(LanguageContext);
  if (!context) {
    return {
      locale: 'en',
      currentLanguage: 'en',
      language: 'en',
      setLocale: () => {},
      setLanguage: () => {},
      changeLanguage: () => {},
      t: (key: string, fallback?: string) => fallback || key,
      version: 1,
      availableLanguages: DEFAULT_SUPPORTED_LANGUAGES,
      languages: DEFAULT_SUPPORTED_LANGUAGES,
      supportedLanguages: DEFAULT_SUPPORTED_LANGUAGES,
      direction: 'ltr',
      translations: BUILTIN_DICTIONARIES
    };
  }
  return context;
}

export default LanguageProvider;
```

```typescript
'use client';

import { useState, useEffect, useCallback } from 'react';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { Sparkles, Zap, AlertCircle, ArrowUpRight } from 'lucide-react';

export default function AiQuotaBar() {
  const [quotaInfo, setQuotaInfo] = useState<{ plan: string; isUnlimited: boolean; monthlyRecipeLimit: number } | null>(null);
  const [usedCount, setUsedCount] = useState(0);
  const [isDayMode, setIsDayMode] = useState(false);

  const syncState = useCallback(() => {
    try {
      const mode = localStorage.getItem('zecratary_theme_mode');
      setIsDayMode(mode === 'light');

      // Count recipes generated this calendar month
      const rawRecipes = localStorage.getItem('zecratary_saved_recipes') || localStorage.getItem('zecratary_recipes');
      if (rawRecipes) {
        const list = JSON.parse(rawRecipes);
        const currentMonth = new Date().getMonth();
        const currentYear = new Date().getFullYear();
        const monthAiCount = list.filter((r: any) => {
          const d = r.createdAt ? new Date(r.createdAt) : new Date();
          return d.getMonth() === currentMonth && d.getFullYear() === currentYear && (r.isAiGenerated || r.generatedWithAi);
        }).length;
        setUsedCount(monthAiCount);
      }
    } catch (_) {}
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    syncState();
    fetch('/api/ai/quota')
      .then(res => res.json())
      .then(data => setQuotaInfo(data))
      .catch(() => {});

    window.addEventListener('zecratary_theme_mode_changed', syncState);
    window.addEventListener('storage', syncState);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('zecratary_theme_mode_changed', syncState);
      window.removeEventListener('storage', syncState);
    };
  }, [syncState]);

  if (!quotaInfo) return null;

  const isUnlimited = quotaInfo.isUnlimited;
  const limit = quotaInfo.monthlyRecipeLimit;
  const percent = isUnlimited ? 0 : Math.min(100, Math.round((usedCount / limit) * 100));
  const isLimitReached = !isUnlimited && usedCount >= limit;

  return (
    <div 
      className="p-3.5 rounded-2xl border mb-4 shadow-sm text-xs transition-colors duration-200"
      style={{
        backgroundColor: isDayMode ? '#ffffff' : 'var(--color-card, #0b0f17)',
        borderColor: isLimitReached 
          ? (isDayMode ? '#fca5a5' : '#7f1d1d') 
          : (isDayMode ? '#e2e8f0' : 'var(--color-border, #1e293b)')
      }}
    >
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-2.5">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          {isUnlimited ? (
            <Zap className="h-4 w-4 text-emerald-400 shrink-0" />
          ) : isLimitReached ? (
            <AlertCircle className="h-4 w-4 text-red-400 shrink-0" />
          ) : (
            <Sparkles className="h-4 w-4 text-orange-400 shrink-0" />
          )}

          <div>
            <span className="font-extrabold" style={{ color: isDayMode ? '#0f172a' : '#ffffff' }}>
              {isUnlimited ? 'Unlimited AI Recipes' : `Monthly Quota: ${usedCount} / ${limit} Recipes Used`}
            </span>
            <span className="ml-2 font-mono text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-500">
              ({quotaInfo.plan})
            </span>
          </div>
        </div>

        {!isUnlimited && (
          <Link
            href="/profile"
            className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 font-bold text-[11px] hover:underline"
            style={{ color: 'var(--color-primary, #E05638)' }}
          >
            Upgrade for Unlimited <ArrowUpRight className="h-3 w-3" />
          </Link>
        )}
      </div>

      {!isUnlimited && (
        <div className="mt-2.5 w-full bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-800 rounded-full h-2 overflow-hidden">
          <div 
            className="h-full rounded-full transition-all duration-300"
            style={{
              width: `${percent}%`,
              backgroundColor: isLimitReached ? '#ef4444' : 'var(--color-primary, #E05638)'
            }}
          />
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```typescript
'use client';

import React, { createContext, useContext, useEffect, useState } from 'react';

interface ThemeContextType {
  isDarkMode: boolean;
  toggleThemeMode: () => void;
  primaryColor: string;
  setPrimaryColor: (color: string) => void;
  updateTheme: (settings: any) => Promise<void>;
}

const ThemeContext = createContext<ThemeContextType>({
  isDarkMode: true,
  toggleThemeMode: () => {},
  primaryColor: '#E05638',
  setPrimaryColor: () => {},
  updateTheme: async () => {},
});

export function ThemeProvider({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
  const [isDarkMode, setIsDarkMode] = useState<boolean>(true);
  const [primaryColor, setPrimaryColorState] = useState<string>('#E05638');
  const [mounted, setMounted] = useState<boolean>(false);

  const applyThemeToDOM = (mode: boolean, primary: string, customColors?: any) => {
    if (typeof document === 'undefined') return;
    const root = document.documentElement;
    root.classList.toggle('dark', mode);
    root.classList.toggle('light', !mode);
    root.style.setProperty('--color-primary', primary);

    if (customColors) {
      if (customColors.primaryHover) root.style.setProperty('--color-primary-hover', customColors.primaryHover);
      if (customColors.accentColor || customColors.accent) {
        const accent = customColors.accentColor || customColors.accent;
        root.style.setProperty('--color-accent', accent);
        root.style.setProperty('--color-emerald', accent);
      }
      if (customColors.backgroundDark || customColors.backgroundColor) {
        const bg = mode ? (customColors.backgroundDark || customColors.backgroundColor) : '#f8fafc';
        root.style.setProperty('--color-bg', bg);
        root.style.setProperty('--color-bg-dark', bg);
      }
      if (customColors.cardDark || customColors.cardBackground) {
        const card = mode ? (customColors.cardDark || customColors.cardBackground) : '#ffffff';
        root.style.setProperty('--color-card', card);
        root.style.setProperty('--color-card-dark', card);
      }
    } else {
      if (mode) {
        root.style.setProperty('--color-bg', '#070b13');
        root.style.setProperty('--color-card', '#111726');
      } else {
        root.style.setProperty('--color-bg', '#f8fafc');
        root.style.setProperty('--color-card', '#ffffff');
      }
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    setMounted(true);
    const fetchServerTheme = async () => {
      try {
        const res = await fetch('/api/user/theme?userId=usr_admin_1', { cache: 'no-store' });
        if (res.ok) {
          const data = await res.json();
          const mode = data.themeMode === 'dark';
          const primary = data.primaryColor || '#E05638';
          setIsDarkMode(mode);
          setPrimaryColorState(primary);
          applyThemeToDOM(mode, primary, data);
        }
      } catch (err) {
        console.error('[ThemeProvider] Failed to fetch server theme:', err);
      }
    };
    fetchServerTheme();
  }, []);

  const updateThemeOnServer = async (newSettings: any) => {
    try {
      const payload = {
        userId: 'usr_admin_1',
        themeMode: isDarkMode ? 'dark' : 'light',
        primaryColor,
        ...newSettings
      };

      const res = await fetch('/api/user/theme', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify(payload)
      });

      if (res.ok) {
        const data = await res.json();
        if (data.success && data.theme) {
          const mode = data.theme.themeMode === 'dark';
          const primary = data.theme.primaryColor || primaryColor;
          setIsDarkMode(mode);
          setPrimaryColorState(primary);
          applyThemeToDOM(mode, primary, data.theme);
          window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('zecratary_theme_changed', { detail: data.theme }));
        }
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('[ThemeProvider] Failed to save server theme:', err);
    }
  };

  const toggleThemeMode = () => {
    const nextMode = !isDarkMode;
    setIsDarkMode(nextMode);
    applyThemeToDOM(nextMode, primaryColor);
    updateThemeOnServer({ themeMode: nextMode ? 'dark' : 'light', primaryColor });
  };

  const setPrimaryColor = (color: string) => {
    setPrimaryColorState(color);
    applyThemeToDOM(isDarkMode, color);
    updateThemeOnServer({ themeMode: isDarkMode ? 'dark' : 'light', primaryColor: color });
  };

  return (
    <ThemeContext.Provider value={{ isDarkMode, toggleThemeMode, primaryColor, setPrimaryColor, updateTheme: updateThemeOnServer }}>
      {children}
    </ThemeContext.Provider>
  );
}

export function useTheme() {
  return useContext(ThemeContext);
}
```

```typescript
    (dynamicLanguages || []).forEach((l) => {
      if (l && l.code) {
        const c = l.code.toLowerCase().trim();
        map[c] = {
          flag: l.flag || map[c]?.flag || '🌐',
          native: l.native || l.name || map[c]?.native || l.code.toUpperCase()
        };
      }
    });
    return map;
  }, [dynamicLanguages]);

  const getLanguageMeta = useCallback((code: string) => {
    const c = (code || 'en').toLowerCase().trim();
    return dynamicFlagMap[c] || { flag: '🌐', native: code.toUpperCase() };
  }, [dynamicFlagMap]);

  // Synchronize dynamicLanguages whenever langContext updates
  useEffect(() => {
    const ctxLangs = (langContext as any)?.availableLanguages || (langContext as any)?.languages;
    if (Array.isArray(ctxLangs) && ctxLangs.length > 0) {
      setDynamicLanguages(ctxLangs.map(normalizeLanguageItem));
    }
  }, [langContext]);

  // Active Languages Filtered by Status (ONLY show language that is active)
  const activeLanguages = useMemo(() => {
    const sourceList = Array.isArray(dynamicLanguages) && dynamicLanguages.length > 0
      ? dynamicLanguages
      : ((langContext as any)?.availableLanguages || []);

    const normalizedList = (Array.isArray(sourceList) && sourceList.length > 0
      ? sourceList
      : [
          { code: 'en', name: 'English', native: 'English', flag: '🇺🇸', status: 'active', is_default: true },
          { code: 'th', name: 'Thai', native: 'ไทย', flag: '🇹🇭', status: 'active', is_default: false },
          { code: 'es', name: 'Spanish', native: 'Español', flag: '🇪🇸', status: 'active', is_default: false },
          { code: 'fr', name: 'French', native: 'Français', flag: '🇫🇷', status: 'active', is_default: false }
        ]
    ).map(normalizeLanguageItem);

    const activeOnly = normalizedList.filter(isLanguageActive);
    return activeOnly.length > 0 
      ? activeOnly 
      : [{ code: 'en', name: 'English', native: 'English', flag: '🇺🇸', status: 'active', is_default: true }];
  }, [dynamicLanguages, langContext]);

  // Auto-switch to active default language if currentLanguage was deactivated in /admin/language
  useEffect(() => {
    if (activeLanguages.length > 0) {
      const isCurrentActive = activeLanguages.some(
        l => l.code && l.code.toLowerCase().trim() === currentLanguage.toLowerCase().trim()
      );
      if (!isCurrentActive) {
        const fallbackLang = activeLanguages.find(l => l.is_default) || activeLanguages[0];
        if (fallbackLang?.code && typeof changeLanguage === 'function') {
          changeLanguage(fallbackLang.code);
        }
      }
    }
  }, [activeLanguages, currentLanguage, changeLanguage]);

  // Accordion Sections - Collapsed by default
  const DEFAULT_OPEN_SECTIONS = {
  create: true,
  manage: true,
  plan: true,
  finance: false,
  admin: false,
};

  const [openSections, setOpenSections] = useState<{
    create: boolean;
    manage: boolean;
    plan: boolean;
    finance: boolean;
    admin: boolean;
  }>(() => {
    if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
      try {
        const stored = localStorage.getItem('zecratary_sidebar_sections');
        if (stored) {
          const parsed = JSON.parse(stored);
          if (parsed && typeof parsed === 'object') {
            return { ...DEFAULT_OPEN_SECTIONS, ...parsed };
          }
        }
      } catch (_) {}
    }
    return DEFAULT_OPEN_SECTIONS;
  });

  // Topbar Dropdown Controls
  const [notifDropdownOpen, setNotifDropdownOpen] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [langDropdownOpen, setLangDropdownOpen] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [profileDropdownOpen, setProfileDropdownOpen] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [dropdownLangExpanded, setDropdownLangExpanded] = useState<boolean>(false);

  // Synchronous Balances & Telemetry
  const [tokenBalance, setTokenBalance] = useState<number>(() => {
    try {
      const u = getCurrentUser();
      const val = Number(u?.token_balance ?? u?.tokenBalance ?? u?.tokens ?? 100);
      return isNaN(val) ? 100 : val;
    } catch (_) { return 100; }
  });
  const [tokenSymbol, setTokenSymbol] = useState<string>('🪙');
  const [tokenIcon, setTokenIcon] = useState<string>('🪙');

  const [walletBalance, setWalletBalance] = useState<number>(() => {
    try {
      const u = getCurrentUser();
      const val = parseFloat(String(u?.wallet_balance ?? u?.walletBalance ?? 0));
      return isNaN(val) ? 0 : val;
    } catch (_) { return 0; }
  });
  const [walletCurrency, setWalletCurrency] = useState<string>('USD');
  const [walletSymbol, setWalletSymbol] = useState<string>('$');

  const [notifications, setNotifications] = useState<InAppNotification[]>([]);
  const [unreadCount, setUnreadCount] = useState<number>(0);

  const topbarRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  // Dedicated Language Synchronizer (Immediate response to /admin/language updates)
  const syncLanguages = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`/api/admin/languages?t=${Date.now()}`, { cache: 'no-store' });
      if (res.ok) {
        const data = await res.json();
        const incoming = data.languages || data.supported_languages || data.data;
        if (Array.isArray(incoming) && incoming.length > 0) {
          const normalized = incoming.map(normalizeLanguageItem);
          setDynamicLanguages(normalized);
          if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
            try {
              localStorage.setItem('zecratary_languages', JSON.stringify(normalized));
            } catch (_) {}
          }
          return;
        }
      }
    } catch (_) {}

    const ctxLangs = (langContext as any)?.availableLanguages || (langContext as any)?.languages;
    if (Array.isArray(ctxLangs) && ctxLangs.length > 0) {
      setDynamicLanguages(ctxLangs.map(normalizeLanguageItem));
    }
  }, [langContext]);

  // Dynamic Telemetry & Settings Fetcher (PostgreSQL & MySQL Synced)
  const fetchBalancesAndTelemetry = useCallback(async (activeU?: any) => {
    try {
      const u = activeU || getCurrentUser();
      const params = new URLSearchParams();
      if (u?.id) params.set('userId', String(u.id));
      if (u?.email) params.set('email', String(u.email));
      const qs = params.toString() ? `?${params.toString()}&t=${Date.now()}` : `?t=${Date.now()}`;

      const [tokRes, walRes, notifRes, cfgRes, curRes, langRes] = await Promise.allSettled([
        fetch(`/api/tokens${qs}`, { cache: 'no-store' }),
        fetch(`/api/wallet${qs}`, { cache: 'no-store' }),
        fetch(`/api/notifications${qs}`, { cache: 'no-store' }),
        fetch(`/api/admin/token-setting`, { cache: 'no-store' }),
        fetch(`/api/admin/currencies`, { cache: 'no-store' }),
        fetch(`/api/admin/languages`, { cache: 'no-store' })
      ]);

      let dynamicCurrMap = { ...DEFAULT_CURRENCY_SYMBOLS };

      if (curRes.status === 'fulfilled' && curRes.value.ok) {
        const curData = await curRes.value.json();
        if (curData.currencySymbols && typeof curData.currencySymbols === 'object') {
          dynamicCurrMap = { ...dynamicCurrMap, ...curData.currencySymbols };
          setCurrencySymbols(dynamicCurrMap);
        }
      }

      if (langRes.status === 'fulfilled' && langRes.value.ok) {
        const lData = await langRes.value.json();
        const incoming = lData.languages || lData.supported_languages || lData.data;
        if (Array.isArray(incoming) && incoming.length > 0) {
          const normalized = incoming.map(normalizeLanguageItem);
          setDynamicLanguages(normalized);
          if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
            try {
              localStorage.setItem('zecratary_languages', JSON.stringify(normalized));
            } catch (_) {}
          }
        }
      }

      if (tokRes.status === 'fulfilled' && tokRes.value.ok) {
        const tData = await tokRes.value.json();
        const rawTok = tData.tokenBalance ?? tData.token_balance ?? tData.balance ?? tData.tokens;
        const numTok = Number(rawTok);
        if (!isNaN(numTok)) setTokenBalance(numTok);
        if (tData.tokenSymbol) setTokenSymbol(tData.tokenSymbol);
        if (tData.tokenIcon) setTokenIcon(tData.tokenIcon);
      }

      if (walRes.status === 'fulfilled' && walRes.value.ok) {
        const wData = await walRes.value.json();
        const rawWal = wData.wallet_balance ?? wData.walletBalance ?? wData.balance ?? wData.user?.wallet_balance;
        const numWal = parseFloat(String(rawWal ?? 0));
        if (!isNaN(numWal)) setWalletBalance(numWal);
        const curr = (wData.currency || wData.settings?.currency || 'USD').toUpperCase();
        setWalletCurrency(curr);
        setWalletSymbol(dynamicCurrMap[curr] || wData.walletSymbol || '$');
      }

      if (notifRes.status === 'fulfilled' && notifRes.value.ok) {
        const nData = await notifRes.value.json();
        if (Array.isArray(nData.notifications)) {
          setNotifications(nData.notifications);
          setUnreadCount(nData.unreadCount ?? nData.notifications.filter((x: any) => !x.isRead).length);
        }
      }

      if (cfgRes.status === 'fulfilled' && cfgRes.value.ok) {
        const cData = await cfgRes.value.json();
        const cfg = cData.settings || cData.config || cData;
        if (cfg?.tokenIcon) setTokenIcon(cfg.tokenIcon);
        if (cfg?.tokenSymbol) setTokenSymbol(cfg.tokenSymbol);
      }
    } catch (_) {}
  }, []);

  const syncUserState = useCallback(() => {
    try {
      const u = getCurrentUser();
      setCurrentUser(u);
      if (typeof getSiteName === 'function') setSiteName(getSiteName());
      if (typeof getSiteIcon === 'function') {
        const icon = getSiteIcon();
        setSiteIcon(icon);
        updateFavicon(icon);
      }

      fetchSiteConfig().then((cfg) => {
        if (cfg) {
          if (cfg.siteName) setSiteName(cfg.siteName);
          const authoritativeIcon = cfg.titlebarImage || cfg.titlebar_image || cfg.titlebarEmoji || cfg.titlebar_emoji || cfg.siteIcon;
          if (authoritativeIcon) {
            setSiteIcon(authoritativeIcon);
            updateFavicon(cfg.faviconImage || cfg.favicon_image || cfg.faviconEmoji || authoritativeIcon);
          }
        }
      }).catch(() => {});

      if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
        const themeMode = localStorage.getItem('zecratary_theme_mode') || 'dark';
        setIsDarkMode(themeMode === 'dark');

        const cur = (localStorage.getItem('zecratary_currency') || 'USD').toUpperCase();
        setWalletCurrency(cur);
        setWalletSymbol(currencySymbols[cur] || '$');

        const storedSections = localStorage.getItem('zecratary_sidebar_sections');
        if (storedSections) {
          try {
            setOpenSections(prev => ({ ...prev, ...JSON.parse(storedSections) }));
          } catch (_) {}
        }

        const storedLangs = localStorage.getItem('zecratary_languages');
        if (storedLangs) {
          try {
            const parsed = JSON.parse(storedLangs);
            if (Array.isArray(parsed) && parsed.length > 0) {
              setDynamicLanguages(parsed.map(normalizeLanguageItem));
            }
          } catch (_) {}
        }
      }

      if (u?.id || u?.email) {
        fetch(`/api/user/sidebar-settings?userId=${encodeURIComponent(u.id || u.email)}`)
          .then(res => res.json())
          .then(data => {
            if (data?.success && data?.sections) {
              setOpenSections(prev => ({ ...prev, ...data.sections }));
            }
          })
          .catch(() => {});
      }

      fetchBalancesAndTelemetry(u);
    } catch (_) {}
  }, [currencySymbols, fetchBalancesAndTelemetry]);

  // Dynamic Layout Clearance Tokens (--sidebar-width & --topbar-height)
  useEffect(() => {
    if (typeof window === 'undefined') return;
    const updateLayoutTokens = () => {
      const isMobile = window.innerWidth < 768;
      if (isMobile) {
        document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--sidebar-width', '0px');
        document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--topbar-height', '3.5rem');
      } else {
        document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--sidebar-width', isCollapsed ? '5rem' : '16rem');
        document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--topbar-height', '4rem');
      }
    };
    updateLayoutTokens();
    window.addEventListener('resize', updateLayoutTokens);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('resize', updateLayoutTokens);
  }, [isCollapsed]);

  // Route Auto-Expansion
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!pathname) return;
    if (['/chef', '/import', '/manual'].some(p => pathname === p || pathname.startsWith(`${p}/`))) {
      setOpenSections(prev => prev.create ? prev : { ...prev, create: true });
    } else if (['/recipes', '/books', '/pantry'].some(p => pathname === p || pathname.startsWith(`${p}/`))) {
      setOpenSections(prev => prev.manage ? prev : { ...prev, manage: true });
    } else if (['/shopping', '/planner', '/templates'].some(p => pathname === p || pathname.startsWith(`${p}/`))) {
      setOpenSections(prev => prev.plan ? prev : { ...prev, plan: true });
    } else if (['/token', '/wallet', '/subscriptions', '/billing'].some(p => pathname === p || pathname.startsWith(`${p}/`))) {
      setOpenSections(prev => prev.finance ? prev : { ...prev, finance: true });
    } else if (pathname.startsWith('/admin')) {
      setOpenSections(prev => prev.admin ? prev : { ...prev, admin: true });
    }
  }, [pathname]);

  // Real-Time Event & Cross-Tab Subscriptions
  useEffect(() => {
    setMounted(true);
    syncUserState();
    syncLanguages();

    const handleSync = () => syncUserState();
    const handleLangSync = () => {
      syncLanguages();
      fetchBalancesAndTelemetry();
    };

    const handleWalletUpdate = (e?: any) => {
      if (e?.detail) {
        const b = e.detail.wallet_balance ?? e.detail.walletBalance ?? e.detail.balance;
        if (b !== undefined && b !== null) {
          const parsed = parseFloat(String(b));
          if (!isNaN(parsed)) setWalletBalance(parsed);
        }
      }
      fetchBalancesAndTelemetry();
    };
    const handleTokensUpdate = (e?: any) => {
      if (e?.detail) {
        const b = e.detail.token_balance ?? e.detail.tokenBalance ?? e.detail.balance;
        if (b !== undefined && b !== null) {
          const parsed = Number(b);
          if (!isNaN(parsed)) setTokenBalance(parsed);
        }
      }
      fetchBalancesAndTelemetry();
    };

    window.addEventListener('storage', handleSync);
    window.addEventListener('zecratary_auth_changed', handleSync);
    window.addEventListener('zecratary_site_settings_changed', handleSync);
    window.addEventListener('zecratary_site_config_updated', handleSync);
    window.addEventListener('zecratary_admin_settings_updated', handleLangSync);
    window.addEventListener('zecratary_theme_mode_changed', handleSync);
    window.addEventListener('zecratary_wallet_updated', handleWalletUpdate);
    window.addEventListener('zecratary_tokens_updated', handleTokensUpdate);
    window.addEventListener('zecratary_token_settings_updated', handleSync);
    window.addEventListener('zecratary_languages_updated', handleLangSync);
    window.addEventListener('zecratary_locale_changed', handleLangSync);
    window.addEventListener('zecratary_currency_updated', handleSync);
    window.addEventListener('focus', handleLangSync);
    document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', () => {
      if (document.visibilityState === 'visible') {
        handleLangSync();
      }
    });

    let balanceChannel: BroadcastChannel | null = null;
    let languageChannel: BroadcastChannel | null = null;
    if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && 'BroadcastChannel' in window) {
      try {
        balanceChannel = new BroadcastChannel('zecratary_balance_channel');
        balanceChannel.onmessage = (msg) => {
          if (msg.data?.wallet_balance !== undefined) {
            setWalletBalance(parseFloat(String(msg.data.wallet_balance)));
          }
          if (msg.data?.token_balance !== undefined || msg.data?.tokens !== undefined) {
            setTokenBalance(Number(msg.data.token_balance ?? msg.data.tokens));
          }
        };

        languageChannel = new BroadcastChannel('zecratary_language_channel');
        languageChannel.onmessage = () => {
          syncLanguages();
        };
      } catch (_) {}
    }

    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('storage', handleSync);
      window.removeEventListener('zecratary_auth_changed', handleSync);
      window.removeEventListener('zecratary_site_settings_changed', handleSync);
      window.removeEventListener('zecratary_theme_mode_changed', handleSync);
      window.removeEventListener('zecratary_wallet_updated', handleWalletUpdate);
      window.removeEventListener('zecratary_tokens_updated', handleTokensUpdate);
      window.removeEventListener('zecratary_token_settings_updated', handleSync);
      window.removeEventListener('zecratary_languages_updated', handleLangSync);
      window.removeEventListener('zecratary_locale_changed', handleLangSync);
      window.removeEventListener('zecratary_currency_updated', handleSync);
      window.removeEventListener('zecratary_admin_settings_updated', handleLangSync);
      window.removeEventListener('focus', handleLangSync);
      if (balanceChannel) balanceChannel.close();
      if (languageChannel) languageChannel.close();
    };
  }, [syncUserState, syncLanguages, fetchBalancesAndTelemetry]);

  // Click Outside & Escape Key Listener
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleClickOutside = (e: MouseEvent) => {
      if (topbarRef.current && !topbarRef.current.contains(e.target as Node)) {
        setNotifDropdownOpen(false);
        setLangDropdownOpen(false);
        setProfileDropdownOpen(false);
        setDropdownLangExpanded(false);
      }
    };

    const handleKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.key === 'Escape') {
        setNotifDropdownOpen(false);
        setLangDropdownOpen(false);
        setProfileDropdownOpen(false);
        setDropdownLangExpanded(false);
      }
    };

    document.addEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
    document.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
      document.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    };
  }, []);

  const toggleSection = (sectionKey: keyof typeof openSections) => {
    setOpenSections(prev => {
      const next = { ...prev, [sectionKey]: !prev[sectionKey] };
      if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
        try {
          localStorage.setItem('zecratary_sidebar_sections', JSON.stringify(next));
        } catch (_) {}
      }
      const u = getCurrentUser();
      const uId = u?.id || u?.email;
      if (uId) {
        fetch('/api/user/sidebar-settings', {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
          body: JSON.stringify({ userId: uId, sections: next })
        }).catch(() => {});
      }
      return next;
    });
  };

  const toggleTheme = () => {
    const nextMode = !isDarkMode;
    setIsDarkMode(nextMode);
    if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
      const modeStr = nextMode ? 'dark' : 'light';
      localStorage.setItem('zecratary_theme_mode', modeStr);
      if (nextMode) {
        document.documentElement.classList.add('dark');
        document.documentElement.classList.remove('light');
      } else {
        document.documentElement.classList.remove('dark');
        document.documentElement.classList.add('light');
      }
      window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('zecratary_theme_mode_changed', { detail: { mode: modeStr } }));
    }
  };

  const markAllNotificationsRead = async () => {
    setUnreadCount(0);
    setNotifications(prev => prev.map(n => ({ ...n, isRead: true })));
    try {
      const u = getCurrentUser();
      const params = new URLSearchParams();
      if (u?.id) params.set('userId', String(u.id));
      if (u?.email) params.set('email', String(u.email));
      await fetch(`/api/notifications?${params.toString()}`, {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ action: 'mark_all_read' })
      });
    } catch (_) {}
  };

  const handleLogout = async () => {
    try {
      setProfileDropdownOpen(false);
      await logoutUser();
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Logout error:', err);
    } finally {
      if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
        window.location.replace('/login?logout=true');
      }
    }
  };

  const isAuthRoute = Boolean(
    pathname === '/login' ||
    pathname === '/register' ||
    pathname === '/forgot-password' ||
    pathname.startsWith('/login') ||
    pathname.startsWith('/register') ||
    pathname.startsWith('/forgot-password')
  );

  const isHomePage = Boolean(
    pathname === '/' ||
    pathname === '' ||
    pathname === '/index'
  );

  if (!mounted || isAuthRoute || isHomePage || !currentUser) {
    return null;
  }

  const isAdmin = Boolean(
    currentUser?.role === 'admin' ||
    currentUser?.email === 'admin@zecratary.com' ||
    currentUser?.email?.includes('admin')
  );

  const isRouteActive = (route: string): boolean => {
    if (!pathname) return false;
    const cleanPath = pathname === '/' ? '/' : pathname.replace(/\/+$/, '');
    const cleanRoute = route === '/' ? '/' : route.replace(/\/+$/, '');

    if (cleanRoute === '/' || cleanRoute === '/admin') {
      return cleanPath === cleanRoute;
    }
    return cleanPath === cleanRoute || cleanPath.startsWith(`${cleanRoute}/`);
  };

  const navClass = (route: string) => {
    const active = isRouteActive(route);
    return `flex items-center gap-3 px-3 py-2 rounded-xl font-bold text-xs transition duration-200 cursor-pointer ${
      active ? 'text-white shadow-xs' : 'hover:text-white hover:bg-slate-800/30'
    }`;
  };

  const navStyle = (route: string) => {
    const active = isRouteActive(route);
    return active
      ? { backgroundColor: 'var(--color-primary)', color: '#ffffff' }
      : { color: 'var(--color-text-secondary)', backgroundColor: 'transparent' };
  };

  const planBadgeText = currentUser?.subscription_plan === 'pro' 
    ? t('topbarPlanPro', 'Pro Plan') 
    : t('topbarPlanFree', 'Free Tier');

  const financeWalletLabel = t('navWallet', t('wallet') === 'Wallet Settings' ? 'Wallet' : t('wallet', 'Wallet'));

  return (
    <>
      {/* DESKTOP TOP BAR (Fixed Header with Real-Time Telemetry) */}
      <header
        id="zecratary-desktop-topbar"
        role="banner"
        aria-label="Application Header"
        data-lpignore="true"
        data-form-type="other"
        className="hidden md:flex fixed top-0 left-0 right-0 h-16 border-b z-40 items-center justify-between px-6 transition-colors duration-200"
        style={{
          backgroundColor: 'var(--color-card)',
          borderColor: 'var(--color-border)',
          color: 'var(--color-text)'
        }}
        ref={topbarRef}
      >
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setIsCollapsed(!isCollapsed)}
            className="p-1.5 rounded-lg border hover:bg-slate-800/20 cursor-pointer transition mr-1"
            style={{ borderColor: 'var(--color-border)' }}
            title={isCollapsed ? t('expandSidebar', 'Expand Menu') : t('collapseSidebar', 'Collapse Menu')}
          >
            <Menu className="h-4 w-4" />
          </button>
          <Link href="/dashboard" className="flex items-center gap-2.5 font-black text-lg text-[var(--color-primary)]">
            {isImageIcon(siteIcon) ? (
              <img src={siteIcon} alt="Logo" className="w-7 h-7 rounded-lg object-contain" />
            ) : (
              <span className="text-2xl">{siteIcon || '🍳'}</span>
            )}
            <span>{siteName || 'Zecratary'}</span>
          </Link>
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5 sm:gap-3">
          {/* 1. DEDICATED STORE WALLET CAPSULE */}
          <div 
            className="flex items-center rounded-2xl border p-0.5 shadow-xs transition hover:border-[var(--color-primary)]/40"
            style={{
              backgroundColor: 'var(--color-inner-dark)',
              borderColor: 'var(--color-border)'
            }}
          >
            <Link 
              href="/wallet" 
              className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1 rounded-xl hover:opacity-85 transition group cursor-pointer"
              title={t('viewWalletBalance', 'View Wallet Balance & History')}
            >
              <span 
                suppressHydrationWarning
                className="text-xs font-mono font-black" 
                style={{ color: 'var(--color-emerald)' }}
              >
                {walletSymbol}{Number(walletBalance || 0).toFixed(2)}
              </span>
              <span className="text-[10px] font-bold opacity-60 font-mono">
                {walletCurrency}
              </span>
            </Link>

            <Link
              href="/wallet"
              className="flex items-center justify-center w-7 h-7 rounded-xl text-xs font-black transition cursor-pointer hover:opacity-90 active:scale-95 text-white shadow-xs shrink-0"
              style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--color-primary)' }}
              title={t('topUpWallet', 'Top Up Wallet')}
              aria-label="Top Up Wallet"
            >
              <Plus className="h-3.5 w-3.5 stroke-[3]" />
            </Link>
          </div>

          {/* 2. DEDICATED AI TOKEN CAPSULE */}

              backgroundColor: 'var(--color-inner-dark)',
              borderColor: 'var(--color-border)'

              aria-label="Top Up Tokens"
            >
              <Plus className="h-3.5 w-3.5 stroke-[3]" />

          </div>

          {/* 3. NOTIFICATIONS BELL & POPOVER */}

            <button
              type="button"

                setNotifDropdownOpen(!notifDropdownOpen);
                setLangDropdownOpen(false);
                setProfileDropdownOpen(false);
              }}

                backgroundColor: 'var(--color-inner-dark)',

              }}

            >

                <span className="absolute -top-1 -right-1 w-4 h-4 bg-red-500 text-white text-[9px] font-black rounded-full flex items-center justify-center shadow-md animate-pulse">

            {notifDropdownOpen && (

                  backgroundColor: 'var(--color-card)',
                  borderColor: 'var(--color-border)',
                  color: 'var(--color-text)'

                      <span className="px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-red-500/10 text-red-400 font-bold text-[10px]">
                        {unreadCount} {t('topbarUnreadCount', 'unread')}

                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    {unreadCount > 0 && (
                      <button
                        type="button"

                      >
                        <CheckCheck className="h-3 w-3" />
                        <span>{t('topbarMarkAllRead', 'Mark all read')}</span>
                      </button>
                    )}
                    {isAdmin && (
                      <Link
                        href="/admin/notification-settings"
                        onClick={() => setNotifDropdownOpen(false)}
                        className="text-[10px] opacity-70 hover:opacity-100"
                      >
                        {t('settings', 'Settings')}
                      </Link>
                    )}
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div className="space-y-2 max-h-64 overflow-y-auto pr-1">
                  {notifications.length === 0 ? (
                    <div className="text-center py-8 opacity-60 text-xs">
                      {t('topbarNoNotifications', 'No unread notifications')}
                    </div>
                  ) : (
                    notifications.map((n) => (
                      <div
                        key={n.id}
                        className={`p-2.5 rounded-2xl border space-y-1 transition ${
                          n.isRead ? 'opacity-70' : 'border-[var(--color-primary)]/40 shadow-xs'
                        }`}
                        style={{
                          backgroundColor: 'var(--color-inner-dark)',
                          borderColor: n.isRead ? 'var(--color-border)' : 'var(--color-primary)'
                        }}
                      >
                        <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                          <span className="font-bold text-xs">{n.title}</span>
                          {!n.isRead && (
                            <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-[var(--color-primary)] shrink-0" />
                          )}
                        </div>
                        <div className="text-[11px] opacity-80 leading-relaxed">{n.message}</div>
                      </div>
                    ))
                  )}

              </div>

                  color: 'var(--color-text)'

                        if (typeof changeLanguage === 'function') changeLanguage(lang.code);
                        setLangDropdownOpen(false);

                        <span>{lang.native || meta.native}</span>

                      </span>
                      {isSelected && <Check className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-emerald-400" />}
                    </button>

                })}
              </div>

                backgroundColor: 'var(--color-inner-dark)',
                borderColor: 'var(--color-border)',

              }}

                style={{
                  backgroundColor: 'var(--color-card)',
                  borderColor: 'var(--color-border)',
                  color: 'var(--color-text)'
                }}

                  <div className="text-[11px] opacity-60 truncate">{currentUser?.email || ''}</div>

                <Link

                  <Layers className="h-4 w-4 opacity-80" />

                <Link

                </Link>

                <div className="pt-1.5 border-t space-y-1" style={{ borderColor: 'var(--color-border)' }}>

                      type="button"

                      <span className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
                        <Globe className="h-4 w-4 text-[var(--color-primary)]" />

                      <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                        <span className="text-xs">{getLanguageMeta(currentLanguage).flag}</span>
                        <span className="text-[10px] font-mono uppercase opacity-75">{currentLanguage}</span>
                        <ChevronRight className={`h-3 w-3 opacity-60 transition-transform duration-200 ${dropdownLangExpanded ? 'rotate-90' : 'rotate-0'}`} />
                      </span>
                    </button>

                    {dropdownLangExpanded && (

                        className="my-1 ml-2 p-1.5 border rounded-2xl space-y-1 transition-colors duration-200"

                        }}

                          const meta = getLanguageMeta(lang.code);
                          const isSel = currentLanguage === lang.code;
                          return (
                            <button
                              key={lang.code}
                              type="button"
                              onClick={() => {
                                if (typeof changeLanguage === 'function') changeLanguage(lang.code);
                                setDropdownLangExpanded(false);
                              }}

              backgroundColor: 'var(--color-inner-dark)',
              borderColor: 'var(--color-border)'

              <Plus className="h-3 w-3 stroke-[3]" />

              backgroundColor: 'var(--color-inner-dark)',

            }}

            >

                {Number(tokenBalance || 0).toLocaleString()}
              </span>

            >
              <Plus className="h-3 w-3 stroke-[3]" />

                  <SquarePen className="h-4 w-4 shrink-0" />

                <span>{t('manageSection', 'Manage')}</span>

                <span>{t('planSection', 'Plan')}</span>

                <Link href="/templates" className={navClass('/templates')} style={navStyle('/templates')} title={t('templates', 'Meal Blueprints')}>
                  <LayoutTemplate className="h-4 w-4 shrink-0" />
```

```typescript
'use client';
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { useRouter, usePathname } from 'next/navigation';
import { getCurrentUser, initAuthStorage } from '@/lib/auth';

const PUBLIC_ROUTES = ['/login', '/register'];
const ADMIN_RESTRICTED_PREFIXES = ['/admin', '/add-user'];

export default function AuthGuard({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const pathname = usePathname();
  const [authorized, setAuthorized] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    initAuthStorage();
    const user = getCurrentUser();
      const hasCookie = typeof document !== 'undefined' && document.cookie.includes('zecratary_session=');
    const isPublicRoute = PUBLIC_ROUTES.includes(pathname);

    // 1. Unauthenticated users -> Redirect to /login
    if (!user && !isPublicRoute) {
      setAuthorized(false);
      router.replace('/login');
      return;
    }

    // 2. Logged-in users visiting /login or /register -> Redirect to /dashboard
    if (user && isPublicRoute) {
      router.replace('/dashboard');
      return;
    }

    // 3. Standard users attempting to access Admin pages -> Block and redirect to /dashboard
    const isAdminRoute = ADMIN_RESTRICTED_PREFIXES.some(prefix => 
      pathname === prefix || pathname.startsWith(prefix + '/')
    );

    if (user && isAdminRoute && user.role !== 'admin') {
      alert('Access restricted: Administrator privileges required.');
      router.replace('/dashboard');
      return;
    }

    setAuthorized(true);
  }, [pathname, router]);

  if (!authorized && !PUBLIC_ROUTES.includes(pathname)) {
    return (
      <div className="min-h-screen bg-[#070b13] flex items-center justify-center">
        <div className="w-8 h-8 border-2 border-[#E05638] border-t-transparent rounded-full animate-spin"></div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return <>{children}</>;
}
```

```typescript
'use client';

import { useEffect } from 'react';
import { fetchAndApplyServerTheme, applyThemeToDocument } from '@/lib/themeConfig';

export default function ThemeSync() {
  useEffect(() => {
    fetchAndApplyServerTheme();

    const handleSync = (e: any) => {
      if (e?.detail) {
        applyThemeToDocument(e.detail);
      } else {
        try {
          const stored = localStorage.getItem('zecratary_theme_colors') || localStorage.getItem('zecratary_theme_config');
          if (stored) applyThemeToDocument(JSON.parse(stored));
        } catch (_) {}
      }
    };

    window.addEventListener('zecratary_theme_changed', handleSync);
    window.addEventListener('zecratary_theme_updated', handleSync);
    window.addEventListener('storage', handleSync);

    const handlePageShow = (e: PageTransitionEvent) => {
      if (e.persisted) {
        fetchAndApplyServerTheme();
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener('pageshow', handlePageShow);

    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('zecratary_theme_changed', handleSync);
      window.removeEventListener('zecratary_theme_updated', handleSync);
      window.removeEventListener('storage', handleSync);
      window.removeEventListener('pageshow', handlePageShow);
    };
  }, []);

  return null;
}
```

```typescript
// @ts-nocheck
'use client';

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { Coins, Sparkles, Zap } from 'lucide-react';

export function TokenEmojiLoader({ size = 14, className = "" }: { size?: number; className?: string }) {
  return (
    <span 
      suppressHydrationWarning
      className={`inline-flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 align-middle ${className}`}
      style={{ width: `${size}px`, height: `${size}px` }}
      title="Loading token emoji..."
    >
      <span 
        className="rounded-full border-2 border-amber-400 border-t-transparent animate-spin inline-block"
        style={{ width: `${size}px`, height: `${size}px` }}
      />
    </span>
  );
}

export interface DynamicTokenIconProps {
  icon?: string;
  symbol?: string;
  size?: number;
  loading?: boolean;
  className?: string;
  style?: React.CSSProperties;
}

export function DynamicTokenIcon({ 
  icon, 
  symbol, 
  size = 16, 
  loading = false,
  className = '', 
  style = {} 
}: DynamicTokenIconProps) {
  const [mounted, setMounted] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [activeSymbol, setActiveSymbol] = useState<string>(() => symbol || '');

  useEffect(() => {
    setMounted(true);

    if (symbol) {
      setActiveSymbol(symbol);
      return;
    }

    if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
      const stored = localStorage.getItem('zecratary_token_symbol');
      if (stored) setActiveSymbol(stored);

      const handleSettingsUpdate = (e: any) => {
        const sym = e?.detail?.tokenSymbol || e?.detail?.settings?.tokenSymbol || localStorage.getItem('zecratary_token_symbol');
        if (sym) setActiveSymbol(sym);
      };

      let balanceBc: BroadcastChannel | null = null;
      try {
        balanceBc = new BroadcastChannel('zecratary_balance_channel');
        balanceBc.onmessage = (event) => {
          if (event?.data?.tokenSymbol || event?.data?.settings?.tokenSymbol) {
            const sym = event.data.tokenSymbol || event.data.settings?.tokenSymbol;
            if (sym) setActiveSymbol(sym);
          }
        };
      } catch (_) {}

      window.addEventListener('zecratary_token_settings_updated', handleSettingsUpdate);
      window.addEventListener('zecratary_tokens_updated', handleSettingsUpdate);

      return () => {
        if (balanceBc) balanceBc.close();
        window.removeEventListener('zecratary_token_settings_updated', handleSettingsUpdate);
        window.removeEventListener('zecratary_tokens_updated', handleSettingsUpdate);
      };
    }
  }, [symbol]);

  const targetSymbol = symbol || (mounted ? activeSymbol : '');

  if (loading || (!targetSymbol && !icon)) {
    return <TokenEmojiLoader size={size} className={className} />;
  }

  const targetImage = (icon && (icon.startsWith('http') || icon.startsWith('/') || icon.startsWith('data:image'))) 
    ? icon 
    : (targetSymbol && (targetSymbol.startsWith('http') || targetSymbol.startsWith('/') || targetSymbol.startsWith('data:image')) ? targetSymbol : null);

  if (targetImage) {
    return (
      <img 
        src={targetImage} 
        alt="Token" 
        style={{ width: `${size}px`, height: `${size}px`, ...style }} 
        className={`inline-block object-contain shrink-0 ${className}`} 
      />
    );
  }

  const lower = targetSymbol.toLowerCase();
  if (lower === 'coins' || lower === 'coin') {
    return <Coins style={{ width: `${size}px`, height: `${size}px`, ...style }} className={`shrink-0 ${className}`} />;
  }
  if (lower === 'sparkles' || lower === 'sparkle') {
    return <Sparkles style={{ width: `${size}px`, height: `${size}px`, ...style }} className={`shrink-0 ${className}`} />;
  }
  if (lower === 'zap' || lower === 'lightning' || lower === 'flash') {
    return <Zap style={{ width: `${size}px`, height: `${size}px`, ...style }} className={`shrink-0 ${className}`} />;
  }

  return (
    <span 
      suppressHydrationWarning
      style={{ fontSize: `${size}px`, lineHeight: 1, ...style }} 
      className={`inline-flex items-center justify-center select-none shrink-0 ${className}`}
    >
      {targetSymbol}
    </span>
  );
}

export default DynamicTokenIcon;
```

```typescript
import { useState } from 'react';
import { Coins, CheckCircle2, AlertCircle, X, Sparkles, Loader2, ArrowRight } from 'lucide-react';
import { useTranslation } from '@/components/LanguageProvider';

interface TokenPackage {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  tokens: number;
  price: number;
  badge?: string;
}

interface TokenPurchaseModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  userId?: string | null;
  userEmail?: string | null;
  tokenSymbol?: string;
  packages: TokenPackage[];
  onPurchased?: (newBalance: number) => void;
}

export default function TokenPurchaseModal({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  userId,
  userEmail,
  tokenSymbol = '🪙',
  packages,
  onPurchased
}: TokenPurchaseModalProps) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const [buyingId, setBuyingId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [errorMsg, setErrorMsg] = useState('');
  const [successMsg, setSuccessMsg] = useState('');

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const handleBuy = async (pkg: TokenPackage) => {
    setBuyingId(pkg.id);
    setErrorMsg('');
    setSuccessMsg('');

    try {
      const res = await fetch('/api/tokens', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          action: 'purchase',
          packageId: pkg.id,
          userId,
          userEmail
        })
      });

      const data = await res.json();
      if (!res.ok || !data.success) {
        throw new Error(data.error || 'Failed to purchase tokens.');
      }

      setSuccessMsg(data.message || `Added ${pkg.tokens} tokens!`);
      if (onPurchased && typeof data.newBalance === 'number') {
        onPurchased(data.newBalance);
      }
      setTimeout(() => {
        onClose();
        setSuccessMsg('');
      }, 1800);
    } catch (err: any) {
      setErrorMsg(err.message || 'Purchase error');
    } finally {
      setBuyingId(null);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-sm animate-in fade-in">
      <div 
        className="w-full max-w-lg rounded-3xl border p-6 space-y-5 shadow-2xl transition-colors duration-200"
        style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--color-card)', borderColor: 'var(--color-border)', color: 'var(--color-text)' }}
      >
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b pb-3" style={{ borderColor: 'var(--color-border)' }}>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
            <div className="p-2 rounded-xl bg-amber-500/10 text-amber-500">
              <Coins className="h-5 w-5" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <h3 className="text-base font-black" style={{ color: 'var(--color-text)' }}>
                {t('purchaseTokensModalTitle', 'Top Up Token Balance')}
              </h3>
              <p className="text-[11px]" style={{ color: 'var(--color-text-secondary)' }}>
                {t('purchaseTokensModalSubtitle', 'Choose a package to consume recipes & chef generation seamlessly.')}
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
          <button 
            type="button" 
            onClick={onClose}
            className="p-1.5 rounded-lg border hover:opacity-75 transition cursor-pointer"
            style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--color-inner-dark)', borderColor: 'var(--color-border)' }}
          >
            <X className="h-4 w-4" />
          </button>
        </div>

        {errorMsg && (
          <div className="p-3 border rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold flex items-center gap-2 text-red-500 bg-red-500/10 border-red-500/20">
            <AlertCircle className="h-4 w-4 shrink-0" />
            <span>{errorMsg}</span>
          </div>
        )}

        {successMsg && (
          <div className="p-3 border rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold flex items-center gap-2 text-emerald-500 bg-emerald-500/10 border-emerald-500/20">
            <CheckCircle2 className="h-4 w-4 shrink-0" />
            <span>{successMsg}</span>
          </div>
        )}

        <div className="space-y-3">
          {packages.map((pkg) => (
            <div 
              key={pkg.id}
              className="flex items-center justify-between p-4 rounded-2xl border transition hover:border-amber-500/50"
              style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--color-inner-dark)', borderColor: 'var(--color-border)' }}
            >
              <div className="space-y-1">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <span className="text-xs font-black" style={{ color: 'var(--color-text)' }}>{pkg.name}</span>
                  {pkg.badge && (
                    <span className="text-[10px] font-black px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full border bg-amber-500/10 border-amber-500/30 text-amber-500">
                      {pkg.badge}
                    </span>
                  )}
                </div>
                <div className="text-xs font-mono font-bold text-amber-500 flex items-center gap-1">
                  <span>+{pkg.tokens}</span>
                  <span>{tokenSymbol}</span>
                </div>
              </div>

              <button
                type="button"
                disabled={Boolean(buyingId)}
                onClick={() => handleBuy(pkg)}
                className="px-4 py-2 rounded-xl text-white font-extrabold text-xs flex items-center gap-1.5 shadow-md transition cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-50"
                style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--color-primary)' }}
              >
                {buyingId === pkg.id ? (
                  <Loader2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5 animate-spin" />
                ) : (
                  <>
                    <span>${pkg.price.toFixed(2)}</span>
                    <ArrowRight className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                  </>
                )}
              </button>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```typescript
'use client';

import { useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import { useServerInsertedHTML } from 'next/navigation';
import { applyThemeToDocument, fetchAndApplyServerTheme, applyGlobalFont } from '@/lib/themeConfig';

export default function GlobalThemeSync() {
  const isInserted = useRef(false);

  useServerInsertedHTML(() => {
    if (isInserted.current) return null;
    isInserted.current = true;

    const prehydrateScript = `(function() {
      try {
        var doc = document.documentElement;
        doc.classList.add('theme-preloading');
        var mode = localStorage.getItem('zecratary_theme_mode');
        var isDay = mode === 'light' || mode === 'day';
        if (isDay) {
          doc.classList.remove('dark');
          doc.classList.add('light');
        } else {
          doc.classList.remove('light');
          doc.classList.add('dark');
        }
        var stored = localStorage.getItem('zecratary_theme_colors') || localStorage.getItem('zecratary_theme_config');
        var c = stored ? JSON.parse(stored) : null;
        if (c) {
          var p = c.primary || c.primaryColor || '#10b981';
          var ph = c.primaryHover || '#059669';
          var ac = c.accentEmerald || c.accentColor || c.accent || '#10b981';
          var bg = c.backgroundColor || c.backgroundDark || '#070b13';
          var card = c.cardBackground || c.cardDark || '#0f172a';
          var border = c.cardBorder || c.borderColor || '#1e293b';
          var textSec = c.textSecondary || '#94a3b8';
          var txt = c.textColor || '#ffffff';

          doc.style.setProperty('--color-primary', p);
          doc.style.setProperty('--color-primary-hover', ph);
          doc.style.setProperty('--color-accent', ac);
          doc.style.setProperty('--color-emerald', ac);

          if (isDay) {
            doc.style.setProperty('--color-bg', '#f8fafc');
            doc.style.setProperty('--color-card', '#ffffff');
            doc.style.setProperty('--color-inner-dark', '#f1f5f9');
            doc.style.setProperty('--color-border', '#e2e8f0');
            doc.style.setProperty('--color-text', '#0f172a');
            doc.style.setProperty('--color-text-secondary', '#64748b');
          } else {
            doc.style.setProperty('--color-bg', bg);
            doc.style.setProperty('--color-card', card);
            doc.style.setProperty('--color-inner-dark', '#111726');
            doc.style.setProperty('--color-border', border);
            doc.style.setProperty('--color-text', txt);
            doc.style.setProperty('--color-text-secondary', textSec);
          }
        }
      } catch (e) {}
    })();`;

    return (
      <script
        id="zecratary-theme-prehydrate"
        dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: prehydrateScript }}
      />
    );
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    if (typeof document !== 'undefined') {
      document.documentElement.classList.remove('theme-preloading');
    }

    fetchAndApplyServerTheme();

    const handleThemeUpdate = (e: Event) => {
      const detail = (e as CustomEvent)?.detail;
      if (detail && typeof detail === 'object' && !('mode' in detail)) {
        applyThemeToDocument(detail);
      } else {
        fetchAndApplyServerTheme();
      }
    };

    const handleFontUpdate = (e: Event) => {
      const detail = (e as CustomEvent)?.detail;
      if (detail) {
        (applyGlobalFont as any)(detail.fontFamily, detail.fontSize, detail.fontLetterSpacing);
      } else {
        (applyGlobalFont as any)();
      }
    };

    const handleModeUpdate = () => {
      applyThemeToDocument();
    };

    window.addEventListener('zecratary_theme_updated', handleThemeUpdate);
    window.addEventListener('zecratary_theme_changed', handleThemeUpdate);
    window.addEventListener('zecratary_admin_settings_updated', handleThemeUpdate);
    window.addEventListener('zecratary_theme_mode_changed', handleModeUpdate);
    window.addEventListener('zecratary_font_updated', handleFontUpdate);
    window.addEventListener('storage', handleThemeUpdate);

    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('zecratary_theme_updated', handleThemeUpdate);
      window.removeEventListener('zecratary_theme_changed', handleThemeUpdate);
      window.removeEventListener('zecratary_admin_settings_updated', handleThemeUpdate);
      window.removeEventListener('zecratary_theme_mode_changed', handleModeUpdate);
      window.removeEventListener('zecratary_font_updated', handleFontUpdate);
      window.removeEventListener('storage', handleThemeUpdate);
    };
  }, []);

  return null;
}
```

```typescript
// @ts-nocheck
/**
 * Dual Database Engine - MySQL Adapter
 * Repository: cygnusorbit/zecratary (GitHub)
 */

declare const __non_webpack_require__: ((id: string) => any) | undefined;

export interface MysqlQueryResult<T = any> extends Array<T> {
  rows: T[];
  fields?: any[];
  affectedRows?: number;
  insertId?: number;
  [key: string]: any;
}

let cachedMysqlDriver: any = null;
let driverChecked = false;

function getMysqlDriver(): any {
  if (driverChecked) return cachedMysqlDriver;
  driverChecked = true;

  try {
    if (typeof __non_webpack_require__ === 'function') {
      cachedMysqlDriver = __non_webpack_require__('mysql2/promise');
      return cachedMysqlDriver;
    }
  } catch (_) {}

  return null;
}

export function isMysqlAvailable(): boolean {
  return !!getMysqlDriver();
}

export function getMysqlConnectionUrl(): string | null {
  const url = process.env.MYSQL_URL || process.env.MYSQL_DATABASE_URL;
  if (url && url.startsWith('mysql://')) return url;

  const dbUrl = process.env.DATABASE_URL;
  if (dbUrl && dbUrl.startsWith('mysql://')) return dbUrl;

  const host = process.env.MYSQL_HOST;
  const database = process.env.MYSQL_DATABASE;
  if (host && database) {
    const user = process.env.MYSQL_USER || 'root';
    const password = process.env.MYSQL_PASSWORD || '';
    const port = process.env.MYSQL_PORT || '3306';
    return `mysql://${encodeURIComponent(user)}:${encodeURIComponent(password)}@${host}:${port}/${database}`;
  }

  return null;
}

const globalWithMysql = globalThis as unknown as {
  __zecratary_mysql_pool?: any;
};

export async function getMysqlPool(): Promise<any> {
  if (globalWithMysql.__zecratary_mysql_pool) {
    return globalWithMysql.__zecratary_mysql_pool;
  }

  const driver = getMysqlDriver();
  const connUrl = getMysqlConnectionUrl();

  if (!driver || !connUrl) {
    return null;
  }

  try {
    const pool = driver.createPool({
      uri: connUrl,
      waitForConnections: true,
      connectionLimit: 10,
      queueLimit: 0,
      enableKeepAlive: true,
      keepAliveInitialDelay: 10000,
    });

    globalWithMysql.__zecratary_mysql_pool = pool;
    return pool;
  } catch (err: any) {
    console.warn('[MySQL Pool Initialization Notice]:', err.message);
    return null;
  }
}

export const getMysqlConnection = getMysqlPool;

export async function query<T = any>(sql: string, params: any[] = []): Promise<any> {
  const pool = await getMysqlPool();

  if (!pool) {
    try {
      const { query: pgQuery } = await import('@/lib/db').catch(() => ({ query: null }));
      if (typeof pgQuery === 'function') {
        const pgResult = await pgQuery(sql, params);
        const rows = Array.isArray(pgResult) ? pgResult : (pgResult?.rows || []);
        const formatted = [...rows] as MysqlQueryResult<T>;
        formatted.rows = rows;
        return formatted;
      }
    } catch (_) {}

    const empty = [] as unknown as MysqlQueryResult<T>;
    empty.rows = [];
    return empty;
  }

  try {
    const [rawRows, fields] = await pool.query(sql, params);
    const rows = Array.isArray(rawRows) ? rawRows : [];
    const result = [...rows] as MysqlQueryResult<T>;
    result.rows = rows;
    result.fields = fields;

    if (rawRows && typeof rawRows === 'object' && !Array.isArray(rawRows)) {
      result.affectedRows = (rawRows as any).affectedRows;
      result.insertId = (rawRows as any).insertId;
    }

    return result;
  } catch (err: any) {
    console.warn('[MySQL Query Notice]:', err.message);
    const errResult = [] as unknown as MysqlQueryResult<T>;
    errResult.rows = [];
    return errResult;
  }
}

export const queryMysql = query;
export const execute = query;
export const executeMysql = query;

export const mysqlPool = {
  query,
  queryMysql,
  execute,
  executeMysql,
  getPool: getMysqlPool,
  getConnection: getMysqlPool,
};
export const pool = mysqlPool;

export default {
  query,
  queryMysql,
  execute,
  executeMysql,
  pool,
  mysqlPool,
  getMysqlPool,
  getMysqlConnection,
  isMysqlAvailable,
  getMysqlConnectionUrl,
};
```

```typescript
import { Pool } from 'pg';
import fs from 'fs';
import path from 'path';

let pool: Pool | null = null;

export function getPostgresPool(): Pool | null {
  if (pool) return pool;

  const connectionString = 
    process.env.DATABASE_URL || 
    process.env.POSTGRES_URL || 
    process.env.PG_CONNECTION_STRING;

  if (!connectionString) {
    return null;
  }

  try {
    pool = new Pool({
      connectionString,
      ssl: process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production' ? { rejectUnauthorized: false } : undefined,
      max: 10,
      idleTimeoutMillis: 30000,
      connectionTimeoutMillis: 5000,
    });
    return pool;
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('[PostgreSQL] Pool initialization error:', err);
    return null;
  }
}

export async function syncUserToPostgres(user: any): Promise<any> {
  let resolvedUser = { ...user };
  const p = getPostgresPool();

  if (p) {
    try {
      await p.query(`
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users (
          id VARCHAR(255) PRIMARY KEY,
          name VARCHAR(255),
          email VARCHAR(255) UNIQUE NOT NULL,
          password VARCHAR(255),
          role VARCHAR(50) DEFAULT 'user',
          picture TEXT,
          avatar TEXT,
          subscription_plan VARCHAR(100) DEFAULT 'taster',
          provider VARCHAR(50) DEFAULT 'credentials',
          created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
          updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
        );
      `);

      const alterQueries = [
        "ALTER TABLE users ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS picture TEXT",
        "ALTER TABLE users ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS avatar TEXT",
        "ALTER TABLE users ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS role VARCHAR(50) DEFAULT 'user'",
        "ALTER TABLE users ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS provider VARCHAR(50) DEFAULT 'credentials'",
        "ALTER TABLE users ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS subscription_plan VARCHAR(100) DEFAULT 'taster'",
        "ALTER TABLE users ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP"
      ];
      for (const q of alterQueries) {
        try { await p.query(q); } catch (_) {}
      }

      const email = user.email.toLowerCase().trim();
      const existing = await p.query(
        'SELECT * FROM users WHERE LOWER(email) = LOWER($1) LIMIT 1',
        [email]
      );

      if (existing.rows && existing.rows.length > 0) {
        const row = existing.rows[0];
        const updatedRes = await p.query(
          `UPDATE users SET 
            name = COALESCE($1, name),
            picture = COALESCE($2, picture),
            avatar = COALESCE($2, avatar),
            provider = COALESCE(provider, 'google'),
            updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
          WHERE LOWER(email) = LOWER($3)
          RETURNING *`,
          [
            user.name || row.name, 
            user.picture || row.picture || row.avatar, 
            email
          ]
        );
        const ur = updatedRes.rows[0] || row;
        resolvedUser = {
          id: ur.id,
          name: ur.name,
          email: ur.email,
          role: ur.role || row.role || user.role || 'user',
          subscriptionPlan: ur.subscription_plan || row.subscription_plan || 'taster',
          picture: ur.picture || ur.avatar || user.picture || '',
          avatar: ur.avatar || ur.picture || user.avatar || '',
          createdAt: ur.created_at || user.createdAt
        };
      } else {
        const insertRes = await p.query(
          `INSERT INTO users (id, name, email, role, picture, avatar, subscription_plan, provider, created_at, updated_at)
          VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $5, $6, 'google', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
          RETURNING *`,
          [
            user.id,
            user.name,
            email,
            user.role || 'user',
            user.picture || '',
            user.subscriptionPlan || 'taster'
          ]
        );
        const nr = insertRes.rows[0];
        if (nr) {
          resolvedUser = {
            id: nr.id,
            name: nr.name,
            email: nr.email,
            role: nr.role,
            subscriptionPlan: nr.subscription_plan,
            picture: nr.picture || nr.avatar || '',
            avatar: nr.avatar || nr.picture || '',
            createdAt: nr.created_at
          };
        }
      }
    } catch (dbErr) {
      console.error('[PostgreSQL] Failed to sync user to PostgreSQL:', dbErr);
    }
  }

  // File-based store fallback
  try {
    const cwd = process.cwd();
    const paths = [
      path.join(cwd, 'apps/web/data/users.json'),
      path.join(cwd, 'data/users.json')
    ];
    for (const p of paths) {
      try {
        let list: any[] = [];
        if (fs.existsSync(p)) {
          const raw = fs.readFileSync(p, 'utf-8');
          list = JSON.parse(raw);
          if (!Array.isArray(list)) list = [];
        } else {
          fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(p), { recursive: true });
        }
        const idx = list.findIndex(u => u && u.email && u.email.toLowerCase() === resolvedUser.email.toLowerCase());
        if (idx >= 0) {
          list[idx] = { ...list[idx], ...resolvedUser };
        } else {
          list.unshift(resolvedUser);
        }
        fs.writeFileSync(p, JSON.stringify(list, null, 2), 'utf-8');
      } catch (_) {}
    }
  } catch (_) {}

  return resolvedUser;
}
```

```typescript
export function getEffectiveThemeMode(fallback: 'light' | 'dark' = 'dark'): 'light' | 'dark' {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return fallback;
  try {
    const stored = localStorage.getItem('zecratary_theme_mode');
    if (stored === 'light' || stored === 'day') return 'light';
    if (stored === 'dark' || stored === 'night') return 'dark';
    if (document.documentElement.classList.contains('light')) return 'light';
    if (document.documentElement.classList.contains('dark')) return 'dark';
  } catch (_) {}

/**
 * Applies typography font family, size scaling, and tracking dynamically
 */
export function applyGlobalFont(fontFamily?: string, fontSize?: string, letterSpacing?: string): void {
  if (typeof document === 'undefined') return;
  const root = document.documentElement;

  const targetFont = fontFamily || memoryGlobalFont || (typeof window !== 'undefined' ? localStorage.getItem('zecratary_font_family') || localStorage.getItem('zecratary_global_font') : null) || 'Inter';
  const targetSize = fontSize || (typeof window !== 'undefined' ? localStorage.getItem('zecratary_font_size') : null) || '16px';
  const targetSpacing = letterSpacing || (typeof window !== 'undefined' ? localStorage.getItem('zecratary_font_spacing') : null) || '0em';

  if (targetFont && targetFont !== 'inherit') {
    memoryGlobalFont = targetFont;
    const matched = AVAILABLE_FONTS.find(f => f.id.toLowerCase() === targetFont.toLowerCase() || f.name.toLowerCase() === targetFont.toLowerCase());
    const familyValue = matched ? matched.family : targetFont;

    root.style.setProperty('--font-primary', familyValue);
    root.style.setProperty('--font-family', familyValue);
    root.style.setProperty('--font-family-base', familyValue);
    root.style.setProperty('--font-body', familyValue);
    root.style.setProperty('--font-custom', familyValue);
    root.style.fontFamily = familyValue;

    if (document.body) {
      document.body.style.fontFamily = familyValue;
    }

    if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
      try {
        localStorage.setItem('zecratary_font_family', targetFont);
        localStorage.setItem('zecratary_global_font', targetFont);
      } catch (_) {}
    }
  }

  if (targetSize) {
    root.style.setProperty('--font-size-base', targetSize);
    root.style.setProperty('--font-size-global', targetSize);
    root.style.setProperty('--font-size', targetSize);
    if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
      try {
        localStorage.setItem('zecratary_font_size', targetSize);
      } catch (_) {}
    }
  }

  if (targetSpacing) {
    root.style.setProperty('--font-letter-spacing', targetSpacing);
    root.style.setProperty('--letter-spacing-global', targetSpacing);
    root.style.setProperty('--letter-spacing', targetSpacing);
    if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
      try {
        localStorage.setItem('zecratary_font_spacing', targetSpacing);
      } catch (_) {}
    }
  }
}

  if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
```
