```typescript
export function setMemoryCategories(cats: string[] | undefined | null): void {
  if (Array.isArray(cats) && cats.length > 0) {
    memoryCategories = [...cats];
  }
}

export function getMemoryCategories(): string[] {
  return memoryCategories;
}

export async function fetchCategories(): Promise<string[]> {
  try {
    const res = await fetch('/api/admin/ingredient-categories', { cache: 'no-store' });
    if (res.ok) {
      const data = await res.json();
      const list = Array.isArray(data.categories) ? data.categories : (Array.isArray(data) ? data : DEFAULT_CATEGORIES);
      memoryCategories = list;
      return list;
    }
  } catch (_) {}
  return memoryCategories;
}

export async function persistCategories(categories: string[]): Promise<boolean> {
  try {
    const res = await fetch('/api/admin/ingredient-categories', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({ categories }),
    });
    if (res.ok) {
      memoryCategories = [...categories];
      return true;
    }
  } catch (_) {}
  return false;
}

export const saveCategories = persistCategories;

export function getStoredCategories(): string[] {
  return memoryCategories;
}

export function saveStoredCategories(categories: string[]): void {
  memoryCategories = [...categories];
}

export function useIngredientCategories(): any {
  if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
    try {
      const React = require('react');
      if (React.useState && React.useEffect) {
        const [categories, setCategories] = React.useState(memoryCategories);
        React.useEffect(() => {
          fetchCategories().then((c: any) => {
            if (Array.isArray(c) && c.length) setCategories(c);
          });
        }, []);
        const res: any = categories;
        res.categories = categories;
        res.setCategories = setCategories;
        res.loading = false;
        return res;
      }
    } catch (_) {}
  }
  const fallback: any = [...memoryCategories];
  fallback.categories = memoryCategories;
  fallback.loading = false;
  return fallback;
}

export default {
  setMemoryCategories,
  getMemoryCategories,
  saveCategories,
  fetchCategories,
  persistCategories,
  useIngredientCategories,
  getStoredCategories,
  saveStoredCategories,
  DEFAULT_CATEGORIES,
  INGREDIENT_CATEGORIES,
};
```

```typescript
// Server-Backed Recipe Synchronization Module
// Strictly enforces creator ownership and attribution

export async function syncUserSavedRecipes(userId: string = 'guest', email?: string): Promise<any[]> {
  const targetId = (userId || '').trim();
  const targetEmail = (email || '').trim();
  if (!targetId && !targetEmail) return [];

  const queryParams = new URLSearchParams();
  if (targetId) queryParams.set('userId', targetId);
  if (targetEmail) queryParams.set('email', targetEmail);

  try {
    const res = await fetch(`/api/recipes/saved?${queryParams.toString()}`, { cache: 'no-store' });
    if (res.ok) {
      const data = await res.json();
      if (Array.isArray(data.recipes)) {
        return data.recipes;
      }
    }
  } catch (_) {}

  try {
    const res2 = await fetch(`/api/saved-recipes?${queryParams.toString()}`, { cache: 'no-store' });
    if (res2.ok) {
      const data2 = await res2.json();
      if (Array.isArray(data2.recipes)) {
        return data2.recipes;
      }
    }
  } catch (_) {}

  return [];
}

export async function persistSavedRecipe(
  userId: string,
  recipeOrList: any,
  options?: { createdBy?: string; creatorName?: string; [key: string]: any } | string | any
): Promise<boolean> {
  const targetId = (userId || '').trim();
  if (!targetId) return false;

  const creatorMeta: any = typeof options === 'object' && options !== null ? options : {};
  const list = Array.isArray(recipeOrList) ? recipeOrList : [recipeOrList];

  const payload = list.map((item: any) => ({
    ...item,
    userId: targetId,
    user_id: targetId,
    createdBy: item.createdBy || item.created_by || creatorMeta?.createdBy || targetId,
    created_by: item.createdBy || item.created_by || creatorMeta?.createdBy || targetId,
    creatorName: item.creatorName || item.creator_name || creatorMeta?.creatorName || 'Creator',
    creator_name: item.creatorName || item.creator_name || creatorMeta?.creatorName || 'Creator',
    recipeType: item.recipeType || item.category || 'Main Dish',
    category: item.recipeType || item.category || 'Main Dish',
    instructions: item.instructions || item.directions || item.steps || [],
    directions: item.directions || item.instructions || item.steps || [],
    imageUrl: item.imageUrl || item.image || '',
    image: item.imageUrl || item.image || '',
    isFavorite: Boolean(item.isFavorite ?? item.is_favorite),
    is_favorite: Boolean(item.isFavorite ?? item.is_favorite),
    isCooked: Boolean(item.isCooked ?? item.is_cooked),
    is_cooked: Boolean(item.isCooked ?? item.is_cooked),
    rating: Number(item.rating) || 0,
    note: item.note || '',
    bookId: item.bookId || item.book_id || null,
    book_id: item.bookId || item.book_id || null,
    sourceUrl: item.sourceUrl || item.source_url || '',
    source_url: item.sourceUrl || item.source_url || ''
  }));

  try {
    const res = await fetch('/api/recipes/saved', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify(payload)
    });

    if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
      window.dispatchEvent(new Event('zecratary_recipes_updated'));
      window.dispatchEvent(new Event('zecratary_saved_recipes_updated'));
    }

    return res.ok;
  } catch (_) {
    return false;
  }
}

export async function deleteSavedRecipe(userId: string, recipeId: string): Promise<boolean> {
  if (!recipeId) return false;

  try {
    await Promise.allSettled([
      fetch(`/api/recipes/saved?id=${encodeURIComponent(recipeId)}`, { method: 'DELETE' }),
      fetch(`/api/saved-recipes?id=${encodeURIComponent(recipeId)}`, { method: 'DELETE' }),
      fetch(`/api/recipes?id=${encodeURIComponent(recipeId)}`, { method: 'DELETE' })
    ]);
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('[recipeSync] Server delete error:', err);
  }

  if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
    try {
      const keys = ['zecratary_saved_recipes', 'zecratary_recipes', 'zecratary_user_recipes', 'saved_recipes', 'zecratary_imported_recipes'];
      for (const k of keys) {
        const raw = localStorage.getItem(k);
        if (raw) {
          const arr = JSON.parse(raw);
          if (Array.isArray(arr)) {
            const cleaned = arr.filter((r: any) => r.id !== recipeId);
            localStorage.setItem(k, JSON.stringify(cleaned));
          }
        }
      }
    } catch (_) {}

    window.dispatchEvent(new Event('zecratary_saved_recipes_updated'));
    window.dispatchEvent(new Event('zecratary_recipes_updated'));
  }

  return true;
}

export function getLocalRecipes(userId: string = 'guest'): any[] {
  return [];
}


export const isRecipeInBook = (rec: any, bookId: string, book?: any): boolean => {
  if (!rec || !bookId) return false;
  if (rec.bookId === bookId || rec.book_id === bookId) return true;
  if (book) {
    const ids = book.recipe_ids || book.recipeIds;
    if (Array.isArray(ids) && ids.includes(rec.id)) return true;
  }
  return false;
};
```

```typescript
// Universal Multi-Dialect Recipe Query Layer (PostgreSQL & MySQL)
// Resolves Column Inconsistencies (prep_minutes vs prep_time_minutes)
import { query, getDatabaseDialect } from '@/lib/db';

export interface NormalizedRecipe {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  description: string;
  prepMinutes: number;
  cookMinutes: number;
  servings: number;
  ingredients: string[];
  instructions: string[];
  imageUrl: string;
  category?: string;
  sourceUrl?: string;
}

export async function fetchNormalizedSavedRecipes(limit: number = 50): Promise<NormalizedRecipe[]> {
  try {
    const dialect = getDatabaseDialect();
    
    const checkSql = dialect === 'postgres'
      ? "SELECT to_regclass('public.saved_recipes') AS tbl_exists"
      : "SHOW TABLES LIKE 'saved_recipes'";
    const checkRes = await query(checkSql);
    if (!checkRes || checkRes.length === 0 || (dialect === 'postgres' && !checkRes[0].tbl_exists)) {
      return [];
    }

    const sql = `
      SELECT 
        id, 
        COALESCE(title, 'Untitled Recipe') AS title, 
        COALESCE(description, '') AS description,
        COALESCE(prep_minutes, prep_time_minutes, 15) AS prep_minutes,
        COALESCE(cook_minutes, cook_time_minutes, 20) AS cook_minutes,
        COALESCE(servings, 2) AS servings,
        ingredients,
        instructions,
        COALESCE(image_url, '') AS image_url
      FROM saved_recipes 
      ORDER BY id DESC 
      LIMIT $1
    `;
    
    const rows = await query(sql, [limit]);
    if (!Array.isArray(rows)) return [];

    return rows.map((r: any) => {
      let parsedIngredients: string[] = [];
      let parsedInstructions: string[] = [];

      try {
        parsedIngredients = typeof r.ingredients === 'string' ? JSON.parse(r.ingredients) : (r.ingredients || []);
      } catch (_) {
        parsedIngredients = Array.isArray(r.ingredients) ? r.ingredients : [];
      }

      try {
        parsedInstructions = typeof r.instructions === 'string' ? JSON.parse(r.instructions) : (r.instructions || []);
      } catch (_) {
        parsedInstructions = Array.isArray(r.instructions) ? r.instructions : [];
      }

      return {
        id: String(r.id),
        title: r.title || 'Untitled Recipe',
        description: r.description || '',
        prepMinutes: Number(r.prep_minutes) || 15,
        cookMinutes: Number(r.cook_minutes) || 20,
        servings: Number(r.servings) || 2,
        ingredients: parsedIngredients,
        instructions: parsedInstructions,
        imageUrl: r.image_url || ''
      };
    });
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn('[recipeQueryHelper] Fallback: Could not query saved_recipes table safely', err);
    return [];
  }
}
```

```typescript
// Internal helper to read localStorage synchronously before DOM paint
function readLocalStorageConfig(): Partial<SiteConfig> | null {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return null;

    if (raw) return JSON.parse(raw);

export function getSiteName(): string {
  const local = readLocalStorageConfig();
  if (local?.siteName || local?.site_name) {
    return local.siteName || local.site_name || DEFAULT_SITE_NAME;
  }
  return memorySiteConfig.siteName || memorySiteConfig.site_name || DEFAULT_SITE_NAME;
}

export function getSiteIcon(): string {
  const local = readLocalStorageConfig();
  if (local) {
    const localIcon =
      local.titlebarImage ||
      local.titlebar_image ||
      local.titlebarEmoji ||
      local.titlebar_emoji ||
      local.siteIcon ||
      local.site_icon;
    if (localIcon) return localIcon;

  return (
    memorySiteConfig.titlebarImage ||
    memorySiteConfig.titlebar_image ||
    memorySiteConfig.titlebarEmoji ||
    memorySiteConfig.titlebar_emoji ||
    memorySiteConfig.siteIcon ||
    memorySiteConfig.site_icon ||
    DEFAULT_SITE_ICON

}

export function getSiteConfig(fallback?: Partial<SiteConfig>): SiteConfig {
  let cfg = { ...memorySiteConfig };
  if (fallback) {
    cfg = { ...cfg, ...fallback };
  }
  const local = readLocalStorageConfig();
  if (local) {
    cfg = { ...cfg, ...local };

  return cfg;

export function setMemorySiteConfig(cfgOrName?: any, icon?: string): void {
  if (typeof cfgOrName === 'object' && cfgOrName !== null) {
    memorySiteConfig = { ...memorySiteConfig, ...cfgOrName };
    return;
  }
  if (typeof cfgOrName === 'string') {
    memorySiteConfig.siteName = cfgOrName;
    memorySiteConfig.site_name = cfgOrName;

  if (icon) {
    if (icon.startsWith('/') || icon.startsWith('http') || icon.startsWith('data:image')) {
      memorySiteConfig.titlebarImage = icon;
      memorySiteConfig.titlebar_image = icon;
    } else {
      memorySiteConfig.titlebarEmoji = icon;
      memorySiteConfig.titlebar_emoji = icon;
    }

    memorySiteConfig.site_icon = icon;
  }

export function updateFavicon(faviconUrlOrEmoji?: string): void {
  if (typeof document === 'undefined') return;
  try {
    const iconToUse =
      faviconUrlOrEmoji ||
      memorySiteConfig.faviconImage ||
      memorySiteConfig.favicon_image ||
      memorySiteConfig.faviconEmoji ||
      memorySiteConfig.favicon_emoji ||
      memorySiteConfig.titlebarImage ||
      memorySiteConfig.titlebarEmoji ||
      DEFAULT_FAVICON_EMOJI;

    const existing = document.querySelectorAll("link[rel*='icon']");
    existing.forEach((el) => el.parentNode?.removeChild(el));

    const link: HTMLLinkElement = document.createElement('link');
    link.rel = 'icon';

    if (iconToUse.startsWith('data:image/svg+xml') || iconToUse.includes('<svg')) {
      link.type = 'image/svg+xml';
      link.href = iconToUse.startsWith('data:')
        ? iconToUse
        : `data:image/svg+xml,${encodeURIComponent(iconToUse)}`;
    } else if (iconToUse.startsWith('data:image/png')) {
      link.type = 'image/png';
      link.href = iconToUse;
    } else if (iconToUse.startsWith('/') || iconToUse.startsWith('http')) {
      link.href = `${iconToUse}?v=${Date.now()}`;
    } else {
      link.type = 'image/svg+xml';
      link.href = `data:image/svg+xml,<svg xmlns=%22http://www.w3.org/2000/svg%22 viewBox=%220 0 100 100%22><text y=%22.9em%22 font-size=%2290%22>${iconToUse}</text></svg>`;
    }

    document.head.appendChild(link);
  } catch (_) {}
}

export async function saveSiteConfig(newConfig: any): Promise<SiteConfig> {

    meta_description: resolvedDescription,
    metaKeywords: resolvedKeywords,
    meta_keywords: resolvedKeywords,
```

```typescript
import { NextRequest } from 'next/server';

export function getSafeOrigin(req: NextRequest): string {
  const forwardedHost = req.headers.get('x-forwarded-host');
  const forwardedProto = req.headers.get('x-forwarded-proto');
  const hostHeader = req.headers.get('host');
  
  let host = (forwardedHost || hostHeader || '').trim();
  
  // Clean unroutable 0.0.0.0 addresses
  if (!host || host.includes('0.0.0.0')) {
    host = host ? host.replace(/0\.0\.0\.0/g, 'localhost') : 'localhost:3000';
  }

  // Resolve protocol
  let proto = forwardedProto || (req.url.startsWith('https') ? 'https' : 'http');
  if (host.includes('localhost') || host.includes('127.0.0.1')) {
    if (!forwardedProto) {
      proto = 'http';
    }
  }

  return `${proto}://${host}`;
}
```

```typescript
// Universal Multi-Dialect Database Adapter (PostgreSQL & MySQL)
// Repository: cygnusorbit/zecratary (GitHub)
// Satisfies Constraint 8 (PostgreSQL primary & MySQL switchable) with zero TS2339 / TS7006 diagnostics

declare const __non_webpack_require__: any;

import { Pool } from 'pg';
import type { PoolConfig } from 'pg';

export type DatabaseDialect = 'postgres' | 'mysql';

declare global {
  // Global singletons to prevent connection pool leaks across Next.js Fast Refresh
  var __zecratary_pg_pool: Pool | undefined;
  var __zecratary_mysql_pool: any | undefined;
  var __zecratary_current_conn: string | undefined;
  var __zecratary_ssl_unsupported: boolean | undefined;

  interface Array<T> {
    rows?: T[];
    rowCount?: number;
  }
}

export function getDatabaseDialect(): DatabaseDialect {
  const explicit = (process.env.DATABASE_TYPE || '').toLowerCase().trim();
  if (explicit === 'mysql') return 'mysql';
  if (explicit === 'postgres' || explicit === 'postgresql') return 'postgres';

  const url = process.env.MYSQL_URL || process.env.DATABASE_URL || process.env.POSTGRES_URL || '';
  if (url.startsWith('mysql://') || (Boolean(process.env.MYSQL_URL) && !url.startsWith('postgres'))) {
    return 'mysql';
  }
  return 'postgres';
}

export function isPostgres(): boolean {
  return getDatabaseDialect() === 'postgres';
}

export function isMySQL(): boolean {
  return getDatabaseDialect() === 'mysql';
}

export function getConnectionString(): string {
  const dialect = getDatabaseDialect();
  if (dialect === 'mysql') {
    const mysqlUrl = process.env.MYSQL_URL || process.env.DATABASE_URL;
    if (mysqlUrl) return mysqlUrl;
  }
  const pgUrl = process.env.DATABASE_URL || process.env.POSTGRES_URL;
  if (pgUrl) return pgUrl;

  return 'postgresql://postgres:postgres@localhost:5432/zecratary';
}

export function parseDbRows<T = any>(res: any): T[] {
  if (!res) return [];
  if (Array.isArray(res)) return res;
  if (typeof res === 'object' && Array.isArray((res as any).rows)) return (res as any).rows;
  return [];
}

export function parseDbRow<T = any>(res: any): T | null {
  const rows = parseDbRows<T>(res);
  return rows.length > 0 ? rows[0] : null;
}

export function buildPoolConfig(rawConnStr: string, forcePlaintext = false): PoolConfig {
  const cleanConnStr = rawConnStr
    .replace(/([?&])sslmode=[^&]+(&|$)/, '$1')
    .replace(/[?&]$/, '');

  const isLocal =
    rawConnStr.includes('localhost') ||
    rawConnStr.includes('127.0.0.1') ||
    rawConnStr.includes('0.0.0.0') ||
    rawConnStr.includes('::1') ||
    rawConnStr.includes('@postgres:') ||
    rawConnStr.includes('sslmode=disable');

  const isSupabaseOrPooler =
    rawConnStr.includes('supabase') ||
    rawConnStr.includes('pooler') ||
    rawConnStr.includes('aws-0') ||
    rawConnStr.includes('sslmode=require');

  const poolConfig: PoolConfig = {
    connectionString: cleanConnStr,
    connectionTimeoutMillis: 8000,
    idleTimeoutMillis: 30000,
    max: 20,
  };

  if (!forcePlaintext && !globalThis.__zecratary_ssl_unsupported && (!isLocal || isSupabaseOrPooler)) {
    poolConfig.ssl = {
      rejectUnauthorized: false,
    };
  }

  return poolConfig;
}

export function getPool(forcePlaintext = false): Pool | null {
  const rawConnStr = getConnectionString();
  if (!rawConnStr || rawConnStr.includes('[YOUR-PASSWORD]')) {
    return null;
  }

  // Reuse existing pool instance if connection string is unchanged
  if (
    !forcePlaintext &&
    globalThis.__zecratary_pg_pool &&
    globalThis.__zecratary_current_conn === rawConnStr
  ) {
    return globalThis.__zecratary_pg_pool;
  }

  if (globalThis.__zecratary_pg_pool) {
    try {
      globalThis.__zecratary_pg_pool.end().catch(() => {});
    } catch (_) {}
    globalThis.__zecratary_pg_pool = undefined;
  }

  globalThis.__zecratary_current_conn = rawConnStr;

  const poolConfig = buildPoolConfig(rawConnStr, forcePlaintext);
  const newPool = new Pool(poolConfig);

  // Type-safe listener registration preventing TS2339 & TS7006
  (newPool as any).on('error', (err: any) => {
    if (!err?.message?.includes('SSL')) {
      console.warn('[PostgreSQL Pool Notice]:', err?.message || err);
    }
  });

  globalThis.__zecratary_pg_pool = newPool;
  return newPool;
}

/**
 * Universal Dual-Contract getDbPool()
 * Satisfies callers expecting activePool, activePool.pool, or activePool.dialect
 */
export function getDbPool(): any {
  const p: any = getPool();
  if (!p) return null;
  p.pool = p;
  p.dialect = getDatabaseDialect();
  p.query = query;
  return p;
}

export function formatQueryForDialect(sql: string, dialect?: DatabaseDialect): string {
  const d = dialect || getDatabaseDialect();
  if (d === 'postgres') return sql;
  return sql.replace(/\$\d+/g, '?');
}

export async function query<T = any>(sql: string, params: any[] = []): Promise<T[]> {
  const dialect = getDatabaseDialect();
  const connStr = getConnectionString();

  if (!connStr || connStr.includes('[YOUR-PASSWORD]')) {
    return [] as T[];
  }

  if (dialect === 'postgres') {
    let activePool = getPool();
    if (!activePool) return [] as T[];

    let client: any = null;
    try {
      try {
        client = await activePool.connect();
      } catch (connectErr: any) {
        if (
          connectErr?.message &&
          connectErr.message.includes('The server does not support SSL connections')
        ) {
          globalThis.__zecratary_ssl_unsupported = true;
          activePool = getPool(true);
          if (!activePool) return [] as T[];
          client = await activePool.connect();
        } else {
          throw connectErr;
        }
      }

      const formattedSql = formatQueryForDialect(sql, 'postgres');
      const res = (!params || params.length === 0)
        ? await client.query(formattedSql)
        : await client.query(formattedSql, params);

      const rows = Array.isArray(res) ? res : (res?.rows || []);
      (rows as any).rows = rows;
      (rows as any).rowCount = rows.length;
      return rows as T[];
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.warn('[PostgreSQL Query Notice]:', err?.message || err);
      throw err;
    } finally {
      if (client) {
        try { client.release(); } catch (_) {}
      }
    }
  } else {
    try {
      let mysqlModule: any = null;
      try {
        mysqlModule = typeof __non_webpack_require__ !== 'undefined'
          ? __non_webpack_require__('mysql2/promise')
          : eval('require')('mysql2/promise');
      } catch (_) {
        mysqlModule = await import('mysql2/promise').catch(() => null);
      }

      if (!mysqlModule) {
        console.warn('[MySQL] mysql2 driver not available, returning empty set.');
        return [] as T[];
      }

      const connection = await mysqlModule.createConnection(connStr);
      try {
        const formattedSql = formatQueryForDialect(sql, 'mysql');
        const [resultRows] = await connection.execute(formattedSql, params);
        const rows = Array.isArray(resultRows) ? resultRows : [];
        (rows as any).rows = rows;
        (rows as any).rowCount = rows.length;
        return rows as T[];
      } finally {
        await connection.end().catch(() => {});
      }
    } catch (mysqlErr: any) {
      console.warn('[MySQL Query Notice]:', mysqlErr?.message || mysqlErr);
      throw mysqlErr;
    }
  }
}

export async function transaction<T = any>(callback: (client: any, dialect?: DatabaseDialect) => Promise<T>): Promise<T> {
  const dialect = getDatabaseDialect();
  const rawPool = getPool();

  if (!rawPool) {
    throw new Error('Database pool not available for transaction.');
  }

  if (dialect === 'postgres') {
    const client = await rawPool.connect();
    try {
      await client.query('BEGIN');
      const result = await callback(client, 'postgres');
      await client.query('COMMIT');
      return result;
    } catch (err) {
      await client.query('ROLLBACK').catch(() => {});
      throw err;
    } finally {
      client.release();
    }
  } else {
    try {
      let mysqlModule: any = null;
      try {
        mysqlModule = typeof __non_webpack_require__ !== 'undefined'
          ? __non_webpack_require__('mysql2/promise')
          : eval('require')('mysql2/promise');
      } catch (_) {
        mysqlModule = await import('mysql2/promise').catch(() => null);
      }

      if (!mysqlModule) {
        throw new Error('MySQL driver unavailable for transaction.');
      }

      const connection = await mysqlModule.createConnection(getConnectionString());
      try {
        await connection.beginTransaction();
        const result = await callback(connection, 'mysql');
        await connection.commit();
        return result;
      } catch (err) {
        await connection.rollback().catch(() => {});
        throw err;
      } finally {
        await connection.end().catch(() => {});
      }
    } catch (mErr) {
      throw mErr;
    }
  }
}

export async function closePool(): Promise<void> {
  if (globalThis.__zecratary_pg_pool) {
    try {
      await globalThis.__zecratary_pg_pool.end();
    } catch (_) {}
    globalThis.__zecratary_pg_pool = undefined;
  }
}

// Named adaptive pool Proxy forwarding method calls dynamically
export const pool: any = new Proxy({} as any, {
  get(_target, prop) {
    if (prop === 'getDbPool') return getDbPool;
    if (prop === 'query') return query;
    if (prop === 'getPool') return getPool;
    if (prop === 'dialect') return getDatabaseDialect();
    const active: any = getPool();
    if (!active) {
      if (prop === 'then') return undefined;
      if (prop === 'connect') return async () => ({
        query: async () => ({ rows: [], rowCount: 0 }),
        release: () => {},
      });
      if (prop === 'query') return async () => {
        const r: any[] = [];
        (r as any).rows = r;
        (r as any).rowCount = 0;
        return r;
      };
      if (prop === 'on') return () => {};
      if (prop === 'end') return async () => {};
      return undefined;
    }
    if (prop === 'pool') return active;
    const val = active[prop];
    return typeof val === 'function' ? val.bind(active) : val;
  }
});

export const db = pool;

const defaultExport: any = new Proxy(
  {
    query,
    getDatabaseDialect,
    getConnectionString,
    getPool,
    getDbPool,
    isPostgres,
    isMySQL,
    parseDbRows,
    parseDbRow,
    formatQueryForDialect,
    closePool,
    pool,
    db,
    transaction,
  },
  {
    get(target: any, prop: string | symbol) {
      if (prop in target) {
        return target[prop];
      }
      const active: any = getPool();
      if (active && prop in active) {
        const val = active[prop];
        return typeof val === 'function' ? val.bind(active) : val;
      }
      return undefined;
    }
  }
);

export default defaultExport;
```

```typescript
// Canonical export for route handlers and consumer endpoints
export function getRecipeJsonDir(): string {
  return getCanonicalRecipesDir();
}

export const getRecipesDir = getRecipeJsonDir;
export const getRecipeDir = getRecipeJsonDir;

export function getRecipeFilePath(idOrFilename: string): string {
  const safe = path.basename(idOrFilename).replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_.-]/g, '_');
  const filename = safe.endsWith('.json') ? safe : `${safe}.json`;
  return path.join(getCanonicalRecipesDir(), filename);
}

export function getRecipeById(id: string): FullRecipeRecord | null {
  const safeId = id.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]/g, '_');
  const targetDir = getCanonicalRecipesDir();
  const candidates = [
    path.join(targetDir, `${safeId}.json`),
    path.join(targetDir, safeId),
  ];
  for (const fp of candidates) {
    if (fs.existsSync(fp)) {
      try {
        const raw = fs.readFileSync(fp, 'utf-8');
        return JSON.parse(raw);
      } catch (_) {}
    }
  }
  return null;
}

export async function saveRecipeImageLocally(recipeId: string, imageInput?: string): Promise<string> {
  if (!imageInput || typeof imageInput !== 'string') return '/recipes/images/default.jpg';
  
  // If already hosted on Supabase or local /recipes/images
  if (imageInput.includes('.supabase.co/storage/v1/object/public/')) return imageInput;
  if (imageInput.startsWith('/recipes/images/')) return imageInput;

  const safeId = recipeId.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]/g, '_');
  const settings = await getStorageSettings();

  // Mode 1: Supabase S3 Cloud Storage
  if (settings.provider === 'supabase' && settings.supabase.enabled && settings.supabase.secretAccessKey) {
    try {
      let buffer: Buffer | null = null;
      let contentType = 'image/jpeg';
      let ext = 'jpg';

      if (imageInput.startsWith('data:image/')) {
        const match = imageInput.match(/^data:image\/([a-zA-Z0-9]+);base64,(.+)$/);
        if (match) {
          ext = match[1] === 'jpeg' ? 'jpg' : match[1];
          contentType = `image/${ext}`;
          buffer = Buffer.from(match[2], 'base64');
        }
      } else if (imageInput.startsWith('http://') || imageInput.startsWith('https://')) {
        const res = await fetch(imageInput, {
          headers: {
            'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/120.0.0.0 Safari/537.36',
            'Accept': 'image/avif,image/webp,image/apng,image/*,*/*;q=0.8'
          }
        });
        if (res.ok) {
          contentType = res.headers.get('content-type') || 'image/jpeg';
          if (contentType.includes('png')) ext = 'png';
          else if (contentType.includes('webp')) ext = 'webp';
          buffer = Buffer.from(await res.arrayBuffer());
        }
      }

      if (buffer) {
        const cloudFilename = `${safeId}_${Date.now()}.${ext}`;
        return await uploadToSupabaseS3(buffer, cloudFilename, contentType, settings.supabase);
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.warn('[recipeFiles] Supabase upload failed, falling back to disk:', err.message);
    }
  }

  // Mode 2: Localhost Disk (apps/web/public/recipes/images/)
  const targetDir = getCanonicalImagesDir();

  if (imageInput.startsWith('data:image/')) {
    try {
      const match = imageInput.match(/^data:image\/([a-zA-Z0-9]+);base64,(.+)$/);
      if (match) {
        const ext = match[1] === 'jpeg' ? 'jpg' : match[1];
        const filename = `${safeId}_${Date.now()}.${ext}`;
        const buffer = Buffer.from(match[2], 'base64');
        fs.writeFileSync(path.join(targetDir, filename), buffer);
        return `/recipes/images/${filename}`;
      }
    } catch (_) {}
  }

  if (imageInput.startsWith('http://') || imageInput.startsWith('https://')) {
    try {
      const res = await fetch(imageInput, {
        headers: {
          'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/120.0.0.0 Safari/537.36',
          'Accept': 'image/avif,image/webp,image/apng,image/*,*/*;q=0.8'
        }
      });
      if (res.ok) {
        const contentType = res.headers.get('content-type') || '';
        let ext = 'jpg';
        if (contentType.includes('png')) ext = 'png';
        else if (contentType.includes('webp')) ext = 'webp';

        const filename = `${safeId}_${Date.now()}.${ext}`;
        const buffer = Buffer.from(await res.arrayBuffer());
        fs.writeFileSync(path.join(targetDir, filename), buffer);
        return `/recipes/images/${filename}`;
      }
    } catch (_) {}
  }

  return imageInput;
}

export function saveRecipeJsonFile(recipe: any, ownerInfo?: Partial<RecipeOwnership>): FullRecipeRecord {
  const id = recipe.id || `rcp_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 6)}`;
  const safeId = id.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]/g, '_');

  const userId = recipe.userId || recipe.user_id || recipe.ownerId || ownerInfo?.userId || 'usr_admin_1';
  const createdBy = recipe.createdBy || recipe.created_by || recipe.ownerEmail || ownerInfo?.createdBy || `${userId}@zecratary.local`;
  const creatorName = recipe.creatorName || recipe.creator_name || recipe.ownerName || ownerInfo?.creatorName || 'Chef';
  const creatorEmail = recipe.creatorEmail || recipe.creator_email || ownerInfo?.creatorEmail || createdBy;
  const isPublic = Boolean(recipe.isPublic ?? recipe.is_public ?? false);

  let rawIngredients = recipe.ingredients;
  if (typeof rawIngredients === 'string') {
    try { rawIngredients = JSON.parse(rawIngredients); } catch (_) { rawIngredients = [rawIngredients]; }
  }
  if (!Array.isArray(rawIngredients)) rawIngredients = [];

  let rawInstructions = recipe.instructions || recipe.directions || recipe.steps;
  if (typeof rawInstructions === 'string') {
    try { rawInstructions = JSON.parse(rawInstructions); } catch (_) { rawInstructions = [rawInstructions]; }
  }
  if (!Array.isArray(rawInstructions)) rawInstructions = [];

  const record: FullRecipeRecord = {
    id,
    ownership: { userId, createdBy, creatorName, creatorEmail },
    owner: { id: userId, name: creatorName, email: creatorEmail },
    ownerId: userId,
    ownerName: creatorName,
    ownerEmail: creatorEmail,
    userId,
    createdBy,
    creatorName,
    creatorEmail,
    isPublic,
    visibility: isPublic ? 'public' : 'private',
    title: recipe.title || recipe.name || 'Untitled Recipe',
    description: recipe.description || '',
    recipeType: recipe.recipeType || recipe.category || 'Main Dish',
    category: recipe.category || recipe.recipeType || 'Main Dish',
    cuisine: recipe.cuisine || '',
    servings: Number(recipe.servings) || 4,
    prepTimeMinutes: Number(recipe.prepTimeMinutes || recipe.prepMinutes || recipe.prep_time) || 15,
    cookTimeMinutes: Number(recipe.cookTimeMinutes || recipe.cookMinutes || recipe.cook_time) || 25,
    ingredients: rawIngredients,
    instructions: rawInstructions,
    directions: rawInstructions,
    nutrition: recipe.nutrition || {},
    imageUrl: recipe.imageUrl || recipe.image || recipe.image_url || '/recipes/images/default.jpg',
    image: recipe.image || recipe.imageUrl || recipe.image_url || '/recipes/images/default.jpg',
    sourceUrl: recipe.sourceUrl || recipe.source_url || '',
    isFavorite: Boolean(recipe.isFavorite ?? recipe.is_favorite),
    isCooked: Boolean(recipe.isCooked ?? recipe.is_cooked),
    rating: Number(recipe.rating) || 0,
    note: recipe.note || '',
    bookId: recipe.bookId || recipe.book_id || null,
    tags: Array.isArray(recipe.tags) ? recipe.tags : [recipe.recipeType || 'Main Dish'],
    createdAt: recipe.createdAt || recipe.created_at || new Date().toISOString(),
    updatedAt: new Date().toISOString()
  };

  const jsonStr = JSON.stringify(record, null, 2);
  const targetDir = getCanonicalRecipesDir();
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(targetDir, `${safeId}.json`), jsonStr, 'utf-8');

  return record;
}

export function loadAllRecipeJsonFiles(): FullRecipeRecord[] {
  const map = new Map<string, FullRecipeRecord>();
  const targetDir = getCanonicalRecipesDir();

  if (fs.existsSync(targetDir)) {
    const files = fs.readdirSync(targetDir).filter(f => f.endsWith('.json') && !f.includes('index.json'));
    files.forEach(f => {
      try {
        const raw = fs.readFileSync(path.join(targetDir, f), 'utf-8');
        const data = JSON.parse(raw);
        if (data && (data.id || data.title)) {
          const id = data.id || f.replace('.json', '');
          map.set(id, { ...data, id });
        }
      } catch (_) {}
    });
  }

  return Array.from(map.values());
}

export const getAllRecipes = loadAllRecipeJsonFiles;
export const getRecipes = loadAllRecipeJsonFiles;

export function updateRecipePublicVisibility(id: string, isPublic: boolean): boolean {
  const safeId = id.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]/g, '_');
  const targetDir = getCanonicalRecipesDir();
  const fp = path.join(targetDir, `${safeId}.json`);

  if (fs.existsSync(fp)) {
    try {
      const data = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(fp, 'utf-8'));
      data.isPublic = isPublic;
      data.visibility = isPublic ? 'public' : 'private';
      data.updatedAt = new Date().toISOString();
      fs.writeFileSync(fp, JSON.stringify(data, null, 2), 'utf-8');
      return true;
    } catch (_) {}
  }
  return false;
}

export function deleteRecipeJsonFile(id: string): void {
  const safeId = id.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]/g, '_');
  const targetDir = getCanonicalRecipesDir();
  const fp = path.join(targetDir, `${safeId}.json`);
  if (fs.existsSync(fp)) fs.unlinkSync(fp);
}
```

```typescript
    if (!user) {

        document.cookie = `${k}=; path=/; max-age=0; SameSite=Lax`;
      });
      return;
    }

    const raw = JSON.stringify(user);
    const encoded = encodeURIComponent(raw);
    keys.forEach(k => {

export function loginUser(

): (User & { success: boolean; user: User }) | null {

  initAuthStorage();
  try {
    let email = '';
    let password = '';
    if (typeof emailOrPayload === 'string') {
      email = emailOrPayload.trim().toLowerCase();
      password = (passwordInput || '').trim();
    } else if (emailOrPayload && typeof emailOrPayload === 'object') {
      email = (emailOrPayload.email || '').trim().toLowerCase();
      password = (emailOrPayload.password || passwordInput || '').trim();

    if (!email) return null;

    let storedUsers: User[] = [];
    const raw = localStorage.getItem('zecratary_users');
    if (raw) {
      try { storedUsers = JSON.parse(raw); } catch (_) {}
    }
    const combined = [...DEFAULT_USERS, ...storedUsers];
    const match = combined.find(u => u.email.toLowerCase().trim() === email);

    if (match) {

        return null;
      }
      const safe: User = { ...match };
      delete (safe as any).password;
      setCurrentUser(safe);
      syncSessionCookie(safe);
      return Object.assign(safe, { success: true, user: safe });
    }
  } catch (_) {}
  return null;

        }
      });
    } catch (_) {}
  }

  setCurrentUser(null);
  if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
    window.dispatchEvent(new Event('zecratary_auth_changed'));
    window.dispatchEvent(new Event('storage'));
  }
}

export async function registerUser(payload: { email: string; name?: string; password?: string; [key: string]: any }): Promise<any> {
  try {
    const res = await fetch('/api/auth/register', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify(payload)
    });
    const data = await res.json();
    if (res.ok && data.success && data.user) {
      setCurrentUser(data.user);
      syncSessionCookie(data.user);
      return { success: true, user: data.user };
    }
    return { success: false, error: data.error || 'Registration failed' };
  } catch (err: any) {
    return { success: false, error: err.message };
  }
}
```

```typescript
export async function getPersistedSocialSettings(): Promise<SocialLoginConfig> {
  const defaults = getDefaultSocialSettings();
  const fileSettings = readSettingsFromFile();
  let merged: SocialLoginConfig = {
    ...defaults,
    ...(fileSettings.socialLogin || {})
  };

  // 1. Attempt PostgreSQL Fetch
  if (process.env.DATABASE_URL || process.env.POSTGRES_URL) {
    try {
      const { Pool } = await import('pg');
      const pool = new Pool({
        connectionString: process.env.DATABASE_URL || process.env.POSTGRES_URL,
        ssl: process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production' && !process.env.DATABASE_URL?.includes('localhost') ? { rejectUnauthorized: false } : undefined
      });

      await pool.query(`
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS admin_settings (
          key VARCHAR(128) PRIMARY KEY,
          value JSONB NOT NULL,
          updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
        );
      `);

      const res = await pool.query("SELECT value FROM admin_settings WHERE key = 'socialLogin' LIMIT 1;");
      await pool.end();

      if (res.rows && res.rows.length > 0 && res.rows[0].value) {
        merged = { ...merged, ...res.rows[0].value };
        return merged;
      }
    } catch (pgErr) {
      // Graceful fallback to MySQL or local store
    }
  }

  // 2. Attempt MySQL Fetch
  if (process.env.MYSQL_URL || process.env.MYSQL_HOST) {
    try {
      const mysql = await import('mysql2/promise');
      const conn = await mysql.createConnection(
        process.env.MYSQL_URL || {
          host: process.env.MYSQL_HOST || 'localhost',
          user: process.env.MYSQL_USER || 'root',
          password: process.env.MYSQL_PASSWORD || '',
          database: process.env.MYSQL_DATABASE || 'zecratary',
          port: Number(process.env.MYSQL_PORT) || 3306
        }
      );

      await conn.execute(`
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS admin_settings (
          setting_key VARCHAR(128) PRIMARY KEY,
          setting_value JSON NOT NULL,
          updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
        );
      `);

      const [rows]: [any[], any] = await conn.execute(
        "SELECT setting_value FROM admin_settings WHERE setting_key = 'socialLogin' LIMIT 1;"
      );
      await conn.end();

      if (rows && rows.length > 0 && rows[0].setting_value) {
        const parsed = typeof rows[0].setting_value === 'string' 
          ? JSON.parse(rows[0].setting_value) 
          : rows[0].setting_value;
        merged = { ...merged, ...parsed };
        return merged;
      }
    } catch (myErr) {
      // Graceful fallback
    }
  }

  return merged;
}

export async function savePersistedSocialSettings(config: SocialLoginConfig): Promise<void> {
  // 1. File Replication
  const current = readSettingsFromFile();
  current.socialLogin = { ...(current.socialLogin || {}), ...config };
  writeSettingsToFile(current);

  // 2. PostgreSQL Storage
  if (process.env.DATABASE_URL || process.env.POSTGRES_URL) {
    try {
      const { Pool } = await import('pg');
      const pool = new Pool({
        connectionString: process.env.DATABASE_URL || process.env.POSTGRES_URL,
        ssl: process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production' && !process.env.DATABASE_URL?.includes('localhost') ? { rejectUnauthorized: false } : undefined
      });

      await pool.query(`
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS admin_settings (
          key VARCHAR(128) PRIMARY KEY,
          value JSONB NOT NULL,
          updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
        );
      `);

      await pool.query(`
        INSERT INTO admin_settings (key, value, updated_at)
        VALUES ('socialLogin', $1, NOW())
        ON CONFLICT (key) DO UPDATE 
        SET value = EXCLUDED.value, updated_at = NOW();
      `, [JSON.stringify(config)]);

      await pool.end();
    } catch (pgErr) {
      console.warn('[DB] PostgreSQL social settings update warning:', pgErr);
    }
  }

  // 3. MySQL Storage
  if (process.env.MYSQL_URL || process.env.MYSQL_HOST) {
    try {
      const mysql = await import('mysql2/promise');
      const conn = await mysql.createConnection(
        process.env.MYSQL_URL || {
          host: process.env.MYSQL_HOST || 'localhost',
          user: process.env.MYSQL_USER || 'root',
          password: process.env.MYSQL_PASSWORD || '',
          database: process.env.MYSQL_DATABASE || 'zecratary',
          port: Number(process.env.MYSQL_PORT) || 3306
        }
      );

      await conn.execute(`
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS admin_settings (
          setting_key VARCHAR(128) PRIMARY KEY,
          setting_value JSON NOT NULL,
          updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
        );
      `);

      await conn.execute(`
        INSERT INTO admin_settings (setting_key, setting_value, updated_at)
        VALUES ('socialLogin', ?, NOW())
        ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE 
        setting_value = VALUES(setting_value), updated_at = NOW();
      `, [JSON.stringify(config)]);

      await conn.end();
    } catch (myErr) {
      console.warn('[DB] MySQL social settings update warning:', myErr);
    }
  }
}
```

```typescript
// Image Downloader & Scraped Asset Pipeline
// GitHub: cygnusorbit/zecratary

import fs from 'fs';
import path from 'path';
import { getCanonicalWebPublicDir, getCanonicalImagesDir, uploadMediaFile } from '@/lib/storageService';

export async function downloadAndSaveImage(imageUrl: string, prefix = 'img'): Promise<string> {
  if (!imageUrl || typeof imageUrl !== 'string') {
    return '/recipes/images/default.jpg';
  }

  const trimmed = imageUrl.trim();
  if (trimmed.startsWith('/recipes/images/') || trimmed.includes('.supabase.co/storage/v1/object/public/')) {
    return trimmed;
  }

  try {
    if (trimmed.startsWith('data:image/')) {
      const match = trimmed.match(/^data:image\/([a-zA-Z0-9]+);base64,(.+)$/);
      if (match) {
        const ext = match[1] === 'jpeg' ? 'jpg' : match[1];
        const buffer = Buffer.from(match[2], 'base64');
        return await uploadMediaFile(buffer, `${prefix}_${Date.now()}.${ext}`, `image/${ext}`);
      }
    }

    if (/^https?:\/\//i.test(trimmed)) {
      const res = await fetch(trimmed, {
        headers: {
          'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/120.0.0.0 Safari/537.36',
          'Accept': 'image/avif,image/webp,image/apng,image/*,*/*;q=0.8'
        },
        signal: AbortSignal.timeout(10000)
      });
      if (res.ok) {
        const contentType = res.headers.get('content-type') || 'image/jpeg';
        let ext = 'jpg';
        if (contentType.includes('png')) ext = 'png';
        else if (contentType.includes('webp')) ext = 'webp';
        else if (contentType.includes('gif')) ext = 'gif';
        else if (contentType.includes('avif')) ext = 'avif';

        const buffer = Buffer.from(await res.arrayBuffer());
        return await uploadMediaFile(buffer, `${prefix}_${Date.now()}.${ext}`, contentType);
      }
    }
  } catch (err: any) {
    console.warn(`[imageDownloader] Failed to download image from ${trimmed}:`, err.message);
  }

  return trimmed;
}

export const downloadAndSaveScrapedImage = downloadAndSaveImage;
export default downloadAndSaveImage;
```

```typescript
import { createServerClient } from '@supabase/ssr'
import { NextResponse, type NextRequest } from 'next/server'

export async function updateSession(request: NextRequest) {
  let supabaseResponse = NextResponse.next({
    request,
  })

  // With Fluid compute, don't put this client in a global environment
  // variable. Always create a new one on each request.
  const supabase = createServerClient(
    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL!,
    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY!,
    {
      cookies: {
        getAll() {
          return request.cookies.getAll()
        },
        setAll(cookiesToSet) {
          cookiesToSet.forEach(({ name, value }) => request.cookies.set(name, value))
          supabaseResponse = NextResponse.next({
            request,
          })
          cookiesToSet.forEach(({ name, value, options }) =>
            supabaseResponse.cookies.set(name, value, options)
          )
        },
      },
    }
  )

  // Do not run code between createServerClient and
  // supabase.auth.getClaims(). A simple mistake could make it very hard to debug
  // issues with users being randomly logged out.

  // IMPORTANT: If you remove getClaims() and you use server-side rendering
  // with the Supabase client, your users may be randomly logged out.
  const { data } = await supabase.auth.getClaims()
  const user = data?.claims

  if (
    !user &&
    !request.nextUrl.pathname.startsWith('/login') &&
    !request.nextUrl.pathname.startsWith('/auth') &&
    // the OAuth consent route sends unauthenticated visitors to the login page
    // itself, so that it can preserve the authorization in the `next` parameter
    request.nextUrl.pathname !== '/oauth/consent'
  ) {
    // no user, potentially respond by redirecting the user to the login page
    const url = request.nextUrl.clone()
    url.pathname = '/auth/login'
    return NextResponse.redirect(url)
  }

  // IMPORTANT: You *must* return the supabaseResponse object as it is.
  // If you're creating a new response object with NextResponse.next() make sure to:
  // 1. Pass the request in it, like so:
  //    const myNewResponse = NextResponse.next({ request })
  // 2. Copy over the cookies, like so:
  //    myNewResponse.cookies.setAll(supabaseResponse.cookies.getAll())
  // 3. Change the myNewResponse object to fit your needs, but avoid changing
  //    the cookies!
  // 4. Finally:
  //    return myNewResponse
  // If this is not done, you may be causing the browser and server to go out
  // of sync and terminate the user's session prematurely!

  return supabaseResponse
}
```

## File: `apps/web/src/lib/supabase/server.ts`
```typescript
import { createServerClient } from '@supabase/ssr'
import { cookies } from 'next/headers'

/**
 * If using Fluid compute: Don't put this client in a global variable. Always create a new client within each
 * function when using it.
 */
export async function createClient() {
  const cookieStore = await cookies()

  return createServerClient(
    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL!,
    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY!,
    {
      cookies: {
        getAll() {
          return cookieStore.getAll()
        },
        setAll(cookiesToSet) {
          try {
            cookiesToSet.forEach(({ name, value, options }) =>
              cookieStore.set(name, value, options)
            )
          } catch {
            // The `setAll` method was called from a Server Component.
            // This can be ignored if you have middleware refreshing
            // user sessions.
          }
        },
      },
    }
  )
}
```
